rows.translation: Old Joe Clark je v A, no v druhej časti používa G. Tento znížený tón je jej poznávacím znamením.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Add the left-hand moves and rolling right hand that make a tune sound like bluegrass.
rows.translation: Pridajte pohyby ľavej ruky a plynulé vybrnkávanie pravou, ktoré dodávajú melódii bluegrassový zvuk.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Pick a note, then keep pressing as you glide the same finger up to a higher fret. The new note sounds without a second pick stroke. Light, steady pressure is the trick.
rows.translation: Brnknite tón a pri sklze rovnakého prsta na vyšší pražec stále tlačte. Nový tón zaznie bez ďalšieho úderu brnkadlom. Tajomstvom je ľahký, rovnomerný tlak.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: What sounds the second note in a slide?
rows.translation: Čo rozozvučí druhý tón pri sklze?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Your finger pressing as it moves
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Only the first note is picked. Keep pressure on the string as you slide, or the note dies on the way.
rows.translation: Brnkáte iba prvý tón. Počas sklzu udržujte tlak na strunu, inak tón cestou zanikne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Pick an open pair, then snap a fingertip down just behind fret 2. The new note sounds from the tap alone, with no second pick stroke.
rows.translation: Brnknite prázdnu dvojicu, potom prudko položte konček prsta tesne za pražec 2. Nový tón zaznie iba z príklepu, bez druhého úderu brnkadlom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The reverse: with a finger on fret 2, pick, then pull the finger slightly sideways as you lift. That flick plucks the open note below.
rows.translation: Opačný pohyb: s prstom na pražci 2 brnknite a pri zdvíhaní potiahnite prst mierne nabok. Toto šklbnutie rozozvučí nižší tón prázdnej struny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which moves sound a note without the pick?
rows.translation: Ktoré pohyby rozozvučia tón bez brnkadla?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: All three sound a second note with the fretting hand. The pick plays only the first.
rows.translation: Všetky tri rozozvučia druhý tón rukou na hmatníku. Brnkadlo hrá iba prvý.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Fiddle tunes come alive with small ornaments. Here the two plain A notes that open Old Joe Clark become A, B, A: a hammer-on and a pull-off.
rows.translation: Ľudové husľové melódie ožívajú drobnými ozdobami. Dva obyčajné tóny A na začiatku Old Joe Clark sa tu menia na A, B, A: príklep a odtrh.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In A, B, A, how many times do you pick?
rows.translation: Koľkokrát brnknete v postupe A, B, A?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Pick the first A, hammer on to B and pull off back to A. One pick, three notes.
rows.translation: Brnknite prvé A, príklepom zahrajte B a odtrhom sa vráťte na A. Jedno brnknutie, tri tóny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Crosspicking picks single notes across three pairs in a repeating pattern, so a chord sounds like a ripple. Eight notes split three, three and two.
rows.translation: Pri krížovom vybrnkávaní hráte jednotlivé tóny na troch dvojiciach v opakovanom vzore, takže akord znie ako vlnenie. Osem tónov sa delí na tri, tri a dva.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: How are the eight notes of a crosspicking bar grouped?
rows.translation: Ako je zoskupených osem tónov v takte krížového vybrnkávania?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A three-note pattern repeated across a bar of eight makes the accent shift each time. That is the rolling feel.
rows.translation: Trojtónový vzor opakovaný v takte s ôsmimi tónmi zakaždým posunie prízvuk. Tak vzniká plynulé vlnenie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Ripple through G, C and D
rows.translation: Vlnenie cez G, C a D
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Slides, hammer-ons, chops and crosspicking. Take each one at your own pace, and keep the beat steady above all.
rows.translation: Sklzy, príklepy, tlmené údery a krížové vybrnkávanie. Každé cvičte vlastným tempom a predovšetkým udržujte rovnomerný rytmus.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which beats does the chop land on?
rows.translation: Na ktoré doby pripadá tlmený úder?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Five-string, open G: rolls, old-time tunes and clawhammer
rows.translation: Päťstrunové, otvorené G: vybrnkávanie, tradičné melódie a clawhammer
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Meet the five strings, tune to open G, find the drone string and play a song.
rows.translation: Spoznajte päť strún, nalaďte otvorené G, nájdite bordúnovú strunu a zahrajte pieseň.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A banjo has four full-length strings and a fifth that starts partway up the neck, at its own little tuning peg. That short string is the banjo's signature sound.
rows.translation: Banjo má štyri struny plnej dĺžky a piatu, ktorá začína vyššie na krku pri vlastnom malom ladiacom kolíku. Táto krátka struna tvorí typický zvuk banja.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: String 1 is the thin one nearest the floor. Strings 2, 3 and 4 follow toward your face. The short one on top is string 5.
rows.translation: Struna 1 je tenká a najbližšie k podlahe. Struny 2, 3 a 4 nasledujú smerom k vašej tvári. Krátka struna navrchu je struna 5.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which string is the short one?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The fifth string lies next to string 4 but starts at the fifth fret, with its peg on the side of the neck.
rows.translation: Piata struna leží vedľa struny 4, no začína pri piatom pražci a jej kolík je na boku krku.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Pluck string 1, the thin one nearest the floor.
rows.translation: Brnknite strunu 1, tenkú strunu najbližšie k podlahe.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Now the short string, string 5. Pluck it with your thumb.
rows.translation: Teraz krátka struna, struna 5. Brnknite ju palcom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Standard banjo tuning is open G. From string 4 to string 1 it reads D, G, B, D, and the short fifth string is a high G. Strummed open, they make a G chord.
rows.translation: Štandardné ladenie banja je otvorené G. Od struny 4 po strunu 1 znie D, G, B, D a krátka piata struna je vysoké G. Prázdne struny spolu tvoria akord G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Strings 4, 3, 2 and 1: D, G, B, D.
rows.translation: Struny 4, 3, 2 a 1: D, G, B, D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: What chord do the open strings make?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: G, B and D are the notes of a G chord. That is why this tuning is called open G.
rows.translation: G, B a D sú tóny akordu G. Preto sa toto ladenie volá otvorené G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Bluegrass banjo uses a plastic thumb pick and two metal finger picks, on index and middle. The finger picks point down, curving the same way as your fingertips.
rows.translation: V bluegrasse sa na banjo hrá plastovým brnkadlom na palci a dvoma kovovými na ukazováku a prostredníku. Prstové brnkadlá smerujú nadol a kopírujú zakrivenie končekov prstov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: For now your thumb plays strings 3, 4 and 5, your index plays string 2 and your middle plays string 1. Rest your ring and little fingers lightly on the head.
rows.translation: Zatiaľ palec hrá struny 3, 4 a 5, ukazovák strunu 2 a prostredník strunu 1. Prstenník a malíček zľahka oprite o blanu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Thumb takes strings 3, 4 and 5, index takes string 2 and middle takes string 1.
rows.translation: Palec hrá struny 3, 4 a 5, ukazovák strunu 2 a prostredník strunu 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The fifth string is a drone: you play it open, between melody notes, and it rings over everything. In these lessons you never fret it.
rows.translation: Piata struna tvorí bordún: hráte ju prázdnu medzi tónmi melódie a znie nad celým sprievodom. V týchto lekciách ju nikdy nestláčate na pražci.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: First string 5, then string 1. Which is higher?
rows.translation: Najprv struna 5, potom struna 1. Ktorá znie vyššie?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Why does the fifth string sound so high?
rows.translation: Prečo znie piata struna tak vysoko?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: It is short and tuned to high G
rows.translation: Je krátka a naladená na vysoké G
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Being short lets it hold a high G. It sits on top of the melody like a bell.
rows.translation: Vďaka krátkej dĺžke môže byť naladená na vysoké G. Znie nad melódiou ako zvonček.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Tuned to open G, picks on, thumb ready for the drone. Play each string cleanly and let it ring.
rows.translation: Nalaďte otvorené G, nasaďte prstové brnkadlá a pripravte palec na bordún. Každú strunu zahrajte čisto a nechajte ju znieť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: B, high G, low D, high D, G. Find each string by its note.
rows.translation: B, vysoké G, hlboké D, vysoké D, G. Nájdite každú strunu podľa tónu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: String 3, then string 5. Which is higher?
rows.translation: Struna 3, potom struna 5. Ktorá znie vyššie?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: open string 2 is B, fret 2 on string 3 is A, and open string 3 is G. Your second finger frets the A; your thumb picks string 3.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb potrebuje tri tóny: prázdna struna 2 je B, pražec 2 na strune 3 je A a prázdna struna 3 je G. A stláčate druhým prstom; strunu 3 brnkáte palcom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The right-hand patterns behind the rolling bluegrass sound: pinch, alternating thumb and forward roll.
rows.translation: Vzory pravej ruky pre plynulý bluegrassový zvuk: súzvuk, striedanie palca a dopredné vybrnkávanie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A pinch is your thumb and middle finger plucking at the same moment, on strings 5 and 1. It sounds like a little two-note chord and often starts or ends a phrase.
rows.translation: Súzvuk zahráte palcom a prostredníkom naraz na strunách 5 a 1. Znie ako malý dvojtónový akord a často začína alebo končí frázu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Pinch, or one note at a time?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which strings does a pinch play?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Thumb on the short fifth string and middle on string 1, at the same moment.
rows.translation: Palec na krátkej piatej strune a prostredník na strune 1 súčasne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: This roll is eight even notes: thumb on 3, index on 2, thumb on 5, middle on 1, then thumb on 4, index on 2, thumb on 5, middle on 1.
rows.translation: Tento vzor má osem rovnomerných tónov: palec na 3, ukazovák na 2, palec na 5, prostredník na 1, potom palec na 4, ukazovák na 2, palec na 5, prostredník na 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which finger plays every other note?
rows.translation: Ktorý prst hrá každý druhý tón?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Thumb, index, thumb, middle: the thumb plays every other note, which gives the roll its name.
rows.translation: Palec, ukazovák, palec, prostredník: palec hrá každý druhý tón, čo dáva tomuto vzoru jeho názov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The forward roll moves one way, thumb then index then middle, over and over. Eight notes make thumb, index, middle twice, then thumb, index.
rows.translation: Dopredné vybrnkávanie ide jedným smerom: palec, ukazovák, prostredník, stále dookola. Osem tónov tvorí dvakrát palec, ukazovák, prostredník, potom palec a ukazovák.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: How does a forward roll fit into eight notes?
rows.translation: Ako sa dopredné vybrnkávanie zmestí do ôsmich tónov?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Thumb, index, middle twice, then thumb, index. The accent shifts as it goes, which makes the rolling sound.
rows.translation: Dvakrát palec, ukazovák, prostredník, potom palec a ukazovák. Prízvuk sa priebežne posúva, čím vzniká plynulé vlnenie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A roll is only as good as its timing. Keep all eight notes even, like a ticking clock, and land the first note of each bar right on the beat.
rows.translation: Kvalita vybrnkávacieho vzoru závisí od rytmu. Všetkých osem tónov hrajte rovnomerne ako tikot hodín a prvý tón každého taktu zahrajte presne na dobu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: You lose the beat in the middle of a roll. What now?
rows.translation: Uprostred vzoru stratíte rytmus. Čo teraz?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Stop and start the bar over
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Slow down until it feels right
rows.translation: Spomaliť, kým to nebude znieť správne
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Keep the right hand moving and rejoin
rows.translation: Hýbať pravou rukou ďalej a pridať sa
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In a band the beat never waits. Keep the pattern going and catch the next bar.
rows.translation: V kapele rytmus nikdy nečaká. Pokračujte vo vzore a zachyťte ďalší takt.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Pinch, alternating thumb and forward roll, all on open strings. Keep the eighths even and let every string ring.
rows.translation: Súzvuk, striedanie palca a dopredné vybrnkávanie, všetko na prázdnych strunách. Osminové noty hrajte rovnomerne a každú strunu nechajte znieť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which roll goes thumb, index, middle, over and over?
rows.translation: Ktorý vzor stále opakuje palec, ukazovák, prostredník?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Fret G, C, D7 and E minor and keep the roll going through the changes.
rows.translation: Držte akordy G, C, D7 a E mol a pri zmenách pokračujte vo vybrnkávacom vzore.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second finger on fret 2 of string 4, third finger on fret 2 of string 1. Strings 3 and 5 ring open.
rows.translation: Prvý prst na pražci 1 struny 2, druhý na pražci 2 struny 4, tretí na pražci 2 struny 1. Struny 3 a 5 znejú prázdne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Do you fret the fifth string for C?
rows.translation: Stláčate pri C piatu strunu na pražci?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The open high G belongs to the C chord, so it rings as it is. You never fret it in these lessons.
rows.translation: Prázdne vysoké G patrí do akordu C, preto znie bez zmeny. V týchto lekciách ho nikdy nestláčate na pražci.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second finger on fret 2 of string 3. Strings 4 and 1 ring open. Leave the fifth string out; its G clashes with D7.
rows.translation: Prvý prst na pražci 1 struny 2, druhý na pražci 2 struny 3. Struny 4 a 1 znejú prázdne. Piatu strunu vynechajte; jej G sa bije s D7.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The full D7, if you like
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The two-finger D7 has no F sharp. Add your little finger at fret 4 of string 1 and all four notes of D7 ring. Either shape works in the songs; the full one sounds richer.
rows.translation: Dvojprstovému D7 chýba Fis. Pridajte malíček na pražec 4 struny 1 a zaznejú všetky štyri tóny D7. V piesňach fungujú oba hmaty; úplný znie bohatšie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which chord wants to move on?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: What does your thumb do on D7?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The open G of string 5 isn't part of D7. For now your thumb keeps to strings 3 and 4.
rows.translation: Prázdne G struny 5 nepatrí do D7. Zatiaľ sa palec drží strún 3 a 4.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: G is home, C steps away and D7 pulls you back. Change on the first beat of each bar and keep your right hand moving.
rows.translation: G je domov, C odchádza a D7 vás ťahá späť. Akord meňte na prvej dobe každého taktu a pravou rukou neprestávajte hýbať.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which chord pulls you back to G?
rows.translation: Ktorý akord vás ťahá späť ku G?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: D7 contains C, which leans down to B in the G chord. That pull is why so many songs end D7 to G.
rows.translation: D7 obsahuje C, ktoré smeruje nadol k B v akorde G. Preto toľko piesní končí prechodom z D7 na G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Make C, then lift your first finger off string 2. Two fingers stay on fret 2, strings 4 and 1, and the chord turns darker: E minor.
rows.translation: Vytvorte C, potom zdvihnite prvý prst zo struny 2. Dva prsty zostávajú na pražci 2, na strunách 4 a 1, a akord znie temnejšie: E mol.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Four chords and two rolls. Keep the right hand steady even while the left hand is busy changing.
rows.translation: Štyri akordy a dva vybrnkávacie vzory. Pravou rukou hýbte rovnomerne, aj keď ľavá práve mení hmat.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which string sits out on D7?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Alternating thumb: G, C, D7, G
rows.translation: Striedanie palca: G, C, D7, G
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Forward roll: G, E minor, C, D7, G
rows.translation: Dopredne: G, E mol, C, D7, G
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Four traditional tunes, with the drone string ringing in among the melody.
rows.translation: Štyri tradičné melódie s bordúnovou strunou znejúcou medzi tónmi melódie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Here the melody is the main event: pick each note with the finger that owns its string. Strings 3, 2 and 1 carry this whole tune.
rows.translation: Tu je hlavná melódia: každý tón brnknite prstom priradeným jeho strune. Celú melódiu nesú struny 3, 2 a 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: String 2 open, string 3 fret 2, string 3 open, string 2 fret 1, string 1 open.
rows.translation: Struna 2 prázdna, struna 3 pražec 2, struna 3 prázdna, struna 2 pražec 1, struna 1 prázdna.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which note does the tune end on?
rows.translation: Na ktorom tóne sa melódia končí?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Tunes in G come home to G, here the open third string.
rows.translation: Melódie v G sa vracajú domov na G, tu na prázdnu tretiu strunu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Cripple Creek has a high part that uses the fifth string as a melody note, and a low part down on strings 3 and 4. Take each part slowly first.
rows.translation: Cripple Creek má vysokú časť, kde piata struna hrá tón melódie, a nízku časť na strunách 3 a 4. Každú časť si najprv prejdite pomaly.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: String 5 open, then string 1 at fret 4 and fret 2.
rows.translation: Struna 5 prázdna, potom struna 1 na pražci 4 a pražci 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Where does the high G in the first bar come from?
rows.translation: Odkiaľ pochádza vysoké G v prvom takte?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The drone doubles as a melody note here. Your thumb plays it, right on the beat.
rows.translation: Bordún tu plní aj úlohu tónu melódie. Hráte ho palcom presne na dobu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A tune named for a mountain pass
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Cumberland Gap is the pass early settlers took into Kentucky. The tune climbs to E and F♯ on string 1, so your second and fourth fingers get busy.
rows.translation: Cumberland Gap je priesmyk, ktorým prví osadníci vstupovali do Kentucky. Melódia stúpa k E a F♯ na strune 1, takže druhý a štvrtý prst dostanú zabrať.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: String 1: fret 2, fret 4, fret 2, then open.
rows.translation: Struna 1: pražec 2, pražec 4, pražec 2, potom prázdna.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Where do you play F♯ in this tune?
rows.translation: Kde v tejto melódii hráte F♯?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: F♯ is four frets above the open D of string 1. The fifth string is never fretted here.
rows.translation: F♯ je štyri pražce nad prázdnym D struny 1. Piatu strunu tu nikdy nestláčate na pražci.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Shady Grove has the dark, old sound players call mountain minor. It comes to rest on A instead of G, and the high G of the fifth string sings against it.
rows.translation: Shady Grove má temný, starobylý zvuk, ktorý hráči volajú horský mol. Spočinie na A namiesto G a vysoké G piatej struny znie oproti nemu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: String 3 fret 2, string 2 open, string 1 open, string 1 fret 2.
rows.translation: Struna 3 pražec 2, struna 2 prázdna, struna 1 prázdna, struna 1 pražec 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which tune comes to rest on A instead of G?
rows.translation: Ktorá melódia spočinie na A namiesto G?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Shady Grove is in mountain minor, centered on A. The others come home to G.
rows.translation: Shady Grove má horský molový zvuk so stredom na A. Ostatné sa vracajú domov na G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Sound notes with the fretting hand, then use them in Old Joe Clark.
rows.translation: Rozozvučte tóny rukou na hmatníku a potom ich použite v Old Joe Clark.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Pick an open string, then snap a fingertip down just behind fret 2. The new note sounds from the tap alone, with no second pick.
rows.translation: Brnknite prázdnu strunu, potom prudko položte konček prsta tesne za pražec 2. Nový tón zaznie iba z príklepu, bez druhého brnknutia.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Pick string 3 open, then hammer fret 2 with your second finger.
rows.translation: Brnknite prázdnu strunu 3, potom druhým prstom urobte príklep na pražci 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: How many times do you pick for a hammer-on?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The pick sounds the first note. The second comes from your finger striking the string.
rows.translation: Brnkadlo rozozvučí prvý tón. Druhý vznikne úderom prsta o strunu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Fret a note, pick it, then pull your finger slightly sideways as you lift. That flick plucks the open string, so a second note sounds without the pick.
rows.translation: Stlačte tón na pražci, brnknite ho a pri zdvíhaní potiahnite prst mierne nabok. Toto šklbnutie rozozvučí prázdnu strunu, takže druhý tón zaznie bez brnkadla.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Pick string 1 at fret 2, then pull off to open.
rows.translation: Brnknite strunu 1 na pražci 2, potom odtrhom rozozvučte prázdnu strunu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which way does your finger move in a pull-off?
rows.translation: Ktorým smerom sa pohybuje prst pri odtrhu?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Along the string to the next fret
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Lifting straight up only stops the note. A small sideways flick plucks the open string.
rows.translation: Zdvihnutie priamo nahor tón iba zastaví. Malé šklbnutie nabok rozozvučí prázdnu strunu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Fret string 3 at fret 2, pick it, and slide the same finger up to fret 4 while pressing. A to B in one smooth glide is a classic banjo sound.
rows.translation: Stlačte strunu 3 na pražci 2, brnknite a tým istým prstom sa za stáleho tlaku posuňte na pražec 4. Plynulý sklz z A na B je klasický zvuk banja.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Only the first note is picked. Keep pressing as you glide, or the note dies on the way.
rows.translation: Brnkáte iba prvý tón. Pri sklze stále tlačte, inak tón cestou zanikne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Old Joe Clark is in G, but its second part uses F instead of F♯, on string 1 at fret 3. That lowered note gives the tune its old-time sound.
rows.translation: Old Joe Clark je v G, no druhá časť používa F namiesto F♯ na strune 1 na pražci 3. Tento znížený tón dodáva melódii starobylý zvuk.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: String 1: fret 2, fret 3, fret 2, open. Try hammering from 2 to 3.
rows.translation: Struna 1: pražec 2, pražec 3, pražec 2, prázdna. Skúste príklep z 2 na 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which note gives the second part its old-time color?
rows.translation: Ktorý tón dodáva druhej časti starobylú farbu?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: G major uses F♯. Lowering it to F gives the mixolydian sound that runs through old-time and bluegrass music.
rows.translation: G dur používa F♯. Jeho zníženie na F vytvorí mixolýdický zvuk typický pre tradičnú americkú hudbu a bluegrass.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Hammer-ons, pull-offs and slides, then Old Joe Clark. Pick only where you need to and let your fretting hand do the rest.
rows.translation: Príklepy, odtrhy a sklzy, potom Old Joe Clark. Brnkajte iba tam, kde treba, a zvyšok nechajte na ruku na hmatníku.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which move glides a fretted note up to a higher fret?
rows.translation: Ktorý pohyb plynulo posunie stlačený tón na vyšší pražec?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A different right hand: strike down with a fingernail and catch the drone with your thumb.
rows.translation: Iná práca pravej ruky: udrite nechtom nadol a palcom zachyťte bordún.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Clawhammer uses no picks. Curl your hand into a loose claw and strike down on a string with the back of your index or middle fingernail, moving from the wrist and forearm.
rows.translation: Pri technike clawhammer nepoužívate brnkadlá. Ruku voľne zohnite ako pazúr a chrbtom nechta ukazováka alebo prostredníka udrite nadol na strunu. Pohyb vychádza zo zápästia a predlaktia.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: As your hand strikes, the thumb comes to rest on the fifth string. On the next beat it pushes through that string as your hand lifts.
rows.translation: Pri údere ruky sa palec oprie o piatu strunu. Na ďalšej dobe ju pri zdvíhaní ruky zatlačí a uvoľní.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which way does your fingernail move in clawhammer?
rows.translation: Ktorým smerom sa pohybuje necht pri technike clawhammer?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Clawhammer strikes down with the nail. The fingers never pluck upward.
rows.translation: Pri technike clawhammer udierate nechtom nadol. Prsty nikdy nebrnkajú nahor.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The basic clawhammer rhythm sounds like its name. Bum: strike one note on the beat. Dit: brush down across the strings. Ty: your thumb plays string 5.
rows.translation: Základný rytmus techniky clawhammer znie tak, ako sa volá. Bum: udrite jeden tón na dobu. Di: prejdite nadol cez struny. Ti: palec zahrá strunu 5.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which part of bum-ditty does the thumb play?
rows.translation: Ktorú časť rytmu bum-diti hrá palec?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Bum is a single note, dit is a brush and ty is the thumb on the fifth string.
rows.translation: Bum je jeden tón, di je úder cez struny a ti je palec na piatej strune.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In clawhammer the melody notes fall on the bum strikes. The brush and thumb fill in around them, so tune and rhythm come out together.
rows.translation: Pri technike clawhammer pripadajú tóny melódie na údery bum. Úder cez struny a palec vypĺňajú priestor medzi nimi, takže melódia a rytmus znejú spolu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Where do the melody notes go in bum-ditty?
rows.translation: Kam v rytme bum-diti patria tóny melódie?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The bum lands on the beat, so that is where the melody goes. Dit and ty keep the rhythm rolling.
rows.translation: Bum pripadá na dobu, preto tam patrí melódia. Di a ti udržujú plynulý rytmus.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Skip to My Lou was a party game in the 1840s. In clawhammer each melody note is a bum, followed by a brush and the thumb on string 5.
rows.translation: Skip to My Lou bola spoločenská hra v desaťročí od roku 1840. Pri technike clawhammer je každý tón melódie bum, po ktorom nasleduje úder cez struny a palec na strune 5.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: What does your thumb play after each brush?
rows.translation: Čo hrá palec po každom údere cez struny?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Bum, dit, ty: the ty is always the thumb on the short fifth string.
rows.translation: Bum, di, ti: ti je vždy palec na krátkej piatej strune.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Everything in clawhammer comes back to bum-ditty. Keep the motion loose and the thumb ready, and the melody takes care of itself.
rows.translation: V technike clawhammer sa všetko vracia k rytmu bum-diti. Udržujte uvoľnený pohyb a pripravený palec a melódia príde sama.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which hand shape does clawhammer use?
rows.translation: Aký tvar má ruka pri technike clawhammer?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Hear intervals and chords, and sing back what you hear
rows.translation: Rozpoznajte intervaly a akordy a zopakujte počuté spevom
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Tell which of two notes is higher, from wide leaps down to the smallest step.
rows.translation: Rozlíšte, ktorý z dvoch tónov je vyšší, od veľkých skokov až po najmenší krok.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Pitch is how high or low a note sounds. On a keyboard, low notes sit on the left and high notes on the right. Your ear already knows the difference; here you sharpen it.
rows.translation: Výška tónu určuje, ako vysoko alebo hlboko znie. Na klaviatúre sú hlboké tóny vľavo a vysoké vpravo. Váš sluch už rozdiel pozná; tu ho zdokonalíte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: When the second note is higher, the melody moves up. When it's lower, it moves down. Trace the direction in the air with your hand as you listen.
rows.translation: Keď je druhý tón vyšší, melódia stúpa. Keď je nižší, klesá. Pri počúvaní naznačte smer rukou vo vzduchu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Does the second note go up or down?
rows.translation: Ide druhý tón nahor alebo nadol?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The closer two notes are, the harder they are to tell apart. Let each note finish before you answer. Every answer, right or wrong, trains your ear.
rows.translation: Čím sú dva tóny bližšie, tým ťažšie ich rozlíšite. Pred odpoveďou nechajte každý tón doznieť. Každá odpoveď, správna aj nesprávna, trénuje váš sluch.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Not sure? Hum the first note, then slide your voice to the second. Feel whether your voice climbs or sinks. Your body knows the direction.
rows.translation: Nie ste si istí? Zahmkajte prvý tón a potom hlasom plynulo prejdite na druhý. Vnímajte, či hlas stúpa alebo klesá. Vaše telo pozná smer.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Many melodies move to the very next note of the scale: a small step. Steps sound smooth and close. Listen for a gentle lift or dip instead of a jump.
rows.translation: Mnohé melódie postupujú na najbližší tón stupnice: malý krok. Kroky znejú plynulo a blízko. Počúvajte jemné stúpanie či klesanie namiesto skoku.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Hold the first note in your head while the second one plays. Then compare them, like checking two heights side by side.
rows.translation: Kým znie druhý tón, držte si prvý v hlave. Potom ich porovnajte, akoby ste vedľa seba porovnávali dve výšky.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The smallest step in most music is the half step, also called a semitone: from one key on a keyboard to the very next. It's a tiny move, and you can learn to hear it.
rows.translation: Najmenší krok vo väčšine hudby je poltón: od jedného klávesu k bezprostredne susednému. Je to drobný pohyb a môžete sa ho naučiť počuť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: With tiny steps, your first impression is usually right. Answer, and don't talk yourself out of it.
rows.translation: Pri drobných krokoch býva prvý dojem správny. Odpovedzte a nenechajte sa premôcť pochybnosťami.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Wide leaps, small steps and half steps, high and low, all mixed together. Take a breath before each one.
rows.translation: Veľké skoky, malé kroky a poltóny, vysoko aj hlboko, všetko pomiešané. Pred každým sa nadýchnite.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Hear when two notes match, then match a note with your voice or instrument.
rows.translation: Rozpoznajte, kedy sa dva tóny zhodujú, a potom zopakujte tón hlasom alebo nástrojom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Two notes match when they have exactly the same pitch. Listen for whether the second note lands right on the first or slips away from it.
rows.translation: Dva tóny sa zhodujú, keď majú presne rovnakú výšku. Počúvajte, či druhý tón dopadne presne na prvý, alebo sa od neho odchýli.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Two voices sing exactly the same pitch. What's that called?
rows.translation: Dva hlasy spievajú presne rovnakú výšku. Ako sa to volá?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Singing in unison means singing the very same note.
rows.translation: Spievať unisono znamená spievať úplne rovnaký tón.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: To match a pitch, listen, hear the note again in your head, then sing or play it. Timbre shows whether you're high or low. Slide until you land on it.
rows.translation: Ak chcete zopakovať výšku, počúvajte, predstavte si tón znova v hlave a potom ho zaspievajte alebo zahrajte. Timbre ukáže, či ste vyššie alebo nižšie. Plynulo sa posúvajte, kým ho trafíte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Sing or play back the note you just heard.
rows.translation: Zaspievajte alebo zahrajte tón, ktorý ste práve počuli.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Sing or play back the second note you heard.
rows.translation: Zaspievajte alebo zahrajte druhý tón, ktorý ste počuli.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: If you're off, don't stop. Slide slowly up or down until the note locks in. That slide is how your ear and voice learn to agree.
rows.translation: Ak sa netrafíte, neprestávajte. Pomaly sa posúvajte nahor alebo nadol, kým tón nebude presný. Tak sa sluch a hlas učia spolupracovať.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Before you sing, replay the note silently in your head. Musicians call this audiation: hearing music that isn't sounding. It's the heart of a good ear.
rows.translation: Pred spevom si tón potichu prehrajte v hlave. Hudobníci to volajú audiácia: počuť hudbu, ktorá práve neznie. Je základom dobrého hudobného sluchu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Sing or play back the higher note.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Sing or play back the lower note.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Now match two notes in a row. Sing the first, then move to the second. Notice whether your voice climbs or drops to get there.
rows.translation: Teraz zopakujte dva tóny za sebou. Zaspievajte prvý, potom prejdite na druhý. Všimnite si, či váš hlas pri prechode stúpa alebo klesá.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Sing or play back the notes you just heard, in order.
rows.translation: Zaspievajte alebo zahrajte počuté tóny v rovnakom poradí.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Same or different, single notes and pairs. Listen all the way through before you sing, and slide until each note settles.
rows.translation: Rovnaké či odlišné, jednotlivé tóny aj dvojice. Pred spevom si vypočujte všetko a hlas posúvajte, kým každý tón presne nesadne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Hear half steps and whole steps, then the wider skip of a third.
rows.translation: Rozpoznajte poltóny a celé tóny, potom širší skok tercie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A half step moves to the very next key. A whole step skips one key, so it equals two half steps. Both sound like steps, but a whole step opens a little wider.
rows.translation: Poltón vedie k bezprostredne susednému klávesu. Celý tón jeden kláves preskočí, takže má dva poltóny. Oba znejú ako kroky, no celý tón je o niečo širší.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: How many half steps make a whole step?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A whole step skips one key, so it's two half steps.
rows.translation: Celý tón preskočí jeden kláves, takže má dva poltóny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Musicians call a step a second, because it moves to the next letter: C to D. A half step is a minor second. A whole step is a major second.
rows.translation: Hudobníci volajú krok sekundou, lebo vedie k ďalšiemu písmenu: z C na D. Poltón je malá sekunda. Celý tón je veľká sekunda.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: E up to F is a...
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: E and F have no key between them: a half step, so a minor second.
rows.translation: Medzi E a F nie je žiadny kláves: je to poltón, teda malá sekunda.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: C up to D is a...
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: C to D skips the black key between them: a whole step, so a major second.
rows.translation: C po D preskočí čierny kláves medzi nimi: je to celý tón, teda veľká sekunda.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A step moves to the next letter. A skip jumps over one, like C to E, skipping D. That gap is called a third. Skips sound more open than steps.
rows.translation: Krok vedie k ďalšiemu písmenu. Skok jedno preskočí, napríklad C po E preskočí D. Táto vzdialenosť sa volá tercia. Skoky znejú otvorenejšie než kroky.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: D up to F is a...
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: D to F jumps over E, so it's a skip: a third.
rows.translation: D po F preskočí E, takže je to skok: tercia.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A major third spans four half steps and sounds bright. A minor third spans three and sounds darker, a little wistful. Listen for the brightness.
rows.translation: Veľká tercia má štyri poltóny a znie jasne. Malá tercia má tri a znie temnejšie, trochu clivo. Počúvajte jasnosť zvuku.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: C up to E spans how many half steps?
rows.translation: Koľko poltónov je od C nahor po E?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: C, C♯, D, D♯, E: four half steps, so it's a major third.
rows.translation: C, C♯, D, D♯, E: štyri poltóny, teda veľká tercia.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Half steps, whole steps and thirds, rising and falling. Decide step or skip first, then the exact size.
rows.translation: Poltóny, celé tóny a tercie nahor aj nadol. Najprv určte krok alebo skok, potom presnú veľkosť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Unison, octave, fifth and fourth, each linked to a tune you can hum.
rows.translation: Prima, oktáva, kvinta a kvarta, každá spojená s melódiou, ktorú si môžete zahmkať.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: An interval is the distance between two notes. A unison is no distance at all: the same note twice. An octave runs from one letter to the same letter above, like C to C. It sounds like one note, only brighter.
rows.translation: Interval je vzdialenosť medzi dvoma tónmi. Pri prime nie je žiadna: je to dvakrát rovnaký tón. Oktáva vedie od jedného písmena k rovnakému vyššie, napríklad C po C. Znie ako jeden tón, iba jasnejšie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Jingle Bells opens on one note repeated: a unison. Take Me Out to the Ball Game opens with a leap up an octave. Hum each opening to recall the sound.
rows.translation: Rolničky začínajú opakovaním jedného tónu: primou. Take Me Out to the Ball Game začína skokom o oktávu nahor. Zahmkajte si oba začiatky, aby ste si vybavili ich zvuk.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Why is it called an octave?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C: eight letter names, counting both ends.
rows.translation: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C: osem písmen tónov, ak počítame oba krajné tóny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A perfect fifth spans seven half steps, like C up to G. It sounds open and strong. Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star leaps up a fifth after its first two notes.
rows.translation: Čistá kvinta má sedem poltónov, napríklad C nahor po G. Znie otvorene a pevne. Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star po prvých dvoch tónoch skočí o kvintu nahor.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: What's a perfect fifth above D?
rows.translation: Ktorý tón je čistú kvintu nad D?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Count five letters: D, E, F, G, A. D to A spans seven half steps.
rows.translation: Počítajte päť písmen vrátane krajných: D, E, F, G, A. Od D po A je sedem poltónov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A perfect fourth spans five half steps, like C up to F. It sounds like a call to attention. Amazing Grace opens with a rising fourth.
rows.translation: Čistá kvarta má päť poltónov, napríklad C nahor po F. Znie ako výzva k pozornosti. Amazing Grace začína stúpajúcou kvartou.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Both sound open. The fifth is wider and feels settled. The fourth feels like it wants to move on. If you're unsure, hum the tune for each.
rows.translation: Obe znejú otvorene. Kvinta je širšia a pôsobí ustálene. Kvarta akoby chcela pokračovať. Ak si nie ste istí, zahmkajte si melódiu pre každú z nich.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A fifth spans seven half steps; a fourth spans five.
rows.translation: Kvinta má sedem poltónov; kvarta päť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: An interval keeps its name whether it rises or falls. G down to C is still a fifth. Listen to the size of the gap, not the direction.
rows.translation: Interval si zachováva názov, či stúpa alebo klesá. G nadol po C je stále kvinta. Počúvajte veľkosť vzdialenosti, nie smer.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: When two notes sound together, listen to the blend. An octave melts into one sound. A fifth sounds hollow and strong. A fourth sounds open but restless.
rows.translation: Keď dva tóny znejú súčasne, počúvajte ich súzvuk. Oktáva splýva do jedného zvuku. Kvinta znie duto a pevne. Kvarta znie otvorene, no nepokojne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Sing or play a falling fifth: G down to C.
rows.translation: Zaspievajte alebo zahrajte klesajúcu kvintu: G nadol po C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Unison, octave, fifth and fourth, rising, falling and together. If you get stuck, hum the tune for each.
rows.translation: Prima, oktáva, kvinta a kvarta nahor, nadol aj súčasne. Ak sa zaseknete, zahmkajte si melódiu pre každú z nich.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Thirds, sixths and seconds in their major and minor sizes.
rows.translation: Tercie, sexty a sekundy vo veľkej aj malej podobe.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: When the Saints Go Marching In opens with a major third, bright and bold. Greensleeves opens with a minor third, softer and sadder. Hum both to fix the sounds.
rows.translation: When the Saints Go Marching In začína veľkou terciou, jasnou a smelou. Greensleeves začína malou terciou, jemnejšou a smutnejšou. Zahmkajte obe, aby ste si ich zvuk upevnili.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: How many half steps are in a minor third?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A minor third spans three half steps, like A to C. A major third spans four.
rows.translation: Malá tercia má tri poltóny, napríklad A po C. Veľká tercia má štyri.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A major sixth spans nine half steps; My Bonnie Lies Over the Ocean opens with one. A minor sixth spans eight and sounds darker. The Entertainer leaps up one right after its quick opening notes.
rows.translation: Veľká sexta má deväť poltónov; začína ňou My Bonnie Lies Over the Ocean. Malá sexta má osem a znie temnejšie. The Entertainer o ňu skočí nahor hneď po rýchlych úvodných tónoch.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: C up to A is which interval?
rows.translation: Aký interval je C nahor po A?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: C to A spans nine half steps: a major sixth.
rows.translation: Od C po A je deväť poltónov: veľká sexta.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Frère Jacques opens with a major second, a whole step up. Für Elise opens by rocking down and up a minor second, a half step. Small sizes, big difference.
rows.translation: Bratku Jakub začína veľkou sekundou, celým tónom nahor. Pre Elišku začína kolísaním o malú sekundu nadol a nahor, teda o poltón. Malé vzdialenosti, veľký rozdiel.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which interval is a half step?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A minor second is one half step. A major second is two.
rows.translation: Malá sekunda má jeden poltón. Veľká sekunda dva.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Sing or play the rocking half step: E, D♯, E.
rows.translation: Zaspievajte alebo zahrajte kolísanie o poltón: E, D♯, E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: First judge the size: a step, a skip or a wide leap. Then judge the color: bright for major, darker for minor. Two easy choices beat one hard guess.
rows.translation: Najprv odhadnite veľkosť: krok, malý skok alebo veľký skok. Potom farbu: jasnú pri veľkom intervale, temnejšiu pri malom. Dve ľahké voľby sú lepšie než jeden ťažký odhad.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Minor intervals sound darker than their major partners.
rows.translation: Malé intervaly znejú temnejšie než ich veľké náprotivky.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Seconds, thirds and sixths, major and minor, mixed with the fourths and fifths you already know.
rows.translation: Sekundy, tercie a sexty, veľké aj malé, zmiešané s kvartami a kvintami, ktoré už poznáte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Hear major and minor chords, then diminished, augmented and dominant seventh.
rows.translation: Rozpoznajte durové a molové akordy, potom zmenšené, zväčšené a dominantné septakordy.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A chord is three or more notes sounding together. A major chord sounds bright and settled. A minor chord sounds darker. Only the middle note differs between them.
rows.translation: Akord sú tri alebo viac tónov znejúcich súčasne. Durový akord znie jasne a ustálene. Molový akord znie temnejšie. Líšia sa iba prostredným tónom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A major chord turns minor. How many of its notes change?
rows.translation: Durový akord sa zmení na molový. Koľko jeho tónov sa zmení?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Only the middle note, the third, drops a half step: C E G becomes C E♭ G.
rows.translation: Iba prostredný tón, tercia, klesne o poltón: z C E G sa stane C E♭ G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Sing or play back the chord's notes, low to high.
rows.translation: Zaspievajte alebo zahrajte tóny akordu od najnižšieho po najvyšší.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Unsure? Focus on the middle note. In a major chord it sits four half steps above the bottom. In minor it sits one half step lower, which darkens everything.
rows.translation: Nie ste si istí? Sústreďte sa na prostredný tón. V durovom akorde je štyri poltóny nad spodným. V molovom je o poltón nižšie, čo celý zvuk zatemní.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which notes spell a C minor chord?
rows.translation: Ktoré tóny tvoria akord C mol?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Lower the middle note of C major by a half step: E becomes E♭.
rows.translation: Znížte prostredný tón akordu C dur o poltón: E sa zmení na E♭.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A diminished chord stacks two minor thirds and sounds tight and uneasy. An augmented chord stacks two major thirds and sounds stretched, like a question left hanging.
rows.translation: Zmenšený akord skladá dve malé tercie nad seba a znie stiesnene a nepokojne. Zväčšený akord skladá dve veľké tercie a znie roztiahnuto, ako nezodpovedaná otázka.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which kind of chord is this?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which chord stacks two major thirds?
rows.translation: Ktorý akord skladá dve veľké tercie nad seba?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A major third plus a major third, like C E G♯, makes an augmented chord.
rows.translation: Veľká tercia plus veľká tercia, napríklad C E G♯, tvorí zväčšený akord.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A dominant seventh chord is a major chord plus one more note on top: a minor seventh above the root, the note the chord is named for. It sounds bluesy and restless.
rows.translation: Dominantný septakord je durový akord s ďalším tónom navrchu: malou septimou nad základným tónom, podľa ktorého je akord pomenovaný. Znie bluesovo a nepokojne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: G7 is G major (G B D) plus F, a minor seventh above G.
rows.translation: G7 je G dur (G B D) s pridaným F, malou septimou nad G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Major, minor, diminished, augmented and dominant seventh: bright, dark, tight, stretched, restless. Name the color, then the chord.
rows.translation: Durový, molový, zmenšený, zväčšený a dominantný septakord: jasný, temný, stiesnený, roztiahnutý, nepokojný. Pomenujte farbu, potom akord.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Hear each note's place in a key, from do, the home note, to ti.
rows.translation: Rozpoznajte miesto každého tónu v tónine, od do, základného tónu, po ti.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Every key has a home note called the tonic. Singers call it do. Here you'll hear a chord that sets the key, then a single note to place.
rows.translation: Každá tónina má základný tón zvaný tonika. Speváci ho volajú do. Tu zaznie akord, ktorý určí tóninu, a potom jeden tón, ktorého stupeň určíte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Is the last note do, the home note?
rows.translation: Je posledný tón do, základný tón?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The notes of a major scale are do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, then do again. Each is a scale degree, numbered from do: do is 1, re is 2, up to ti, 7.
rows.translation: Tóny durovej stupnice sú do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti a znova do. Každý je stupňom stupnice číslovaným od do: do je 1, re je 2 až po ti, 7.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which scale degree is the last note?
rows.translation: Ktorý stupeň stupnice je posledný tón?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Sing or play do, re, mi in C major: C, D, E.
rows.translation: Zaspievajte alebo zahrajte do, re, mi v C dur: C, D, E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Do, mi and sol are the notes of the home chord, so they sound stable and at rest. Mi sounds sweet, sol sounds strong and open, and do sounds finished.
rows.translation: Do, mi a sol sú tóny tonického akordu, preto znejú stabilne a pokojne. Mi znie ľúbezne, sol pevne a otvorene a do uzavreto.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In C major, which note is sol?
rows.translation: Ktorý tón je sol v C dur?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Count up from do: C do, D re, E mi, F fa, G sol.
rows.translation: Počítajte nahor od do: C do, D re, E mi, F fa, G sol.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Sing or play do, mi, sol in G major: G, B, D.
rows.translation: Zaspievajte alebo zahrajte do, mi, sol v G dur: G, B, D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Re, fa, la and ti sound unfinished. Ti sits a half step below do and pulls hard upward. Fa leans down to mi. Re and la want to step to a neighbor.
rows.translation: Re, fa, la a ti znejú nedokončene. Ti je poltón pod do a silno k nemu smeruje nahor. Fa smeruje nadol k mi. Re a la chcú prejsť k susednému tónu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which note pulls most strongly up to do?
rows.translation: Ktorý tón najsilnejšie smeruje nahor k do?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Ti sits just a half step below do, so it leans hard toward it.
rows.translation: Ti je iba poltón pod do, preto k nemu silno smeruje.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Sing or play ti rising to do in C major: B, then C.
rows.translation: Zaspievajte alebo zahrajte ti stúpajúce k do v C dur: B, potom C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Set the key with a cadence
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A cadence is a short chord pattern that ends a phrase. Hearing one sets the key firmly. Sing do quietly to yourself, then measure the new note from there.
rows.translation: Kadencia je krátky akordový sled, ktorý ukončuje frázu. Jej zvuk pevne určí tóninu. Potichu si zaspievajte do a od neho odhadnite nový tón.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Why play a cadence before the note?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The chords point to do, so you can hear every other note in relation to it.
rows.translation: Akordy ukazujú na do, takže každý ďalší tón môžete počuť vo vzťahu k nemu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Sing or play up the scale from do in C major: C, D, E, F, G.
rows.translation: Zaspievajte alebo zahrajte stupnicu nahor od do v C dur: C, D, E, F, G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Chords set the key, then one note plays. Find do first, then name the note. Every key works the same way.
rows.translation: Akordy určia tóninu a potom zaznie jeden tón. Najprv nájdite do a potom tón pomenujte. Každá tónina funguje rovnako.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Sing or play do, ti, do in D major: D, C♯, D.
rows.translation: Zaspievajte alebo zahrajte do, ti, do v D dur: D, C♯, D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Hear short melodies, pick out the one you heard, and sing it back.
rows.translation: Počúvajte krátke melódie, vyberte tú, ktorú ste počuli, a zaspievajte ju späť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Dictation means hearing a melody and writing it down. Here you pick it from a list. Find do from the chord, then follow each move: up or down, step or skip.
rows.translation: Diktát znamená vypočuť si melódiu a zapísať ju. Tu ju vyberáte zo zoznamu. Nájdite do podľa akordu a sledujte každý pohyb: nahor či nadol, krok či skok.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Before naming notes, trace the shape with your hand: up, down or bending. Most wrong answers have the wrong shape, so you can rule them out fast.
rows.translation: Pred pomenovaním tónov naznačte tvar rukou: nahor, nadol alebo s obratom. Väčšina nesprávnych odpovedí má nesprávny tvar, takže ich môžete rýchlo vylúčiť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Steps sound smooth; skips jump out. When you hear a jump, check whether it lands on a note of the home chord: do, mi or sol.
rows.translation: Kroky znejú plynulo; skoky vyniknú. Keď počujete skok, zistite, či dopadne na tón tonického akordu: do, mi alebo sol.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A melody goes do, mi, sol. How does it move?
rows.translation: Melódia ide do, mi, sol. Ako sa pohybuje?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Do to mi skips re, and mi to sol skips fa.
rows.translation: Do po mi preskočí re a mi po sol preskočí fa.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Longer melodies use the same tools. Lock in the first note against do, then take the rest one move at a time.
rows.translation: Pri dlhších melódiách používate rovnaké postupy. Určte prvý tón vo vzťahu k do a zvyšok sledujte po jednom pohybe.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A melody stops on ti. How does it sound?
rows.translation: Melódia sa zastaví na ti. Ako znie?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Ti leans up to do, so a melody that stops on ti feels like it's waiting.
rows.translation: Ti smeruje nahor k do, takže melódia končiaca na ti pôsobí, akoby čakala.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Melodies often dip under do to ti, la or sol below. They're the same notes, just lower. Many tunes start on sol below and leap up to do.
rows.translation: Melódie často klesnú pod do na nižšie ti, la alebo sol. Sú to rovnaké tóny, iba nižšie. Mnohé melódie začínajú na nižšom sol a skáču nahor k do.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Amazing Grace starts on sol below do and leaps up. To which note?
rows.translation: Amazing Grace začína na sol pod do a skočí nahor. Na ktorý tón?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Sol up to do is a perfect fourth, the interval you learned with this tune.
rows.translation: Sol nahor po do je čistá kvarta, interval, ktorý ste sa naučili s touto melódiou.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Hear it, find it, sing it
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Chords first, then the melody. Find do, trace the shape, name each note, then sing or play it back.
rows.translation: Najprv akordy, potom melódia. Nájdite do, sledujte tvar, pomenujte každý tón a potom ich zaspievajte alebo zahrajte späť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: How music works, from note names to the chords behind songs
rows.translation: Ako funguje hudba, od názvov tónov po akordy v piesňach
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Seven letters, repeating octaves, and where every note lives on a keyboard.
rows.translation: Sedem písmen, opakujúce sa oktávy a miesto každého tónu na klaviatúre.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Music names its notes with just seven letters: A, B, C, D, E, F, G. After G the alphabet starts again at A, a little higher each time around.
rows.translation: V tejto výučbe označujeme tóny siedmimi písmenami: A, B, C, D, E, F, G. Po G začína abeceda znova od A, pri každom opakovaní o niečo vyššie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The musical alphabet stops at G and starts again at A.
rows.translation: Hudobná abeceda tu končí na G a začína znova od A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which letter comes just before C?
rows.translation: Ktoré písmeno je tesne pred C?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Going down, the alphabet runs C, B, A, then G.
rows.translation: Smerom nadol ide abeceda C, B, A a potom G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Moving forward through the letters, A to B to C, the notes go up. Moving backward, they go down. The letters loop like the hours on a clock.
rows.translation: Keď postupujete písmenami dopredu, z A na B na C, tóny stúpajú. Pri postupe dozadu klesajú. Písmená sa opakujú ako hodiny na ciferníku.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: What are the next two letters after F?
rows.translation: Ktoré dve písmená nasledujú po F?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: F, G, then back around to A.
rows.translation: F, G a potom znova A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Backward through the alphabet means lower notes: E, D, C, B.
rows.translation: Dozadu po abecede znamená k nižším tónom: E, D, C, B.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Play or sing C, D, E, climbing up the alphabet.
rows.translation: Zahrajte alebo zaspievajte C, D, E, stúpajúc po abecede.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Notes that share a letter sound alike even when one is higher. The distance from one C to the next C is an octave. The higher note vibrates exactly twice as fast.
rows.translation: Tóny s rovnakým písmenom znejú podobne, aj keď je jeden vyšší. Vzdialenosť od jedného C po ďalšie C je oktáva. Vyšší tón kmitá presne dvakrát rýchlejšie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Do these two notes share a letter name?
rows.translation: Majú tieto dva tóny rovnaké písmeno?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A4 vibrates 440 times a second. How fast does A5 vibrate?
rows.translation: A4 kmitá 440-krát za sekundu. Ako rýchlo kmitá A5?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: An octave up doubles the vibration: 440 becomes 880.
rows.translation: Oktáva nahor zdvojnásobí počet kmitov: zo 440 sa stane 880.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Notes carry a number that tells you which octave they're in. Middle C, near the center of a piano, is C4. The number goes up by one at every C.
rows.translation: Tóny majú číslo, ktoré určuje ich oktávu. Stredné C blízko stredu klavíra je C4. Pri každom C sa číslo zvýši o jeden.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which note is just above B3?
rows.translation: Ktorý tón je tesne nad B3?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Octave numbers change at C, so the next note up from B3 is C4.
rows.translation: Čísla oktáv sa menia pri C, takže najbližší tón nad B3 je C4.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Play or sing middle C, then the C an octave higher.
rows.translation: Zahrajte alebo zaspievajte stredné C a potom C o oktávu vyššie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A keyboard's black keys come in groups of two and three. They're your map. C is the white key just left of each group of two.
rows.translation: Čierne klávesy tvoria skupiny po dvoch a troch. Sú vašou mapou. C je biely kláves tesne vľavo od každej dvojice čiernych klávesov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: C sits just left of the group of two black keys.
rows.translation: C je tesne vľavo od dvojice čiernych klávesov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: F and the group of three
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: F is the white key just left of each group of three black keys. Find C and F first, and every other white key is a short count away.
rows.translation: F je biely kláves tesne vľavo od každej trojice čiernych klávesov. Najprv nájdite C a F a ku každému ďalšiemu bielemu klávesu stačí krátko počítať.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: F sits just left of the group of three black keys.
rows.translation: F je tesne vľavo od trojice čiernych klávesov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: D sits between the two black keys of the pair.
rows.translation: D je medzi dvoma čiernymi klávesmi v dvojici.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: B is the white key just right of the group of three black keys.
rows.translation: B je biely kláves tesne vpravo od trojice čiernych klávesov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Play or sing F, G, A, starting from the F you just found.
rows.translation: Zahrajte alebo zaspievajte F, G, A od F, ktoré ste práve našli.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: From C, the white keys run C, D, E, F, G, A, B, then C again. Seven white keys hold one of each letter.
rows.translation: Od C idú biele klávesy C, D, E, F, G, A, B a znova C. Sedem bielych klávesov má po jednom z každého písmena.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: G sits between the first two black keys of the group of three.
rows.translation: G je medzi prvými dvoma čiernymi klávesmi v trojici.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: E is the white key just right of the group of two black keys.
rows.translation: E je biely kláves tesne vpravo od dvojice čiernych klávesov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A sits between the last two black keys of the group of three.
rows.translation: A je medzi poslednými dvoma čiernymi klávesmi v trojici.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: How many white keys run from one C up to the next B?
rows.translation: Koľko bielych klávesov je od C nahor po najbližšie B?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: C, D, E, F, G, A, B: seven letters, seven white keys.
rows.translation: C, D, E, F, G, A, B: sedem písmen, sedem bielych klávesov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Play or sing up the white keys from middle C to the next C.
rows.translation: Zahrajte alebo zaspievajte nahor po bielych klávesoch od stredného C po ďalšie C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The alphabet, octaves and the keyboard map, all together. Use the black-key groups to find your way.
rows.translation: Abeceda, oktávy a mapa klaviatúry spolu. Orientujte sa podľa skupín čiernych klávesov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which two letters come right after E?
rows.translation: Ktoré dve písmená nasledujú hneď po E?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: E, F, G: forward through the alphabet.
rows.translation: E, F, G: dopredu po abecede.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Middle C is C4. What's the C an octave above it?
rows.translation: Stredné C je C4. Aké označenie má C o oktávu vyššie?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Each octave up adds one to the number.
rows.translation: Každá oktáva nahor pridá k číslu jeden.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Play or sing G, A, B, C. The alphabet wraps from G back to A.
rows.translation: Zahrajte alebo zaspievajte G, A, B, C. Abeceda sa z G vracia na A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The black keys, the smallest step, and notes with two names.
rows.translation: Čierne klávesy, najmenší krok a tóny s dvoma názvami.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A half step moves from one key to the very next, black or white, with nothing in between. It's the smallest distance on a keyboard and in most music.
rows.translation: Poltón vedie od jedného klávesu k bezprostredne susednému, čiernemu či bielemu, bez iného klávesu medzi nimi. Je to najmenšia vzdialenosť na klaviatúre a vo väčšine hudby.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: What is a half step above E?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: E and F have no black key between them.
rows.translation: Medzi E a F nie je čierny kláves.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Look for the gaps with no black key: E to F and B to C. These white keys sit right next to each other, so they're only a half step apart.
rows.translation: Nájdite miesta bez čierneho klávesu: E po F a B po C. Tieto biele klávesy sú tesne vedľa seba, preto ich delí iba poltón.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which pair of white keys is a half step apart?
rows.translation: Ktorú dvojicu bielych klávesov delí poltón?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: B and C have no black key between them.
rows.translation: Medzi B a C nie je čierny kláves.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: How many half steps from C up to E?
rows.translation: Koľko poltónov je od C nahor po E?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: C, C♯, D, D♯, E: four moves of one key each.
rows.translation: C, C♯, D, D♯, E: štyri posuny, každý o jeden kláves.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Play or sing the two white-key half steps: E to F, then B to C.
rows.translation: Zahrajte alebo zaspievajte dva poltóny na bielych klávesoch: E po F, potom B po C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A sharp (♯) raises a note by a half step. A flat (♭) lowers it by a half step. The black key just above C is C♯; the one just below D is D♭.
rows.translation: Krížik (♯) zvyšuje tón o poltón. Béčko (♭) ho znižuje o poltón. Čierny kláves tesne nad C je C♯; ten tesne pod D je D♭.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: What does a sharp do to a note?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: This black key sits just above F. What's its sharp name?
rows.translation: Tento čierny kláves je tesne nad F. Aký má názov s krížikom?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Raise F by a half step and you get F♯.
rows.translation: Zvýšte F o poltón a dostanete F♯.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The same key sits just below G. What's its flat name?
rows.translation: Ten istý kláves je tesne pod G. Aký má názov s béčkom?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Lower G by a half step and you get G♭.
rows.translation: Znížte G o poltón a dostanete G♭.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Each black key can be named from the white key below it, with a sharp, or the white key above it, with a flat. C♯ and D♭ are the same key.
rows.translation: Každý čierny kláves možno pomenovať podľa nižšieho bieleho s krížikom alebo podľa vyššieho bieleho s béčkom. C♯ a D♭ sú ten istý kláves.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: What is a half step below B?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Lower B by a half step and you get B♭.
rows.translation: Znížte B o poltón a dostanete B♭.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: It's the right-hand key of the pair, just above D: D♯.
rows.translation: Je to pravý kláves z dvojice, tesne nad D: D♯.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Play or sing C, C♯, D: two half steps up.
rows.translation: Zahrajte alebo zaspievajte C, C♯, D: dva poltóny nahor.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A whole step equals two half steps: it skips exactly one key. C to D is a whole step, with C♯ in between. E to F♯ is too.
rows.translation: Celý tón sa rovná dvom poltónom: preskočí presne jeden kláves. C po D je celý tón s C♯ medzi nimi. Aj E po F♯.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: What is a whole step above C?
rows.translation: Čo je celý tón nad C?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: C to D skips one key, C♯.
rows.translation: C po D preskočí jeden kláves, C♯.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: What is a whole step above E?
rows.translation: Čo je celý tón nad E?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: E to F is only a half step, so a whole step up is F♯.
rows.translation: E po F je iba poltón, takže celý tón nahor je F♯.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: What is a whole step above B?
rows.translation: Čo je celý tón nad B?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: B to C is a half step, so a whole step up is C♯.
rows.translation: B po C je poltón, takže celý tón nahor je C♯.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: What is a whole step below F?
rows.translation: Čo je celý tón pod F?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: F down to E is a half step; one more key down is E♭.
rows.translation: F nadol po E je poltón; o ďalší kláves nižšie je E♭.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Play or sing two whole steps up from E: E, F♯, G♯.
rows.translation: Zahrajte alebo zaspievajte dva celé tóny nahor od E: E, F♯, G♯.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Two names for the same pitch are called enharmonic. C♯ and D♭ are one key with two names. Which name you use depends on the key you're in.
rows.translation: Dva názvy tej istej výšky sa nazývajú enharmonické. C♯ a D♭ sú jeden kláves s dvoma názvami. Použitý názov závisí od tóniny, v ktorej hráte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which pair names the same key?
rows.translation: Ktorá dvojica označuje ten istý kláves?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: C♯ is a half step above C; D♭ is a half step below D. Same key.
rows.translation: C♯ je poltón nad C; D♭ je poltón pod D. Ten istý kláves.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.translation: Aký je iný názov pre G♯?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: G♯ and A♭ are the same black key.
rows.translation: G♯ a A♭ sú ten istý čierny kláves.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: White keys can have sharp or flat names as well. E and F are a half step apart, so E♯ is the same key as F, and F♭ is the same key as E.
rows.translation: Aj biele klávesy môžu mať názvy s krížikom či béčkom. E a F delí poltón, takže E♯ je ten istý kláves ako F a F♭ je ten istý kláves ako E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: E♯ is played on which key?
rows.translation: Na ktorom klávese sa hrá E♯?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: E♯ is a half step above E, which is F.
rows.translation: E♯ je poltón nad E, teda F.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.translation: Aký je iný názov pre C?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: B♯ is a half step above B, which is C.
rows.translation: B♯ je poltón nad B, teda C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The black key between F and G is F♯. What's its other name?
rows.translation: Čierny kláves medzi F a G je F♯. Aký je jeho druhý názov?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Play or sing B♭, C, D. B♭ is the same key as A♯.
rows.translation: Zahrajte alebo zaspievajte B♭, C, D. B♭ je ten istý kláves ako A♯.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Half steps, whole steps, sharps, flats and two-name notes, all mixed together. Picture the keyboard as you answer.
rows.translation: Poltóny, celé tóny, krížiky, béčka a tóny s dvoma názvami, všetko pomiešané. Pri odpovedi si predstavujte klaviatúru.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: What is a half step above B?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: What is a whole step above A?
rows.translation: Čo je celý tón nad A?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A to B skips one key, A♯.
rows.translation: A po B preskočí jeden kláves, A♯.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.translation: Aký je iný názov pre E♭?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: E♭ and D♯ are the same black key.
rows.translation: E♭ a D♯ sú ten istý čierny kláves.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: It's the top key of the group of three, just below B: A♯, also called B♭.
rows.translation: Je to najvyšší kláves v trojici, tesne pod B: A♯, nazývaný aj B♭.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: What is a whole step below D?
rows.translation: Čo je celý tón pod D?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: D to C skips one key, C♯.
rows.translation: D po C preskočí jeden kláves, C♯.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Play or sing D, E, F♯, G: whole, whole, then half.
rows.translation: Zahrajte alebo zaspievajte D, E, F♯, G: celý tón, celý tón, potom poltón.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Treble clef lines and spaces, ledger lines, and a first look at bass clef.
rows.translation: Čiary a medzery husľového kľúča, pomocné čiary a prvý pohľad na basový kľúč.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Music is written on a staff: five lines with four spaces between them. Notes sit on a line or in a space. The higher a note sits, the higher it sounds.
rows.translation: Hudba sa zapisuje do notovej osnovy: päť čiar so štyrmi medzerami. Noty ležia na čiare alebo v medzere. Čím vyššie je nota, tým vyššie znie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: How many lines does a staff have?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Five lines, with four spaces between them.
rows.translation: Päť čiar so štyrmi medzerami medzi nimi.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: It sits higher on the staff, so it sounds higher.
rows.translation: V notovej osnove je vyššie, preto aj znie vyššie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Moving up one letter moves from a line to the next space, or from a space to the next line. Notes on neighboring lines are two letters apart.
rows.translation: Posun o jedno písmeno nahor vedie z čiary do ďalšej medzery alebo z medzery na ďalšiu čiaru. Tóny na susedných čiarach delia dva kroky po písmenách.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A note on a line moves up one letter. Where does it land?
rows.translation: Nota na čiare sa posunie o jedno písmeno nahor. Kam sa dostane?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Letters alternate: line, space, line, space.
rows.translation: Písmená sa striedajú: čiara, medzera, čiara, medzera.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The treble clef, or G clef, curls around the second line from the bottom. That line is the G above middle C. Higher instruments and voices read it.
rows.translation: Husľový kľúč čiže G kľúč sa stáča okolo druhej čiary zdola. Tá označuje G nad stredným C. Čítajú ho vyššie nástroje a hlasy.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which note is on the second line of the treble staff?
rows.translation: Ktorý tón je na druhej čiare v husľovom kľúči?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The treble clef curls around that line to mark G.
rows.translation: Husľový kľúč sa stáča okolo tejto čiary a označuje G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: From bottom to top, the treble staff's lines are E, G, B, D, F. Remember them as Every Good Boy Does Fine.
rows.translation: Čiary v husľovom kľúči sú zdola nahor E, G, B, D, F. Zapamätajte si ich podľa začiatočných písmen: Eva griluje, Boris donesie fazuľu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The bottom line is E, the Every of Every Good Boy Does Fine.
rows.translation: Spodná čiara je E, ako Eva v pomôcke „Eva griluje, Boris donesie fazuľu“.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The middle line is B, the Boy of Every Good Boy Does Fine.
rows.translation: Stredná čiara je B, ako Boris v pomôcke „Eva griluje, Boris donesie fazuľu“.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The top line is F, the Fine of Every Good Boy Does Fine.
rows.translation: Horná čiara je F, ako fazuľu v pomôcke „Eva griluje, Boris donesie fazuľu“.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The fourth line up is D, the Does of Every Good Boy Does Fine.
rows.translation: Štvrtá čiara zdola je D, ako donesie v pomôcke „Eva griluje, Boris donesie fazuľu“.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Play or sing the bottom three lines: E, G, B.
rows.translation: Zahrajte alebo zaspievajte tóny spodných troch čiar: E, G, B.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The four spaces of the treble staff spell a word from bottom to top: F, A, C, E. The spaces spell FACE.
rows.translation: Štyri medzery v husľovom kľúči dávajú zdola nahor F, A, C, E. Tvoria anglické slovo FACE, teda „tvár“.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The bottom space is F, the first letter of FACE.
rows.translation: Spodná medzera je F, prvé písmeno slova FACE.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The third space up is C: F, A, C.
rows.translation: Tretia medzera zdola je C: F, A, C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The second space up is A: F, A.
rows.translation: Druhá medzera zdola je A: F, A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Put them together and the staff climbs E, F, G, A, B, C, D, E, F: line, space, line, space, all the way up.
