rows.translation: Spojte ich a osnova stúpa E, F, G, A, B, C, D, E, F: čiara, medzera, čiara, medzera až nahor.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The top space is E, the last letter of FACE.
rows.translation: Horná medzera je E, posledné písmeno slova FACE.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The second line up is G, where the treble clef curls.
rows.translation: Druhá čiara zdola je G, okolo ktorého sa stáča husľový kľúč.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Play or sing the spaces from bottom to top: F, A, C, E.
rows.translation: Zahrajte alebo zaspievajte tóny v medzerách zdola nahor: F, A, C, E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: When a note goes above or below the staff, short extra lines called ledger lines extend it. Middle C sits on one ledger line just below the treble staff.
rows.translation: Keď nota ide nad osnovu alebo pod ňu, osnovu rozširujú krátke pomocné čiary. Stredné C leží na prvej pomocnej čiare pod osnovou v husľovom kľúči.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: One ledger line below the treble staff is middle C.
rows.translation: Na prvej pomocnej čiare pod osnovou v husľovom kľúči je stredné C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: D hangs in the space just below the bottom line.
rows.translation: D je v medzere tesne pod spodnou čiarou.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Above the top line, the pattern keeps going. G sits just above the top line, and A sits on the first ledger line above.
rows.translation: Nad hornou čiarou vzor pokračuje. G je tesne nad hornou čiarou a A na prvej pomocnej čiare nad osnovou.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: One ledger line above the treble staff is A.
rows.translation: Na prvej pomocnej čiare nad osnovou v husľovom kľúči je A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Count down: middle C on the first ledger line, B below it, A on the second ledger line.
rows.translation: Počítajte nadol: stredné C na prvej pomocnej čiare, B pod ním, A na druhej pomocnej čiare.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Play or sing middle C, then D and E, climbing from the ledger line onto the staff.
rows.translation: Zahrajte alebo zaspievajte stredné C, potom D a E, stúpajúc z pomocnej čiary do osnovy.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Low instruments and voices read the bass clef, or F clef. Its two dots surround the fourth line up, marking the F below middle C.
rows.translation: Hlboké nástroje a hlasy čítajú basový čiže F kľúč. Jeho dve bodky obklopujú štvrtú čiaru zdola, ktorá označuje F pod stredným C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which note do the bass clef's dots mark?
rows.translation: Ktorý tón označujú bodky basového kľúča?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The bass clef is the F clef: its dots frame the F line.
rows.translation: Basový kľúč je F kľúč: jeho bodky obklopujú čiaru F.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The bass staff's lines, bottom to top, are G, B, D, F, A: Good Boys Do Fine Always. The spaces are A, C, E, G: All Cows Eat Grass.
rows.translation: Čiary v basovom kľúči sú zdola nahor G, B, D, F, A: Gorila bude dnes fotiť ananás. Medzery sú A, C, E, G: Adam cíti egrešový guláš.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The bottom line of the bass staff is G, the Good of Good Boys Do Fine Always.
rows.translation: Spodná čiara v basovom kľúči je G, ako Gorila v pomôcke „Gorila bude dnes fotiť ananás“.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The second space up is C: All Cows.
rows.translation: Druhá medzera zdola je C, ako cíti v pomôcke „Adam cíti egrešový guláš“.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The top line of the bass staff is A, the Always of Good Boys Do Fine Always.
rows.translation: Horná čiara v basovom kľúči je A, ako ananás v pomôcke „Gorila bude dnes fotiť ananás“.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Where is middle C in bass clef?
rows.translation: Kde je stredné C v basovom kľúči?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: On a ledger line above the staff
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Middle C sits one ledger line above the bass staff, and one below the treble staff.
rows.translation: Stredné C je na prvej pomocnej čiare nad osnovou v basovom kľúči a na prvej pod osnovou v husľovom kľúči.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Play or sing the bass clef spaces: A, C, E, G.
rows.translation: Zahrajte alebo zaspievajte tóny v medzerách basového kľúča: A, C, E, G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Lines, spaces, ledger lines and both clefs. Use your memory sentences, then try to recognize each note at a glance.
rows.translation: Čiary, medzery, pomocné čiary a oba kľúče. Použite pamäťové vety a potom skúste rozpoznať každú notu na prvý pohľad.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The third space up in bass clef is E: All Cows Eat.
rows.translation: Tretia medzera zdola v basovom kľúči je E, ako egrešový v pomôcke „Adam cíti egrešový guláš“.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Play or sing middle C, then E, G, and the C in the third space.
rows.translation: Zahrajte alebo zaspievajte stredné C, potom E, G a C v tretej medzere.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Note values from whole to sixteenth, dots and rests, and the meters 4/4, 3/4 and 6/8.
rows.translation: Hodnoty nôt od celých po šestnástinové, bodky a pomlčky a takty 4/4, 3/4 a 6/8.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The beat is the steady pulse you tap your foot to. Beats are grouped into bars, also called measures. In most music, each bar holds four beats.
rows.translation: Doba je pravidelný pulz, do ktorého si podupkávate nohou. Doby sa zoskupujú do taktov, v angličtine bar alebo measure. Vo väčšine hudby má každý takt štyri doby.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Count each bar out loud: 1, 2, 3, 4. Beat 1, the downbeat, usually feels strongest. Lean into it a little.
rows.translation: Každý takt počítajte nahlas: 1, 2, 3, 4. Doba 1, ťažká doba, zvyčajne pôsobí najsilnejšie. Mierne ju zdôraznite.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: What's another word for a bar?
rows.translation: Čo označuje anglické slovo „bar“ v hudbe?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Bar and measure mean the same thing.
rows.translation: Anglické označenia „bar“ a „measure“ znamenajú to isté: takt.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Beat 1, the downbeat, starts each bar.
rows.translation: Doba 1, ťažká doba, začína každý takt.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A note's shape tells you how long it lasts. In a four-beat bar, a whole note lasts all four beats, a half note two, and a quarter note one.
rows.translation: Tvar noty určuje jej trvanie. V štvordobom takte trvá celá nota všetky štyri doby, polová dve a štvrťová jednu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: How many beats does a half note last?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Two half notes fill a four-beat bar.
rows.translation: Dve polové noty vyplnia štvordobý takt.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: How many quarter notes fill a bar of four beats?
rows.translation: Koľko štvrťových nôt vyplní štvordobý takt?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat, so four fill the bar.
rows.translation: Štvrťová nota trvá jednu dobu, takže štyri vyplnia takt.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A whole note lasts four beats, a half note two, a quarter note one.
rows.translation: Celá nota trvá štyri doby, polová dve, štvrťová jednu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A bar can mix values, as long as they add up. A half note plus two quarter notes fills four beats: 2 + 1 + 1.
rows.translation: V takte môžete kombinovať hodnoty, ak ich súčet sedí. Polová nota a dve štvrťové vyplnia štyri doby: 2 + 1 + 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat, so two fit in each beat. Count them 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and, saying and between the beats.
rows.translation: Osminová nota trvá pol doby, takže do každej doby sa zmestia dve. Počítajte 1 a 2 a 3 a 4 a; „a“ vyslovujte medzi dobami.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A sixteenth note lasts a quarter of a beat, so four fit in each beat. Count them 1 e and a, 2 e and a.
rows.translation: Šestnástinová nota trvá štvrtinu doby, takže do každej doby sa zmestia štyri. Počítajte 1 e a da, 2 e a da.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: How many sixteenth notes equal one quarter note?
rows.translation: Koľko šestnástinových nôt sa rovná jednej štvrťovej?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A quarter note is one beat, and four sixteenths fit in a beat.
rows.translation: Štvrťová nota je jedna doba a do doby sa zmestia štyri šestnástinové noty.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: How many eighth notes fill a bar of four beats?
rows.translation: Koľko osminových nôt vyplní štvordobý takt?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Two per beat, four beats: eight eighth notes.
rows.translation: Dve na dobu, štyri doby: osem osminových nôt.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A dot after a note adds half its value. A half note lasts two beats, so a dotted half lasts three. A dotted quarter lasts one and a half.
rows.translation: Bodka za notou pridáva polovicu jej hodnoty. Polová nota trvá dve doby, preto polová s bodkou trvá tri. Štvrťová s bodkou trvá jeden a pol doby.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Half of two is one, so the dot adds one beat: 2 + 1 = 3.
rows.translation: Polovica z dvoch je jeden, takže bodka pridá jednu dobu: 2 + 1 = 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A rest is a measured silence. Each note value has a matching rest: a quarter rest lasts one beat, a half rest two. Keep counting through them.
rows.translation: Pomlčka je odmerané ticho. Každá hodnota noty má zodpovedajúcu pomlčku: štvrťová trvá jednu dobu, polová dve. Počítajte aj počas nich.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A quarter is one beat; the dot adds half of that.
rows.translation: Štvrťová nota trvá jednu dobu; bodka pridáva polovicu z nej.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A four-beat bar has a half note and a quarter note. What fills the gap?
rows.translation: Štvordobý takt má polovú a štvrťovú notu. Čo vyplní zvyšok?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: 2 + 1 = 3, so one beat is left: a quarter rest.
rows.translation: 2 + 1 = 3, takže zostáva jedna doba: štvrťová pomlčka.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The two stacked numbers at the start of a piece are the time signature. The top number counts beats per bar. The bottom shows which note gets one beat: 4 means a quarter note.
rows.translation: Dve čísla nad sebou na začiatku skladby sú taktové označenie. Horné udáva počet dôb v takte. Dolné ukazuje, ktorá nota trvá jednu dobu: 4 znamená štvrťovú notu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In 4/4, how many quarter-note beats are in a bar?
rows.translation: Koľko štvrťových dôb je v jednom takte 4/4?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The top 4 means four beats; the bottom 4 makes each one a quarter note.
rows.translation: Horná 4 znamená štyri doby; dolná 4 určuje každej hodnotu štvrťovej noty.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In 3/4, each bar holds three quarter-note beats. Count 1, 2, 3, with the weight on 1. It's the lilt of a waltz.
rows.translation: V 3/4 má každý takt tri štvrťové doby. Počítajte 1, 2, 3 s dôrazom na 1. Je to kolísavý rytmus valčíka.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which time signature is a waltz usually in?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In 6/8, each bar holds six eighth notes in two groups of three. It feels like two big beats, each split in three: 1 2 3, 4 5 6.
rows.translation: V 6/8 má každý takt šesť osminových nôt v dvoch trojiciach. Cítime dve veľké doby, každú rozdelenú na tri: 1 2 3, 4 5 6.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Two beats, each split in three
rows.translation: Dve doby, každá delená na tri
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Three beats, each split in two
rows.translation: Tri doby, každá delená na dve
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The eighths group 1 2 3, 4 5 6, so you feel two strong pulses per bar.
rows.translation: Osminové noty sa zoskupujú 1 2 3, 4 5 6, takže v takte cítite dva silné pulzy.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In 3/4, which single note fills a whole bar?
rows.translation: Ktorá jediná nota vyplní celý takt v 3/4?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Three beats: a half note (2) plus its dot (1).
rows.translation: Tri doby: polová nota (2) a jej bodka (1).
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Note values, dots, rests and time signatures together. Count out loud as you tap; your voice keeps your hands honest.
rows.translation: Hodnoty nôt, bodky, pomlčky a taktové označenia spolu. Pri ťukaní počítajte nahlas; hlas pomáha rukám držať presný rytmus.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: How many beats does a whole note last in 4/4?
rows.translation: Koľko dôb trvá celá nota v 4/4?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: How many sixteenth notes fit in one beat?
rows.translation: Koľko šestnástinových nôt sa zmestí do jednej doby?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: What does a dot add to a note?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A bar of 3/4 has a quarter note and a quarter rest. What's missing?
rows.translation: Takt 3/4 má štvrťovú notu a štvrťovú pomlčku. Čo chýba?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: 3/4 holds three beats; 1 + 1 = 2, so one beat remains.
rows.translation: 3/4 má tri doby; 1 + 1 = 2, takže jedna doba zostáva.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: How many eighth notes are in a bar of 6/8?
rows.translation: Koľko osminových nôt je v takte 6/8?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The whole-and-half-step recipe, four major keys, and their key signatures.
rows.translation: Vzorec celých tónov a poltónov, štyri durové tóniny a ich predznamenania.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A scale is a set of notes climbing in order from a home note to the same note an octave up. C major uses only white keys: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C.
rows.translation: Stupnica je rad tónov stúpajúcich od základného tónu po rovnaký tón o oktávu vyššie. C dur používa iba biele klávesy: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: How many different letters are in a major scale?
rows.translation: Koľko rôznych písmen má durová stupnica?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Seven letters, then the first one returns an octave higher.
rows.translation: Sedem písmen a potom sa prvé vráti o oktávu vyššie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Is this scale going up or down?
rows.translation: Ide táto stupnica nahor alebo nadol?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In C major, most neighbors are a whole step apart. Only E to F and B to C are half steps. That uneven spacing gives the scale its sound.
rows.translation: V C dur delí väčšinu susedných tónov celý tón. Iba E po F a B po C sú poltóny. Toto nerovnomerné rozloženie dáva stupnici jej zvuk.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In C major, which steps are half steps?
rows.translation: Ktoré kroky sú v C dur poltóny?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: C to D and F to G
rows.translation: C po D a F po G
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: E to F and B to C
rows.translation: E po F a B po C
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: D to E and A to B
rows.translation: D po E a A po B
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: E and F, and B and C, have no black key between them.
rows.translation: Medzi E a F ani medzi B a C nie je čierny kláves.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: What's the home note of C major?
rows.translation: Aký je základný tón C dur?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The home note, called the tonic, gives the scale its name.
rows.translation: Základný tón, zvaný tonika, dáva stupnici názov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Play or sing the C major scale, up from middle C.
rows.translation: Zahrajte alebo zaspievajte stupnicu C dur nahor od stredného C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Every major scale follows one recipe of steps: whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half. Start on any note, follow it, and you build a major scale.
rows.translation: Každá durová stupnica má rovnaký vzorec krokov: celý tón, celý tón, poltón, celý tón, celý tón, celý tón, poltón. Začnite na ľubovoľnom tóne, dodržte ho a vytvoríte durovú stupnicu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which is the major scale recipe? (W = whole, H = half)
rows.translation: Ktorý vzorec tvorí durovú stupnicu? (W = celý tón, H = poltón)
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: W W H W W W H
rows.translation: W W H W W W H
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: W H W W H W W
rows.translation: W H W W H W W
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: W W W H W W H
rows.translation: W W W H W W H
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half.
rows.translation: Celý tón, celý tón, poltón, celý tón, celý tón, celý tón, poltón.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Number the scale's notes 1 to 8. Where are the half steps?
rows.translation: Očíslujte tóny stupnice od 1 po 8. Kde sú poltóny?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Whole, whole, then half from 3 to 4; whole, whole, whole, then half from 7 to 8.
rows.translation: Celý tón, celý tón a poltón z 3 na 4; celý tón, celý tón, celý tón a poltón zo 7 na 8.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Starting on G, a whole step up lands on...
rows.translation: Ak začnete na G, celý tón nahor vás privedie na…
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: G to A skips one key, G♯.
rows.translation: G po A preskočí jeden kláves, G♯.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Play or sing the first four notes of D major: whole, whole, half.
rows.translation: Zahrajte alebo zaspievajte prvé štyri tóny D dur: celý tón, celý tón, poltón.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Start on G and follow the recipe: G, A, B, C, D, E, then a whole step to F♯ and a half step home to G. G major has one sharp: F♯.
rows.translation: Začnite na G a sledujte vzorec: G, A, B, C, D, E, potom celý tón na F♯ a poltón domov na G. G dur má jeden krížik: F♯.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Why does G major need F♯ instead of F?
rows.translation: Prečo G dur potrebuje F♯ namiesto F?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: F is too low to sing
rows.translation: F je príliš nízke na spev
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: E to F is only a half step
rows.translation: E po F je iba poltón
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The recipe needs a whole step from note 6 to 7, then a half step from 7 up to G.
rows.translation: Vzorec vyžaduje celý tón od tónu 6 po 7, potom poltón od 7 nahor po G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which note is in G major?
rows.translation: Ktorý tón je v G dur?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: G major's seventh note is F♯.
rows.translation: Siedmy tón G dur je F♯.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: How many sharps are in G major?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Play or sing the G major scale. Remember the F♯.
rows.translation: Zahrajte alebo zaspievajte stupnicu G dur. Nezabudnite na F♯.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: From D, the recipe gives D, E, F♯, G, A, B, C♯, D. D major has two sharps: F♯ and C♯.
rows.translation: Od D dáva vzorec D, E, F♯, G, A, B, C♯, D. D dur má dva krížiky: F♯ a C♯.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which two sharps are in D major?
rows.translation: Ktoré dva tóny s krížikom sú v D dur?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Following the recipe from D lands on F♯ as note 3 and C♯ as note 7.
rows.translation: Ak sledujete vzorec od D, tón 3 je F♯ a tón 7 je C♯.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: From F, the recipe needs a half step from A to the fourth note, so it's B♭, not B. F major: F, G, A, B♭, C, D, E, F. One flat: B♭.
rows.translation: Od F vyžaduje vzorec poltón z A na štvrtý tón, teda B♭, nie B. F dur: F, G, A, B♭, C, D, E, F. Jedno béčko: B♭.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which note is in F major?
rows.translation: Ktorý tón je v F dur?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: F major's fourth note is B♭, a half step above A.
rows.translation: Štvrtý tón F dur je B♭, poltón nad A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which major key has two sharps?
rows.translation: Ktorá durová tónina má dva krížiky?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: D major has F♯ and C♯.
rows.translation: D dur má F♯ a C♯.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Play or sing up F major from F to C. The fourth note is B♭.
rows.translation: Zahrajte alebo zaspievajte F dur nahor od F po C. Štvrtý tón je B♭.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Rather than writing F♯ every time, music in G major puts one sharp at the start of each line. That's the key signature: it lists the notes that are always sharp or flat.
rows.translation: Namiesto zapisovania F♯ zakaždým má hudba v G dur jeden krížik na začiatku každého riadka. To je predznamenanie: určuje tóny, ktoré sú vždy zvýšené alebo znížené.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A key signature has one sharp, F♯. Which major key is it?
rows.translation: Predznamenanie má jeden krížik, F♯. Ktorá durová tónina to je?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: G major is the major key with just F♯.
rows.translation: G dur je durová tónina iba s F♯.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A key signature has one flat, B♭. Which major key is it?
rows.translation: Predznamenanie má jedno béčko, B♭. Ktorá durová tónina to je?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: F major is the major key with just B♭.
rows.translation: F dur je durová tónina iba s B♭.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Sharps always appear in the same order: F♯, C♯, G♯, and so on. The last sharp is a half step below the key's name. One sharp, F♯: G major.
rows.translation: Krížiky sú vždy v rovnakom poradí: F♯, C♯, G♯ a tak ďalej. Posledný zvýšený tón je poltón pod základným tónom tóniny. Jeden krížik, F♯: G dur.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A key signature has two sharps, F♯ and C♯. Which major key is it?
rows.translation: Predznamenanie má dva krížiky, F♯ a C♯. Ktorá durová tónina to je?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The last sharp, C♯, is a half step below D.
rows.translation: Posledný zvýšený tón, C♯, je poltón pod D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which major key has no sharps or flats?
rows.translation: Ktorá durová tónina nemá krížiky ani béčka?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: C major uses only white keys.
rows.translation: C dur používa iba biele klávesy.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The key signature shows B♭. Which Bs are played as B♭?
rows.translation: Predznamenanie uvádza B♭. Ktoré tóny B sa hrajú ako B♭?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A key signature applies to every B in every octave, unless the music marks otherwise.
rows.translation: Predznamenanie platí pre každé B v každej oktáve, ak notový zápis neurčí inak.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Play or sing D major, with its two sharps: F♯ and C♯.
rows.translation: Zahrajte alebo zaspievajte D dur s dvoma zvýšenými tónmi: F♯ a C♯.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The recipe, four keys and their signatures. When unsure, build the scale from its home note: whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half.
rows.translation: Vzorec, štyri tóniny a ich predznamenania. Ak váhate, vytvorte stupnicu od základného tónu: celý tón, celý tón, poltón, celý tón, celý tón, celý tón, poltón.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which note belongs in G major?
rows.translation: Ktorý tón patrí do G dur?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: G major's only sharp is F♯.
rows.translation: Jediný zvýšený tón v G dur je F♯.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which major key has one flat?
rows.translation: Ktorá durová tónina má jedno béčko?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: F major's one flat is B♭.
rows.translation: Jediný znížený tón v F dur je B♭.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which scale has the notes D, E, F♯, G, A, B, C♯?
rows.translation: Ktorá stupnica má tóny D, E, F♯, G, A, B, C♯?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In every major scale, which step is a half step?
rows.translation: Ktorý krok je poltónom v každej durovej stupnici?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Whole, whole, half: the first half step falls between notes 3 and 4.
rows.translation: Celý tón, celý tón, poltón: prvý poltón je medzi tónmi 3 a 4.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which key signature belongs to G major?
rows.translation: Ktoré predznamenanie patrí ku G dur?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Play or sing F major, with its B♭.
rows.translation: Zahrajte alebo zaspievajte F dur s jeho B♭.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Name the distance between two notes by number and quality, and measure it in half steps.
rows.translation: Pomenujte vzdialenosť medzi dvoma tónmi číslom a druhom intervalu a zmerajte ju v poltónoch.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: An interval's number comes from counting letter names, including both ends. C up to E counts C, D, E: three letters, so it's a third.
rows.translation: Číslo intervalu získate počítaním písmen tónov vrátane oboch krajných. Pri C nahor po E počítate C, D, E: tri písmená, teda tercia.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: C up to G is a...
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: C, D, E, F, G: five letters.
rows.translation: C, D, E, F, G: päť písmen.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: E, F, G, A: four letters.
rows.translation: E, F, G, A: štyri písmená.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Sharps and flats don't change an interval's number. C to E♭ and C to E are both thirds: C, D, E either way. They differ in size, which comes next.
rows.translation: Krížiky a béčka nemenia číslo intervalu. C po E♭ aj C po E sú tercie: v oboch prípadoch C, D, E. Líšia sa veľkosťou, ku ktorej sa dostaneme ďalej.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: F up to D is a...
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: F, G, A, B, C, D: six letters.
rows.translation: F, G, A, B, C, D: šesť písmen.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A up to E♭ is a...
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A, B, C, D, E: five letters. The flat doesn't change the count.
rows.translation: A, B, C, D, E: päť písmen. Béčko počet nemení.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: G up to the next G is a...
rows.translation: G nahor po ďalšie G je…
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: G, A, B, C, D, E, F, G: eight letters, an octave.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C, D, E, F, G: osem písmen, oktáva.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Two intervals with the same number can differ in size. To measure exactly, count half steps. C up to E is four; C up to E♭ is three.
rows.translation: Dva intervaly s rovnakým číslom sa môžu líšiť veľkosťou. Na presné meranie počítajte poltóny. C nahor po E má štyri; C nahor po E♭ tri.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: How many half steps from D up to F?
rows.translation: Koľko poltónov je od D nahor po F?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: D, D♯, E, F: three moves.
rows.translation: D, D♯, E, F: tri posuny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A third of four half steps is a major third, like C to E. A third of three is a minor third, like C to E♭ or A to C.
rows.translation: Tercia zo štyroch poltónov je veľká tercia, napríklad C po E. Tercia z troch je malá tercia, napríklad C po E♭ alebo A po C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: E up to G♯ is a...
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: E to G♯ spans four half steps.
rows.translation: Od E po G♯ sú štyri poltóny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A up to C is a...
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A to C spans three half steps.
rows.translation: Od A po C sú tri poltóny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: G up to B♭ is a...
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: G to B♭ spans three half steps.
rows.translation: Od G po B♭ sú tri poltóny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Unisons, fourths, fifths and octaves are called perfect. A perfect fourth spans five half steps, a perfect fifth seven, and an octave twelve.
rows.translation: Primy, kvarty, kvinty a oktávy sa označujú ako čisté. Čistá kvarta má päť poltónov, čistá kvinta sedem a oktáva dvanásť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: How many half steps are in a perfect fifth?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: C up to G: seven half steps.
rows.translation: C nahor po G: sedem poltónov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: C up to F is a...
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: C to F spans five half steps.
rows.translation: Od C po F je päť poltónov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Watch out for B and F
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Most white-key fifths are perfect, but B up to F spans only six half steps. It's called a diminished fifth. When in doubt, count half steps.
rows.translation: Väčšina kvínt na bielych klávesoch je čistá, no B nahor po F má iba šesť poltónov. Volá sa zmenšená kvinta. Ak váhate, počítajte poltóny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which of these fifths is smaller than perfect?
rows.translation: Ktorá z týchto kvínt je menšia než čistá?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: B to F spans six half steps; a perfect fifth needs seven.
rows.translation: B po F má šesť poltónov; čistá kvinta potrebuje sedem.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A up to D is a...
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A, B, C, D: four letters, five half steps.
rows.translation: A, B, C, D: štyri písmená, päť poltónov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Seconds, thirds, sixths and sevenths come in major and minor sizes. Minor is always one half step smaller than major.
rows.translation: Sekundy, tercie, sexty a septimy môžu byť veľké alebo malé. Malý interval je vždy o poltón menší než veľký.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Minor second 1, major second 2. Minor third 3, major third 4. Minor sixth 8, major sixth 9. Minor seventh 10, major seventh 11.
rows.translation: Malá sekunda 1, veľká sekunda 2. Malá tercia 3, veľká tercia 4. Malá sexta 8, veľká sexta 9. Malá septima 10, veľká septima 11.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: C up to A is a...
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: C to A spans nine half steps.
rows.translation: Od C po A je deväť poltónov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: C up to B♭ is a...
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: C to B♭ spans ten half steps.
rows.translation: Od C po B♭ je desať poltónov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: E to F is a single half step.
rows.translation: E po F je jediný poltón.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: How many half steps are in a major seventh?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: One half step short of an octave.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: E up to C is a...
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: E, F, G, A, B, C makes a sixth. It spans eight half steps, so it's minor.
rows.translation: E, F, G, A, B, C tvorí sextu. Má osem poltónov, preto je malá.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Count letters for the number. Count half steps for the size. Together they name any interval.
rows.translation: Číslo určíte počítaním písmen. Veľkosť určíte počítaním poltónov. Spolu pomenujú každý interval.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: F up to A is a...
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: F, G, A is a third, and four half steps makes it major.
rows.translation: F, G, A je tercia a vďaka štyrom poltónom je veľká.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: D up to A is a...
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: D to A spans seven half steps.
rows.translation: Od D po A je sedem poltónov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: B up to D is a...
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: B, C, D is a third of three half steps: minor.
rows.translation: B, C, D je tercia z troch poltónov: malá.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: How many half steps are in a major sixth?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: G up to F is a...
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: G to F covers seven letters and ten half steps: a minor seventh.
rows.translation: G po F zahŕňa sedem písmen a desať poltónov: malá septima.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Stack thirds into triads, build major and minor chords, and number the chords of a key.
rows.translation: Skladajte tercie do trojzvukov, tvorte durové a molové akordy a číslujte akordy tóniny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A triad is three notes stacked in thirds. Start on any note, skip a letter, take the next, skip again. C, skip D, E, skip F, G: C E G.
rows.translation: Trojzvuk sú tri tóny uložené v terciách. Začnite ľubovoľným tónom, preskočte písmeno, vezmite ďalšie a znova preskočte. C, preskočte D, E, preskočte F, G: C E G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which notes make a triad built on G?
rows.translation: Ktoré tóny tvoria trojzvuk od G?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: G, skip A, B, skip C, D.
rows.translation: G, preskočte A, B, preskočte C, D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The note a triad is built on is its root. The middle note is the third and the top note is the fifth, named for their distance above the root.
rows.translation: Tón, na ktorom je trojzvuk postavený, je jeho základný tón. Prostredný je tercia a horný kvinta, pomenované podľa vzdialenosti nad základným tónom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In the triad F A C, which note is the root?
rows.translation: Ktorý tón je základný v trojzvuku F A C?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: F is the bottom note the triad is built on.
rows.translation: F je spodný tón, na ktorom je trojzvuk postavený.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In the triad D F A, which note is the fifth?
rows.translation: Ktorý tón je kvintou v trojzvuku D F A?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: D up to A is a fifth: D, E, F, G, A.
rows.translation: D nahor po A je kvinta: D, E, F, G, A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Using only white keys, which triad is built on E?
rows.translation: Ktorý trojzvuk vznikne od E iba na bielych klávesoch?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: E, skip F, G, skip A, B.
rows.translation: E, preskočte F, G, preskočte A, B.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Play or sing the C triad one note at a time: C, E, G.
rows.translation: Zahrajte alebo zaspievajte trojzvuk C po jednom tóne: C, E, G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A major triad has a major third on the bottom, four half steps, then a minor third on top. C E G is major. So are F A C and G B D.
rows.translation: Durový trojzvuk má dole veľkú terciu, štyri poltóny, a nad ňou malú terciu. C E G je durový. Rovnako F A C a G B D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Flip the thirds and you get minor: a minor third on the bottom, then a major third. Lower the middle note of C major and you get C minor: C E♭ G.
rows.translation: Vymeňte tercie a dostanete molový trojzvuk: dole malá tercia a nad ňou veľká. Znížte prostredný tón C dur a dostanete C mol: C E♭ G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: D to F is a minor third; F to A is a major third.
rows.translation: D po F je malá tercia; F po A je veľká tercia.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: E to G♯ is a major third; G♯ to B is a minor third.
rows.translation: E po G♯ je veľká tercia; G♯ po B je malá tercia.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Is A C E major or minor?
rows.translation: Je A C E durový alebo molový trojzvuk?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A to C is a minor third, three half steps.
rows.translation: A po C je malá tercia, tri poltóny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Play or sing A minor one note at a time: A, C, E.
rows.translation: Zahrajte alebo zaspievajte A mol po jednom tóne: A, C, E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Build a triad on each note of a scale, using only that scale's notes, and you get the key's family of chords. C major has seven, one per note.
rows.translation: Na každom tóne stupnice vytvorte trojzvuk iba z tónov tejto stupnice a dostanete rodinu akordov tóniny. C dur ich má sedem, jeden na každom tóne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Using only C major notes, what triad is built on D?
rows.translation: Aký trojzvuk vznikne od D iba z tónov C dur?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: D F A: a minor third, then a major third.
rows.translation: D F A: malá tercia a nad ňou veľká tercia.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Using only C major notes, what triad is built on G?
rows.translation: Aký trojzvuk vznikne od G iba z tónov C dur?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: G B D: a major third, then a minor third.
rows.translation: G B D: veľká tercia a nad ňou malá tercia.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The triad on B is different: B D F. Both thirds are minor, so it's a diminished triad. It sounds tense and wants to move.
rows.translation: Trojzvuk od B je iný: B D F. Obe tercie sú malé, preto je to zmenšený trojzvuk. Znie napäto a žiada si pohyb.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In C major, which chords are major?
rows.translation: Ktoré akordy sú v C dur durové?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: C E G, F A C and G B D each have a major third on the bottom.
rows.translation: C E G, F A C aj G B D majú dole veľkú terciu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Using only C major notes, what triad is built on A?
rows.translation: Aký trojzvuk vznikne od A iba z tónov C dur?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A C E: a minor third, then a major third.
rows.translation: A C E: malá tercia a nad ňou veľká tercia.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Play or sing the diminished triad on B: B, D, F.
rows.translation: Zahrajte alebo zaspievajte zmenšený trojzvuk od B: B, D, F.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Musicians number a key's chords with Roman numerals: I for the chord on note 1, up to vii for note 7. Uppercase means major, lowercase minor, and ° diminished.
rows.translation: Hudobníci číslujú akordy tóniny rímskymi číslicami: I pre akord na tóne 1 až po vii pre tón 7. Veľké písmená znamenajú dur, malé mol a ° zmenšený akord.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Every major key follows one pattern: I, ii, iii, IV, V, vi, vii°. In C major that's C, D minor, E minor, F, G, A minor and B diminished.
rows.translation: Každá durová tónina má rovnaký vzorec: I, ii, iii, IV, V, vi, vii°. V C dur je to C, D mol, E mol, F, G, A mol a B zmenšený.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In C major, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Ktorý akord je IV v C dur?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The fourth note of C major is F.
rows.translation: Štvrtý tón C dur je F.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In C major, which chord is vi?
rows.translation: Ktorý akord je vi v C dur?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The sixth note is A, and lowercase vi means minor.
rows.translation: Šiesty tón je A a malé vi znamená molový akord.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In G major, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Ktorý akord je V v G dur?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Count up from G: G, A, B, C, D. The fifth note is D, and V is major.
rows.translation: Počítajte nahor od G: G, A, B, C, D. Piaty tón je D a V je durový akord.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Why is ii written in lowercase?
rows.translation: Prečo je ii napísané malými písmenami?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In G major, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Ktorý akord je IV v G dur?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: G, A, B, C: the fourth note is C.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C: štvrtý tón je C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Spell it, hear it, number it
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Stack thirds, check their sizes, then place the chord in its key: major on I, IV and V, minor on ii, iii and vi, diminished on vii°.
rows.translation: Skladajte tercie, overte ich veľkosť a zaraďte akord do tóniny: durové na I, IV a V, molové na ii, iii a vi, zmenšený na vii°.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In C major, which chord is ii?
rows.translation: Ktorý akord je ii v C dur?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In F major, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Ktorý akord je V v F dur?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: F, G, A, B♭, C: the fifth note is C.
rows.translation: F, G, A, B♭, C: piaty tón je C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: B to D and D to F are both minor thirds.
rows.translation: B po D aj D po F sú malé tercie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Play or sing the G major triad: G, B, D.
rows.translation: Zahrajte alebo zaspievajte durový trojzvuk G: G, B, D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: How chords move in songs: I–IV–V, the pop loop, ii–V–I, the 12-bar blues and cadences.
rows.translation: Pohyb akordov v piesňach: I–IV–V, popový cyklus, ii–V–I, 12-taktové blues a kadencie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Countless folk, rock and country songs use just three chords: I, IV and V. In C major, that's C, F and G. Together they hold every note of the scale.
rows.translation: Nespočetné ľudové, rockové a country piesne používajú iba tri akordy: I, IV a V. V C dur sú to C, F a G. Spolu obsahujú každý tón stupnice.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In G major, what are I, IV and V?
rows.translation: Aké sú I, IV a V v G dur?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Count up from G: note 1 is G, note 4 is C, note 5 is D.
rows.translation: Počítajte nahor od G: tón 1 je G, tón 4 je C, tón 5 je D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Does this end on the home chord?
rows.translation: Končí sa to na tonickom akorde?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: I feels like home. IV moves away. V builds tension that pulls back to I. That trip, out and back again, shapes a huge number of songs.
rows.translation: I pôsobí ako domov. IV odchádza. V vytvára napätie, ktoré ťahá späť k I. Táto cesta preč a znova späť formuje obrovské množstvo piesní.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which chord pulls most strongly back to I?
rows.translation: Ktorý akord najsilnejšie ťahá späť k I?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: V builds tension that resolves to I.
rows.translation: V vytvára napätie, ktoré sa rozvedie do I.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In D major, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Ktorý akord je IV v D dur?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: D, E, F♯, G: the fourth note is G.
rows.translation: D, E, F♯, G: štvrtý tón je G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Play or sing the roots of I, IV, V, I in C: C, F, G, C.
rows.translation: Zahrajte alebo zaspievajte základné tóny I, IV, V, I v C: C, F, G, C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: This four-chord loop runs under a huge number of pop songs. In C major it's C, G, A minor, F. The minor vi adds a touch of shade before IV lifts back toward home.
rows.translation: Tento štvorakordový cyklus sprevádza obrovské množstvo popových piesní. V C dur je to C, G, A mol, F. Molový vi pridá trochu tieňa, kým IV pozdvihne hudbu späť k domovu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In G major, what is I–V–vi–IV?
rows.translation: Aký je I–V–vi–IV v G dur?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In G: I is G, V is D, vi is E minor, IV is C.
rows.translation: V G: I je G, V je D, vi je E mol, IV je C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Start the same loop on vi and you get vi–IV–I–V: A minor, F, C, G. The chords are identical, but beginning on minor makes it sound more serious.
rows.translation: Začnite rovnaký cyklus na vi a dostanete vi–IV–I–V: A mol, F, C, G. Akordy sú rovnaké, no začiatok na molovom akorde dodá vážnejší zvuk.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In F major, which chord is vi?
rows.translation: Ktorý akord je vi v F dur?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: F, G, A, B♭, C, D: the sixth note is D, and vi is minor.
rows.translation: F, G, A, B♭, C, D: šiesty tón je D a vi je molový akord.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Play or sing the roots of I–V–vi–IV in C: C, G, A, F.
rows.translation: Zahrajte alebo zaspievajte základné tóny I–V–vi–IV v C: C, G, A, F.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: ii–V–I is the most common progression in jazz. In C major: D minor, G, C. Each root falls a fifth to the next, so the move feels like coming home.
rows.translation: ii–V–I je najbežnejší akordový sled v jazze. V C dur: D mol, G, C. Každý základný tón klesá o kvintu k ďalšiemu, takže pohyb pôsobí ako návrat domov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In C major, what is ii–V–I?
rows.translation: Aký je ii–V–I v C dur?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: ii is D minor, V is G, and I is C.
rows.translation: ii je D mol, V je G a I je C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Jazz players usually add sevenths: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7. The extra notes make each move even smoother. The roots and the trip home stay the same.
rows.translation: Jazzoví hráči zvyčajne pridávajú septimy: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7. Ďalšie tóny robia každý prechod ešte plynulejším. Základné tóny a cesta domov zostávajú rovnaké.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In F major, what is ii–V–I?
rows.translation: Aký je ii–V–I v F dur?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: F, G, A, B♭, C: ii is G minor and V is C.
rows.translation: F, G, A, B♭, C: ii je G mol a V je C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In ii–V–I, how do the roots move?
rows.translation: Ako sa pohybujú základné tóny v ii–V–I?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: D down to G, then G down to C: a fifth each time.
rows.translation: D nadol po G, potom G nadol po C: zakaždým kvinta.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Play or sing the roots of ii–V–I in C: D, down to G, up to C.
rows.translation: Zahrajte alebo zaspievajte základné tóny ii–V–I v C: D, nadol na G, nahor na C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The 12-bar blues is a chord plan, twelve bars long, behind countless blues, rock and jazz tunes. It uses I, IV and V, often all as dominant seventh chords for a bluesy edge.
rows.translation: 12-taktové blues je akordový plán dlhý dvanásť taktov, na ktorom stoja nespočetné bluesové, rockové a jazzové melódie. Používa I, IV a V, často všetky ako dominantné septakordy pre bluesovú ostrosť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Four bars of I. Two of IV, two of I. One of V, one of IV, two of I. Then it repeats. In A: A7 four times, D7 twice, A7 twice, E7, D7, A7 twice.
rows.translation: Štyri takty I. Dva IV, dva I. Jeden V, jeden IV, dva I. Potom sa opakuje. V A: A7 štyrikrát, D7 dvakrát, A7 dvakrát, E7, D7, A7 dvakrát.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: How many bars of I open the 12-bar blues?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Four bars of I, then IV arrives in bar 5.
rows.translation: Štyri takty I, potom v takte 5 príde IV.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In the 12-bar blues, which chord is in bar 9?
rows.translation: Ktorý akord je v takte 9 pri 12-taktovom blues?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Bar 9 is the one bar of V, before IV in bar 10.
rows.translation: Takt 9 je jediný takt V pred IV v takte 10.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In the key of E, what are the three blues chords?
rows.translation: Aké sú tri bluesové akordy v tónine E?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In E, I is E, IV is A and V is B.
rows.translation: V E je I E, IV je A a V je B.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Play or sing the roots of the blues in A: A, D, E, back to A.
rows.translation: Zahrajte alebo zaspievajte základné tóny blues v A: A, D, E a späť na A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A cadence is the chord move that ends a phrase, like punctuation. V to I is the strongest, a full stop. It's called an authentic cadence.
rows.translation: Kadencia je akordový pohyb, ktorý končí frázu ako interpunkcia. V po I je najsilnejší, ako bodka. Volá sa autentická kadencia.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: IV to I is a plagal cadence, the soft amen at the end of many hymns. Stopping on V is a half cadence, like a comma. V to vi is deceptive: you expect home and get a surprise.
rows.translation: IV po I je plagálna kadencia, jemné amen na konci mnohých hymnov. Zastavenie na V je polovičná kadencia, ako čiarka. V po vi je klamná: čakáte domov a príde prekvapenie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which cadence ends a phrase on V?
rows.translation: Ktorá kadencia končí frázu na V?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A half cadence pauses on V, like a comma.
rows.translation: Polovičná kadencia sa zastaví na V ako čiarka.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which cadence is called the amen cadence?
rows.translation: Ktorá kadencia sa nazýva kadenciou amen?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: IV to I is the soft amen at the end of many hymns.
rows.translation: IV po I je jemné amen na konci mnohých hymnov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Home, away and back again. Name the progression, then the cadence that ends it. Listen for where the music wants to rest.
rows.translation: Domov, preč a znova späť. Pomenujte akordový sled a potom kadenciu, ktorá ho uzatvára. Počúvajte, kde chce hudba spočinúť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In D major, what is I–V–vi–IV?
rows.translation: Aký je I–V–vi–IV v D dur?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In D: I is D, V is A, vi is B minor, IV is G.
rows.translation: V D: I je D, V je A, vi je B mol, IV je G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In which bar does the 12-bar blues first move to IV?
rows.translation: V ktorom takte prejde 12-taktové blues prvýkrát na IV?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: V to I is the full stop of music.
rows.translation: V po I je hudobná bodka.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Play or sing the roots of I–IV–V–I in G: G, C, D, G.
rows.translation: Zahrajte alebo zaspievajte základné tóny I–IV–V–I v G: G, C, D, G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Feel the beat, count it, and tap it in time
rows.translation: Cíťte dobu, počítajte ju a ťukajte presne v rytme
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Find the pulse, count to four, and tap in time.
rows.translation: Nájdite pulz, počítajte do štyroch a ťukajte v rytme.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The beat is a steady pulse
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The beat is the steady pulse you tap your foot to. It never rushes or drags, like footsteps on an easy walk. Every rhythm sits on top of it.
rows.translation: Doba je pravidelný pulz, do ktorého si podupkávate nohou. Neponáhľa sa ani nespomaľuje, ako kroky pri pokojnej prechádzke. Každý rytmus na ňom stojí.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Hold your fingertip just above the screen and tap each time the click sounds. Let it bounce off the glass like a drumstick. Aim to land with the click, not after it.
rows.translation: Držte konček prsta tesne nad obrazovkou a ťuknite pri každom kliknutí. Nech sa od skla odrazí ako palička od bubna. Snažte sa trafiť kliknutie, nie okamih po ňom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A beat keeps the same space between pulses, like a clock ticking.
rows.translation: Doby majú stále rovnaké rozostupy ako tikot hodín.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: How many clicks did you hear?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Most music groups beats in fours. Count 1, 2, 3, 4 out loud with the click, then start again at 1. Saying the numbers helps your hands keep time.
rows.translation: Väčšina hudby zoskupuje doby po štyroch. S kliknutím počítajte nahlas 1, 2, 3, 4 a potom začnite znova od 1. Vyslovovanie čísel pomáha rukám držať rytmus.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A bar is one group of beats. Here each bar holds four beats, written 4/4. Beat 1 starts every bar, so lean on it a little as you count.
rows.translation: Takt je jedna skupina dôb. Tu má každý takt štyri doby, zapísané ako 4/4. Doba 1 začína každý takt, preto ju pri počítaní trochu zdôraznite.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The strong click is beat 1. How many beats are in each bar?
rows.translation: Silné kliknutie je doba 1. Koľko dôb má každý takt?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Counting starts again at 1 at the top of every bar.
rows.translation: Na začiatku každého taktu začíname počítať znova od 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A note that lasts one beat is a quarter note. Four of them fill a bar of 4/4, so tapping on every beat means tapping quarter notes.
rows.translation: Nota trvajúca jednu dobu je štvrťová. Štyri vyplnia takt 4/4, takže ťukanie na každú dobu znamená ťukanie štvrťových nôt.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Now tap only on 1 and 3. Each tap is a half note, two beats long. Keep counting all four; the beats you skip still happen.
rows.translation: Teraz ťukajte iba na 1 a 3. Každé ťuknutie je polová nota dlhá dve doby. Počítajte všetky štyri; aj vynechané doby stále plynú.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: You tap on 1 and 3. What happens on 2 and 4?
rows.translation: Ťukáte na 1 a 3. Čo sa deje na 2 a 4?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The beat never stops. You count through the beats you don't tap.
rows.translation: Pulz sa nikdy nezastaví. Počítajte aj doby, na ktoré neťukáte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A whole note lasts all four beats. Tap once on 1 and count 2, 3, 4 under your breath so the next 1 lands on time.
rows.translation: Celá nota trvá všetky štyri doby. Ťuknite raz na 1 a potichu počítajte 2, 3, 4, aby ďalšia 1 prišla načas.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Tempo is the speed of the beat
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Tempo is how fast the beat goes, counted in beats per minute, or bpm. At 60 bpm the beat comes once a second, like a clock.
rows.translation: Tempo určuje rýchlosť pulzu v dobách za minútu, čiže bpm. Pri 60 bpm prichádza doba raz za sekundu ako tikot hodín.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: At 60 bpm, how often does the beat come?
rows.translation: Ako často prichádza doba pri 60 bpm?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: 60 beats in 60 seconds is one beat each second.
rows.translation: 60 dôb za 60 sekúnd je jedna doba každú sekundu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Faster tempos need less effort, not more. Keep your hand loose and tap from the knuckle, not the wrist or shoulder.
rows.translation: Rýchlejšie tempo vyžaduje menej námahy, nie viac. Ruku držte uvoľnenú a ťukajte pohybom z kĺbu prsta, nie zo zápästia alebo ramena.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The tempo goes up. What should your taps do?
rows.translation: Tempo stúpa. Aké majú byť vaše ťuknutia?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Wait a little behind the click
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Small, relaxed motions are quicker and easier to keep even.
rows.translation: Malé, uvoľnené pohyby sú rýchlejšie a ľahšie sa udržiavajú rovnomerné.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: This challenge mixes beats, bars, longer notes and tempo. Count out loud the whole way, and keep your taps small and relaxed.
rows.translation: Táto výzva mieša doby, takty, dlhšie noty a tempo. Celý čas počítajte nahlas a ťukajte malými, uvoľnenými pohybmi.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Which note lasts a whole bar of 4/4?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A whole note lasts four beats, the full bar of 4/4.
rows.translation: Celá nota trvá štyri doby, celý takt 4/4.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: bpm counts beats per minute, so 90 bpm is one and a half beats each second.
rows.translation: bpm udáva doby za minútu, takže 90 bpm je jeden a pol doby za sekundu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Split each beat in two and count "and."
rows.translation: Rozdeľte každú dobu na dve a počítajte aj „a“.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat, so two fit in every beat. Eight of them fill a bar of 4/4.
rows.translation: Osminová nota trvá pol doby, takže do každej doby sa zmestia dve. Osem ich vyplní takt 4/4.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Say the number on each beat and "and" exactly halfway between: 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Tap on every word.
rows.translation: Na každú dobu povedzte číslo a presne uprostred medzi nimi „a“: 1 a 2 a 3 a 4 a. Ťuknite na každé slovo.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: An eighth note is half a beat, so two fill each beat.
rows.translation: Osminová nota trvá pol doby, takže dve vyplnia každú dobu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The strong clicks are the beats. How many beats did you hear?
rows.translation: Silné kliknutia sú doby. Koľko dôb ste počuli?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Now some beats get one tap and some get two. Keep saying every "and," even the ones you don't tap.
rows.translation: Teraz na niektoré doby ťuknete raz a na iné dvakrát. Stále vyslovujte každé „a“, aj to, na ktoré neťukáte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: How do you count this pattern?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Beat 1 has two taps, 1 and. Beats 2, 3 and 4 get one tap each.
rows.translation: Doba 1 má dve ťuknutia, 1 a. Doby 2, 3 a 4 majú po jednom ťuknutí.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: In eighths, each tap lands on a number or an "and." Before you tap a new pattern, say its counts once out loud.
rows.translation: Pri osminových notách každé ťuknutie pripadá na číslo alebo „a“. Pred ťukaním nového vzoru si ho raz nahlas odpočítajte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Beats 1 and 3 have two taps each; beats 2 and 4 have one.
rows.translation: Doby 1 a 3 majú po dvoch ťuknutiach; doby 2 a 4 po jednom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Beat 1 has one tap, beats 2 and 3 have two, and beat 4 has one.
rows.translation: Doba 1 má jedno ťuknutie, doby 2 a 3 majú dve a doba 4 jedno.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: The "and" should land exactly halfway between beats. If your eighths sound like a gallop, slow down and say the counts as you tap.
rows.translation: „A“ má pripadnúť presne doprostred medzi doby. Ak vaše osminové noty znejú ako cval, spomaľte a pri ťukaní nahlas počítajte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Your eighths sound uneven. What helps most?
rows.translation: Osminové noty znejú nerovnomerne. Čo najviac pomôže?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Slow down and count out loud
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Speed up until it smooths out
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Slowing down gives you time to place each "and" in the middle. Counting keeps it there.
rows.translation: Spomalenie dá čas umiestniť každé „a“ doprostred. Počítanie ho tam udrží.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Hover just above the glass between taps. A short, light motion is easier to keep even at faster tempos.
rows.translation: Medzi ťuknutiami držte prst tesne nad sklom. Krátky, ľahký pohyb sa aj vo vyššom tempe ľahšie udržiava rovnomerný.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: This challenge mixes quarters and eighths. Say each pattern's counts once, then tap it with every "and" right in the middle.
rows.translation: Táto výzva mieša štvrťové a osminové noty. Každý vzor si raz nahlas odpočítajte, potom ho vyťukajte s každým „a“ presne uprostred.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Leave space on purpose, then tap between the beats.
rows.translation: Zámerne nechajte ticho a potom ťukajte medzi dobami.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A rest is a silence with a set length. You still count it; you just don't tap. A quarter rest lasts one beat.
rows.translation: Pomlčka je ticho určenej dĺžky. Stále ju počítate, iba neťukáte. Štvrťová pomlčka trvá jednu dobu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: What do you do on a rest?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: A rest takes up time just like a note. Counting it keeps your place.
rows.translation: Pomlčka zaberá čas rovnako ako nota. Počítanie vám pomáha udržať miesto.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Leaving beat 1 empty is the hardest rest. Nod your head on 1 so you feel it without tapping, then come in on 2.
rows.translation: Vynechať dobu 1 je najťažšie. Na 1 kývnite hlavou, aby ste ju cítili bez ťuknutia, a potom nastúpte na 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: An eighth rest lasts half a beat. Count 1 and 2 and, rest on 2, and tap its "and" instead. It feels like a small push into beat 3.
rows.translation: Osminová pomlčka trvá pol doby. Počítajte 1 a 2 a, na 2 nechajte pomlčku a namiesto nej ťuknite na jej „a“. Pôsobí to ako malé postrčenie do doby 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: It sits halfway between beats 2 and 3, on the "and" of 2.
rows.translation: Je uprostred medzi dobami 2 a 3, na „a“ po 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Syncopation puts a strong note between the beats, where your ear doesn't expect one. It makes a rhythm lean forward.
rows.translation: Synkopa umiestňuje dôrazný tón medzi doby tam, kde ho sluch nečaká. Rytmus tak akoby smeroval dopredu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: This pattern lands on 1, the "and" of 2, and 4. Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and, and tap only those three spots.
rows.translation: Tento vzor pripadá na 1, na „a“ po 2 a na 4. Počítajte „1 a 2 a 3 a 4 a“ a ťukajte iba na týchto troch miestach.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Count the clicks from 1 to 8. Where do the strong ones fall?
rows.translation: Počítajte kliknutia od 1 po 8. Kam pripadajú silné?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Syncopation shifts the weight off the beat, onto an "and" or a weak beat.
rows.translation: Synkopa presúva dôraz mimo hlavnej doby na „a“ alebo na ľahkú dobu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 2

rows.source: Offbeats are the "and" between beats. Nod on the numbers and tap only the ands, like the chop of a reggae guitar.
rows.translation: Údery medzi dobami pripadajú na „a“. Na čísla kývajte hlavou a ťukajte len na „a“, ako pri tlmených úderoch reggae gitary.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The first click is beat 1. Are the strong clicks on the numbers or the ands?
rows.translation: Prvé kliknutie je doba 1. Sú silné kliknutia na číslach alebo na „a“?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Offbeats fall halfway between the beats, on every "and."
rows.translation: Údery medzi dobami pripadajú do polovice medzi dobami, na každé „a“.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: This challenge mixes rests, the "and" on its own, syncopation and offbeats. Count every eighth out loud, even when you don't tap.
rows.translation: Táto výzva spája pomlčky, samostatné „a“, synkopy a údery medzi dobami. Počítajte nahlas každú osminu, aj keď neťukáte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Tapping the "and" of 2 and skipping 3 moves the weight off the beat.
rows.translation: Ťuknutie na „a“ po 2 a vynechanie 3 presúva dôraz mimo doby.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Hold notes across the beat with ties and dotted rhythms.
rows.translation: Predĺžte tóny cez dobu pomocou ligatúr a bodkovaných rytmov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A tie is a curved line joining two notes. You play the first and hold it through the second, so the tied note gets no new tap.
rows.translation: Ligatúra je oblúčik spájajúci dve noty rovnakej výšky. Zahráte prvú a držíte ju aj počas druhej, takže na zviazanú notu už neťuknete.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Beat 2 is tied to beat 3. What do you do on 3?
rows.translation: Doba 2 je ligatúrou spojená s dobou 3. Čo urobíte na 3?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A tie stretches one note. You count 3, but the note from beat 2 keeps sounding.
rows.translation: Ligatúra predlžuje jeden tón. Počítate 3, ale tón z doby 2 stále znie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Tie the "and" of 2 into beat 3. Tap on the "and," then let beat 3 pass while the note rings. It's syncopation, written another way.
rows.translation: Spojte „a“ po 2 s dobou 3. Ťuknite na „a“ a potom nechajte dobu 3 prejsť, kým tón znie. Je to inak zapísaná synkopa.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A dot after a note adds half its length. A half note lasts two beats, so a dotted half lasts three. Tap 1, count 2 and 3, tap 4.
rows.translation: Bodka za notou pridáva polovicu jej dĺžky. Polová nota trvá dve doby, preto polová s bodkou trvá tri. Ťuknite na 1, počítajte 2 a 3, ťuknite na 4.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat. How long is a dotted quarter?
rows.translation: Štvrťová nota trvá jednu dobu. Ako dlho trvá štvrťová s bodkou?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Half of one beat is a half beat. Add it and you get one and a half.
rows.translation: Polovica jednej doby je pol doby. Po pridaní dostanete jeden a pol doby.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A dotted quarter lasts one and a half beats, so the next note lands on an "and." Count 1 and 2 and: tap 1, then the "and" of 2.
rows.translation: Štvrťová s bodkou trvá jeden a pol doby, preto ďalšia nota padne na „a“. Počítajte 1 a 2 a: ťuknite na 1, potom na „a“ po 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: You tapped this pattern with a rest in Unit 3. What changes with a dot?
rows.translation: Tento rytmus ste v časti 3 ťukali s pomlčkou. Čo sa zmení s bodkou?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The taps land in the same places. Only the length of the first note changes.
rows.translation: Ťuknutia zostanú na rovnakých miestach. Mení sa iba dĺžka prvého tónu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A dotted quarter plus an eighth fills two beats: long, short. Count 1 and 2 and; tap 1 and the "and" of 2.
rows.translation: Štvrťová s bodkou a osmina vyplnia dve doby: dlho, krátko. Počítajte 1 a 2 a; ťuknite na 1 a na „a“ po 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A dotted quarter and an eighth together last how long?
rows.translation: Ako dlho spolu trvajú štvrťová s bodkou a osminová nota?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: One and a half plus a half is two.
rows.translation: Jeden a pol plus polovica sú dve.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which lasts as long as a dotted quarter?
rows.translation: Čo trvá rovnako dlho ako štvrťová s bodkou?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A quarter tied to an eighth
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The tie adds half a beat to the quarter, just like the dot does.
rows.translation: Ligatúra pridáva štvrťovej note pol doby, rovnako ako bodka.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: This challenge mixes ties and dots. Count every eighth out loud; a held note still takes up its full time.
rows.translation: Táto výzva spája ligatúry a bodky. Počítajte nahlas každú osminu; aj držaný tón trvá celý svoj čas.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: How long is a dotted half note?
rows.translation: Ako dlho trvá polová nota s bodkou?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A half note is two beats; the dot adds one more.
rows.translation: Polová nota trvá dve doby; bodka pridáva ešte jednu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A tie connects two notes. How many times do you tap?
rows.translation: Ligatúra spája dve noty. Koľkokrát ťuknete?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: You tap the first note and hold through the second.
rows.translation: Ťuknete na prvú notu a držíte ju aj počas druhej.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Split the beat in three, then swing your eighths.
rows.translation: Rozdeľte dobu na tri časti a potom hrajte osminy so swingom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Triplets split the beat in three
rows.translation: Trioly delia dobu na tri časti
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A triplet fits three even notes into one beat. Count 1-trip-let, 2-trip-let, with each syllable the same length.
rows.translation: Triola vtesná tri rovnaké noty do jednej doby. Počítajte 1-ta-ta, 2-ta-ta, každú slabiku rovnako dlho.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: How many triplet notes fit in one beat?
rows.translation: Koľko triolových nôt sa zmestí do jednej doby?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Triplets split each beat into three equal parts.
rows.translation: Trioly delia každú dobu na tri rovnaké časti.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Are the clicks in groups of two or three?
rows.translation: Sú kliknutia v skupinách po dvoch alebo po troch?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Eighths split the beat in two; triplets split it in three. The beat itself stays put. Only the way you divide it changes.
rows.translation: Osminy delia dobu na dve časti, trioly na tri. Samotná doba zostáva rovnaká. Mení sa len jej delenie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: You count 1-trip-let, 2-trip-let. What are you tapping?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Three syllables per beat means three notes per beat: triplets.
rows.translation: Tri slabiky na dobu znamenajú tri noty na dobu: trioly.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: In swing, each pair of eighths turns long-short. The "and" moves late, onto the last part of a triplet. Think doo-ba, doo-ba.
rows.translation: Pri swingu sa každý pár osmín mení na dlho-krátko. „A“ sa oneskorí na poslednú časť trioly. Predstavte si dúú-ba, dúú-ba.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Count 1-trip-let and tap only on "1" and "let." The gap in the middle is the swing.
rows.translation: Počítajte 1-ta-ta a ťukajte len na „1“ a posledné „ta“. Medzera uprostred tvorí swing.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: In swing, where does the "and" land?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Swing delays the "and" to the last triplet, which gives the long-short lilt.
rows.translation: Swing oneskorí „a“ na poslednú notu trioly, čím vzniká kolísanie dlho-krátko.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Jazz drummers play this on the ride cymbal: 1, 2, a swung "and," 3, 4, a swung "and." It sounds like ding, ding-a ding.
rows.translation: Džezoví bubeníci hrajú na čineli ride: 1, 2, swingové „a“, 3, 4, swingové „a“. Znie to ako ding, ding-a ding.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: How do you tap a swung "and"?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A swung "and" waits for the last triplet of the beat.
rows.translation: Swingové „a“ čaká na poslednú notu trioly v dobe.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Straight eighths split the beat evenly; swung eighths go long-short. Tap one, then the other, and feel the difference.
rows.translation: Rovné osminy delia dobu rovnomerne; swingové idú dlho-krátko. Ťukajte najprv jedny, potom druhé a vnímajte rozdiel.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: This challenge mixes triplets, straight eighths and swing. Keep the beat steady while the way you split it changes.
rows.translation: Táto výzva spája trioly, rovné osminy a swing. Držte stálu dobu, aj keď sa mení jej delenie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Swing turns each pair of eighths into what?
rows.translation: Na čo mení swing každý pár osmín?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The first eighth stretches and the "and" arrives late.
rows.translation: Prvá osmina sa predĺži a „a“ príde neskôr.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Waltz in three, march in two, rock in 6/8, and place the accents.
rows.translation: Valčík na tri, pochod na dve, kolísanie v 6/8 a rozmiestnenie prízvukov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: In 3/4 time each bar has three beats: ONE, two, three. It's the waltz. Count 1, 2, 3 and lean on 1.
rows.translation: V 3/4 takte má každý takt tri doby: RAZ, dva, tri. Je to valčík. Počítajte 1, 2, 3 a zdôraznite 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A half note fills two of the three beats. Tap 1, count 2, tap 3. It feels like the big step and small step of a waltz.
rows.translation: Polová nota vyplní dve z troch dôb. Ťuknite na 1, počítajte 2, ťuknite na 3. Pripomína to veľký a malý krok valčíka.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: How many beats are in a bar of 3/4?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The top number of a time signature tells you how many beats are in each bar.
rows.translation: Horné číslo taktového označenia udáva počet dôb v takte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: 2/4 has two beats per bar: ONE, two, like marching feet. The bars go by quickly, so beat 1 comes around often.
rows.translation: 2/4 má dve doby v takte: RAZ, dva, ako kroky pri pochode. Takty plynú rýchlo, preto sa doba 1 často vracia.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which meter feels like a march?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Two beats per bar match left, right, left, right.
rows.translation: Dve doby v takte zodpovedajú krokom ľavá, pravá, ľavá, pravá.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: In 6/8 each bar holds six eighth notes in two groups of three: ONE two three FOUR five six. It feels like two big, rocking beats.
rows.translation: V 6/8 má takt šesť osminových nôt v dvoch skupinách po troch: RAZ dva tri ŠTYRI päť šesť. Cítite dve veľké, kolísavé doby.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The six eighths fall into two groups of three, so you feel two big beats.
rows.translation: Šesť osmín tvorí dve skupiny po troch, preto cítite dve veľké doby.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A favorite 6/8 pattern goes long-short, long-short: tap 1, 3, 4 and 6. It rocks like a lullaby or a sea shanty.
rows.translation: Obľúbený rytmus v 6/8 ide dlho-krátko, dlho-krátko: ťukajte na 1, 3, 4 a 6. Kolíše sa ako uspávanka alebo námornícka pieseň.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Six clicks per bar. Which meter is this?
rows.translation: Šesť kliknutí v takte. Aký je to takt?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: An accent is a note played stronger than the ones around it. Move the accents and the feel changes, even when every note stays the same.
rows.translation: Prízvuk je nota zahraná silnejšie než okolité noty. Presuňte prízvuky a pocit z rytmu sa zmení, aj keď všetky noty zostanú rovnaké.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Count all eight eighths and tap just the accents: 1, the "and" of 2, and 4. This 3-3-2 pattern drives a lot of pop and Latin music.
rows.translation: Počítajte všetkých osem osmín a ťukajte len prízvuky: 1, „a“ po 2 a 4. Tento vzor 3-3-2 poháňa veľa popovej a latinskoamerickej hudby.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: An accent is about weight, not length. The note is simply played stronger.
rows.translation: Prízvuk je o dôraze, nie o dĺžke. Nota sa jednoducho zahrá silnejšie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Rock, pop and soul put the accent on beats 2 and 4. This is the backbeat. Count all four and tap only 2 and 4, like a snare drum.
rows.translation: Rock, pop a soul kladú prízvuk na doby 2 a 4. To je dôraz na ľahké doby. Počítajte všetky štyri a ťukajte len 2 a 4 ako malý bubon.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The first click is beat 1. Where are the strong clicks?
rows.translation: Prvé kliknutie je doba 1. Kde sú silné kliknutia?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: This challenge moves between meters and accents. Before each tap step, count one bar under your breath to find beat 1.
rows.translation: Táto výzva strieda takty a prízvuky. Pred každým ťukaním si potichu odpočítajte jeden takt, aby ste našli dobu 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Six eighth notes per bar, felt in two groups of three.
rows.translation: Šesť osmín v takte, cítených ako dve skupiny po troch.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Find your voice and sing in tune
rows.translation: Objavte svoj hlas a spievajte čisto
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Stand tall, breathe low, hold your first steady note and sing a song.
rows.translation: Stojte vzpriamene, dýchajte do spodnej časti trupu, držte prvý stály tón a zaspievajte pieseň.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and knees soft. Let your shoulders drop and your head float up, as if a string lifts it. Keep your jaw loose.
rows.translation: Stojte s chodidlami na šírku bokov a mierne uvoľnenými kolenami. Spustite ramená a hlavu nechajte smerovať nahor, akoby ju dvíhala šnúrka. Čeľusť uvoľnite.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Rest a hand on your belly and breathe in slowly. Your belly and lower ribs widen while your shoulders stay still. That low breath powers your voice.
rows.translation: Položte si ruku na brucho a pomaly sa nadýchnite. Brucho a spodné rebrá sa rozšíria, ramená zostanú pokojné. Tento hlboký dych podporuje váš hlas.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: When you breathe in to sing, what should move?
rows.translation: Čo sa má hýbať pri nádychu pred spevom?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3
