rows.source: A low breath widens your ribs and belly. Lifting your shoulders tightens your neck and throat.
rows.translation: Hlboký nádych rozšíri rebrá a brucho. Dvíhanie ramien napína krk a hrdlo.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Timbre listens for the note's name, so a C sung low or high both count. Pick the octave that feels easy, never strained.
rows.translation: Timbre rozpoznáva názov tónu, takže nízke aj vysoké C sa počíta. Vyberte si oktávu, ktorá je pohodlná a nenamáha hlas.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Breathe low, then sing C on "ah" in a comfortable octave. Hold it steady.
rows.translation: Hlboko sa nadýchnite a zaspievajte C na „á“ v pohodlnej oktáve. Držte ho rovno.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Once more: stand tall, breathe low, and let the note ring.
rows.translation: Ešte raz: stojte vzpriamene, hlboko sa nadýchnite a nechajte tón znieť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: To sustain is to hold a note at one steady pitch. Let the air out slowly and evenly, like fogging a mirror without stopping.
rows.translation: Držať tón znamená udržiavať jeho výšku stálu. Vydychujte pomaly a rovnomerne, akoby ste bez prestávky zahmlievali zrkadlo.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Sing C on "ah" and hold it steady until it locks in.
rows.translation: Spievajte C na „á“ a držte ho rovno až do potvrdenia presnej výšky.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Your note wobbles and fades. What helps most?
rows.translation: Tón kolíše a slabne. Čo pomôže najviac?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Steady air makes a steady note. Extra volume and tension make it harder to control.
rows.translation: Rovnomerný výdych dáva stály tón. Väčšia hlasitosť a napätie sťažujú jeho ovládanie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Now E. Same low breath, same easy "ah."
rows.translation: Teraz E. Rovnaký hlboký nádych, rovnaké nenútené „á“.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Sing "ah" with your jaw dropped and the tip of your tongue resting behind your lower teeth. The sound flows out instead of getting squeezed.
rows.translation: Spievajte „á“ so spustenou čeľusťou a špičkou jazyka opretou za dolnými zubami. Zvuk voľne prúdi namiesto toho, aby ste ho vytláčali.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: G this time. Drop your jaw and keep the "ah" open.
rows.translation: Teraz G. Spustite čeľusť a nechajte „á“ otvorené.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Matching pitch means singing the same note you hear. Listen, imagine the note for a moment, then sing softly and adjust until it settles.
rows.translation: Trafiť výšku znamená zaspievať rovnaký tón, aký počujete. Počúvajte, chvíľu si tón predstavujte, potom spievajte potichu a jemne ho dolaďujte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Sing E softly, then adjust until it settles.
rows.translation: Spievajte E potichu a dolaďujte ho, kým sa neustáli.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Flat means under the target pitch; sharp means over it. If you're flat, lift a little. If you're sharp, ease down. Small moves work best.
rows.translation: Príliš nízko znamená pod cieľovou výškou, príliš vysoko nad ňou. Ak ste nízko, trochu stúpnite. Ak vysoko, jemne klesnite. Najlepšie fungujú malé zmeny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Timbre says you're flat. What do you do?
rows.translation: Timbre ukazuje príliš nízky tón. Čo urobíte?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Flat means under the note, so lift the pitch slightly.
rows.translation: Príliš nízky tón je pod cieľovou výškou, preto ju trochu zvýšte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Two notes this time: D, then G. Take a breath between them.
rows.translation: Teraz dva tóny: D a potom G. Medzi nimi sa nadýchnite.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Humming with your lips closed is a gentle warm-up. You should feel a light buzz on your lips and nose. Keep it soft and easy.
rows.translation: Mručanie so zatvorenými perami je jemné rozospievanie. Na perách a nose by ste mali cítiť ľahké chvenie. Mručte ticho a nenútene.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Hum C, E and G, one at a time. Keep it light.
rows.translation: Mručte C, E a G, každý zvlášť. Ľahko a nenútene.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Close your lips loosely and blow so they flutter like a motorboat, then add your voice. It keeps your throat relaxed while your voice wakes up.
rows.translation: Voľne spojte pery a fúkajte, aby sa rozkmitali ako motorový čln. Potom pridajte hlas. Hrdlo zostáva uvoľnené, kým sa hlas prebúdza.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Lip trill on G, E, then C. If your lips stop, press your cheeks lightly.
rows.translation: Trilkujte perami na G, E a potom C. Ak sa pery zastavia, jemne pritlačte líca.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A note feels tight or scratchy. What do you do?
rows.translation: Pri tóne cítite napätie alebo škriabanie. Čo urobíte?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Stop, rest, and try it softer
rows.translation: Prestanete, oddýchnete si a skúsite tichšie
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Strain is a signal to ease off. Rest, sip some water, and come back lighter.
rows.translation: Napätie je signál poľaviť. Oddýchnite si, napite sa vody a vráťte sa k ľahšiemu spevu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Stand tall, breathe low, and start each note softly. Rest between steps if your voice feels tired.
rows.translation: Stojte vzpriamene, hlboko dýchajte a každý tón začnite jemne. Ak je hlas unavený, medzi krokmi si oddýchnite.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: E, then G. Hear each one before you sing it.
rows.translation: E, potom G. Každý tón si najprv v duchu vypočujte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Sharp is over the target pitch; flat is under it.
rows.translation: Príliš vysoký tón je nad cieľovou výškou, príliš nízky pod ňou.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Sing D softly, then adjust until it settles.
rows.translation: Spievajte D potichu a dolaďujte ho, kým sa neustáli.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: E, D and C, each a step from the next. Sing it where it feels easy; Timbre hears the right note in any octave.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb potrebuje tri tóny: E, D a C, každý o krok vedľa ďalšieho. Spievajte v pohodlnej polohe; Timbre rozpozná správny tón v každej oktáve.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: E, D, C: three steps down to home.
rows.translation: E, D, C: tri kroky nadol k domovskému tónu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Ma-ry had a lit-tle lamb: E D C D E E E.
rows.translation: Ma-ry had a lit-tle lamb: E D C D E E E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Hear a note, sing it back, and move by small steps.
rows.translation: Vypočujte si tón, zopakujte ho spevom a pohybujte sa po malých krokoch.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Before you sing, hear the note in your head for a second. That pause lets your voice aim for the pitch instead of hunting for it.
rows.translation: Pred spevom si tón na sekundu predstavte v hlave. Táto chvíľa pomôže hlasu zamieriť na správnu výšku namiesto jej hľadania.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Hear D in your head, then sing it.
rows.translation: Predstavte si D a potom ho zaspievajte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Hear F in your head, then sing it.
rows.translation: Predstavte si F a potom ho zaspievajte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Your first try lands flat. What next?
rows.translation: Prvý pokus je príliš nízko. Čo ďalej?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Small changes find the note fastest. Lift gently and let it settle.
rows.translation: Malé zmeny nájdu tón najrýchlejšie. Jemne stúpnite a nechajte ho ustáliť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Hear A in your head, then sing it.
rows.translation: Predstavte si A a potom ho zaspievajte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Three notes in a row: D, F, A.
rows.translation: Tri tóny za sebou: D, F, A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Unison means two sounds on exactly the same pitch. When they match, they blend into one; when they're slightly off, you hear a wobble.
rows.translation: Unisono znamená dva zvuky presne rovnakej výšky. Keď sa zhodujú, splynú; pri malom rozdiele počujete kolísanie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Sing E and hold it in tune.
rows.translation: Spievajte E a držte ho čisto.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: To sing the same note twice, stop the air for a moment, then start again on a soft "da." Don't slide between them.
rows.translation: Ak chcete zaspievať rovnaký tón dvakrát, na chvíľu zastavte výdych a začnite znova mäkkým „da“. Medzi tónmi nekĺžte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Sing E three times on "da," with a tiny gap each time.
rows.translation: Zaspievajte E trikrát na „da“, vždy s drobnou medzerou.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A step is the next note
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A step moves to the next note of a scale, up or down. Steps are the smallest, easiest moves to sing in tune.
rows.translation: Krokom prejdete na susedný tón stupnice nahor alebo nadol. Kroky sú najmenšie pohyby a najľahšie sa spievajú čisto.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Did it go up or down?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A half step is the smallest step, like E to F, with no note between. Most neighboring scale notes, like C and D, are a whole step apart: two half steps.
rows.translation: Poltón je najmenšia vzdialenosť, napríklad E až F, bez tónu medzi nimi. Väčšina susedných tónov stupnice, ako C a D, je vzdialená celý tón: dva poltóny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: E, up a half step to F, and back.
rows.translation: E, o poltón nahor na F a späť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Hear each note in your head first, start softly, and adjust in small moves. Give repeated notes a fresh start.
rows.translation: Najprv si každý tón predstavte, začnite jemne a dolaďujte malými zmenami. Opakované tóny vždy nasaďte nanovo.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Hear G in your head, then sing it.
rows.translation: Predstavte si G a potom ho zaspievajte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: B, up a half step to C, and back.
rows.translation: B, o poltón nahor na C a späť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: E to F has no note between them. C to D and G to A are whole steps.
rows.translation: Medzi E a F nie je ďalší tón. C až D a G až A sú celé tóny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Sing do-re-mi, the major scale, and five-note patterns.
rows.translation: Spievajte do-re-mi, durovú stupnicu a päťtónové vzory.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Solfege gives each step of the scale a syllable: do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do. Do is home, wherever the scale starts.
rows.translation: Solmizácia priraďuje stupňom stupnice slabiky: do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do. Do je domovský tón bez ohľadu na začiatok stupnice.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Sing do, re, mi on C, D, E.
rows.translation: Spievajte do, re, mi na C, D, E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which syllable is home, the first step of the scale?
rows.translation: Ktorá slabika je domovským tónom, prvým stupňom stupnice?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Do is the first step and the note a scale comes back to.
rows.translation: Do je prvý stupeň a tón, ku ktorému sa stupnica vracia.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Now back down: mi, re, do.
rows.translation: Teraz späť nadol: mi, re, do.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: the first five steps carry many simple tunes. Sing them up and back down on one breath if it feels easy.
rows.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: prvých päť stupňov nesie veľa jednoduchých melódií. Spievajte ich nahor a späť nadol na jeden nádych, ak je to pohodlné.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: C up to G.
rows.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: od C nahor po G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Between which two steps is there a half step?
rows.translation: Medzi ktorými dvoma stupňami je poltón?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Mi to fa (E to F) is a half step. The other steps from do to sol are whole steps.
rows.translation: Mi až fa (E až F) je poltón. Ostatné kroky od do po sol sú celé tóny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Sol back down to do: G down to C.
rows.translation: Sol späť nadol po do: od G nadol po C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The major scale runs from do up to the next do: eight notes. Mi to fa and ti to do are half steps; every other step is a whole step.
rows.translation: Durová stupnica vedie od do po vyššie do: osem nôt. Mi až fa a ti až do sú poltóny; všetky ostatné kroky sú celé tóny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Do to do: C up to the next C.
rows.translation: Do až do: od C nahor po ďalšie C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Where are the half steps in a major scale?
rows.translation: Kde sú poltóny v durovej stupnici?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Mi-fa and ti-do are half steps. That pattern gives the major scale its sound.
rows.translation: Mi-fa a ti-do sú poltóny. Toto usporiadanie dáva durovej stupnici jej zvuk.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Take a low breath before you start so you don't run out near the top. Let high notes get lighter, not louder, and keep your jaw loose.
rows.translation: Pred začiatkom sa hlboko nadýchnite, aby vám vo výške nedošiel dych. Vysoké tóny spievajte ľahšie, nie hlasnejšie, a uvoľnite čeľusť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Back down from C to C. Keep each lower note bright so it doesn't sag flat.
rows.translation: Späť nadol od C po C. Každý nižší tón udržujte jasný, aby neklesal pod správnu výšku.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Short patterns like do-re-mi-re-do build accuracy fast. Sing one, then start it a step higher and let the scale guide you.
rows.translation: Krátke vzory ako do-re-mi-re-do rýchlo zlepšujú presnosť. Zaspievajte vzor, potom ho začnite o stupeň vyššie a riaďte sa stupnicou.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Do up to sol and back: C to G to C.
rows.translation: Do nahor po sol a späť: C až G až C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Sing C-D-E-D-C, then the same shape one step higher. What's the top note now?
rows.translation: Zaspievajte C-D-E-D-C a potom rovnaký tvar o stupeň vyššie. Aký je teraz najvyšší tón?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: One step higher, the shape becomes D, E, F, E, D.
rows.translation: O stupeň vyššie sa tvar zmení na D, E, F, E, D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Breathe low before each scale, keep the top light, and keep lower notes bright on the way down.
rows.translation: Pred každou stupnicou sa hlboko nadýchnite, výšky spievajte ľahko a pri zostupe udržujte nižšie tóny jasné.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: How many notes are in a major scale, do to do?
rows.translation: Koľko nôt má durová stupnica od do po do?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do: eight notes, with do at both ends.
rows.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do: osem nôt, do na oboch koncoch.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Leap by thirds, fifths and octaves, and land in tune.
rows.translation: Skáčte o tercie, kvinty a oktávy a pristávajte čisto.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: An interval is the distance between two notes. Skip one scale step and you get a third, like do to mi. Hear mi in your head before you leave do.
rows.translation: Interval je vzdialenosť dvoch tónov. Vynechajte jeden stupeň stupnice a dostanete terciu, ako do až mi. Skôr než opustíte do, predstavte si mi.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Do to mi and back: C, E, C.
rows.translation: Do až mi a späť: C, E, C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: C to E skips over D, so it spans three scale notes: a third.
rows.translation: C až E preskakuje D, takže zahŕňa tri tóny stupnice: terciu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Do to sol spans five scale notes, a fifth. It sounds open and strong. Picture the steps in between, then jump straight to sol.
rows.translation: Do až sol zahŕňa päť tónov stupnice, teda kvintu. Znie otvorene a pevne. Predstavte si stupne medzi nimi a skočte rovno na sol.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Do to sol and back: C, G, C.
rows.translation: Do až sol a späť: C, G, C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Do, mi, sol: two thirds stack up to a fifth.
rows.translation: Do, mi, sol: dve tercie nad sebou tvoria kvintu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Counting both ends, how many scale notes from do to sol?
rows.translation: Koľko tónov stupnice je od do po sol vrátane oboch krajných?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: five notes, so it's a fifth.
rows.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: päť tónov, teda kvinta.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: An octave leaps from do to the next do, eight scale notes up. The two notes share a name and blend so well they almost sound like one.
rows.translation: Oktáva skáče od do po ďalšie do, cez osem tónov stupnice vrátane krajných. Oba tóny majú rovnaký názov a tak dobre splývajú, že znejú takmer ako jeden.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Before an octave leap, breathe low and keep your chin level. Think of the top note as light and easy, not a stretch upward.
rows.translation: Pred oktávovým skokom sa hlboko nadýchnite a bradu držte rovno. Horný tón si predstavte ako ľahký a pohodlný, nie ako naťahovanie nahor.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: C, then G, then the high C. Use the G as a stepping stone.
rows.translation: C, potom G a vysoké C. Použite G ako medzistupeň.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Why do the two notes of an octave blend so well?
rows.translation: Prečo dva tóny oktávy tak dobre splývajú?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The top one vibrates twice as fast
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The top note vibrates exactly twice as fast as the bottom one, so their waves line up.
rows.translation: Horný tón kmitá presne dvakrát rýchlejšie než dolný, preto sa ich vlny pravidelne stretávajú.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Hear each leap in your head before you sing it. Land lightly on the top note, then step home.
rows.translation: Pred spevom si každý skok predstavte. Na horný tón pristúpte ľahko a potom sa po krokoch vráťte domov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: High do, sol, mi, do: back down.
rows.translation: Vysoké do, sol, mi, do: späť nadol.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: What is the interval from do to the next do?
rows.translation: Aký interval vedie od do po ďalšie do?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Do to the next do spans eight scale notes: an octave.
rows.translation: Do až ďalšie do zahŕňa osem tónov stupnice: oktávu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Five public-domain tunes, melody only, at an easy pace.
rows.translation: Päť melódií z voľných diel, iba hlavný hlas, v ľahkom tempe.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: This traditional melody leaps up, then steps back down home. Sing it on "loo" and give each repeated note a fresh start.
rows.translation: Táto tradičná melódia vyskočí nahor a potom sa po krokoch vracia domov. Spievajte ju na „lú“ a každý opakovaný tón nasaďte nanovo.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The opening leap: C up to G, step to A, back to G.
rows.translation: Úvodný skok: C nahor na G, krok na A, späť na G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The middle phrase: does it go up or down?
rows.translation: Stredná fráza: ide nahor alebo nadol?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: This melody from Beethoven's Ninth Symphony moves almost entirely by step. Keep it smooth and even, like walking up and down a staircase.
rows.translation: Táto melódia z Beethovenovej Deviatej symfónie postupuje takmer výlučne po krokoch. Spievajte ju plynulo a rovnomerne, ako chôdzu hore a dolu schodmi.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The five notes the tune lives on: F up to C.
rows.translation: Päť tónov melódie: od F nahor po C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The first phrase ends with a dotted note. How does it feel?
rows.translation: Prvá fráza končí bodkovanou notou. Aký má rytmus?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The dotted note is held longer, then a short note leads into the last one.
rows.translation: Bodkovaná nota sa drží dlhšie a potom krátka nota vedie k poslednej.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: This traditional Scottish melody starts with a pickup, a note before the first full bar. Sing it lightly, then lean on the next note.
rows.translation: Táto tradičná škótska melódia začína predtaktím, tónom pred prvým úplným taktom. Zaspievajte ho ľahko a zdôraznite až ďalší tón.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The climb in the third bar: F, A, C, up to D.
rows.translation: Stúpanie v treťom takte: F, A, C, nahor na D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The loudest note of a song
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A note before the first full bar
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A pickup leads into beat 1 of the first full bar.
rows.translation: Predtaktie vedie k dobe 1 prvého úplného taktu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: This American hymn tune from the early 1800s is in 3/4: count 1, 2, 3. Long notes often turn into a quick pair, so keep the pair light.
rows.translation: Táto americká duchovná melódia zo začiatku storočia po roku 1800 je v 3/4: počítajte 1, 2, 3. Dlhé tóny často prechádzajú do rýchlej dvojice, preto ju spievajte ľahko.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The quick turn: F, up to A, back to F.
rows.translation: Rýchly obrat: F, nahor na A, späť na F.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: How many beats are in each bar of this hymn?
rows.translation: Koľko dôb má každý takt tejto duchovnej piesne?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: It's in 3/4: three beats per bar, with the weight on 1.
rows.translation: Je v 3/4: tri doby v takte s dôrazom na 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: This American folk song from the 1800s moves slowly, with wide leaps. Breathe at each rest, and hear every leap before you sing it.
rows.translation: Táto americká ľudová pieseň zo storočia po roku 1800 plynie pomaly a má veľké skoky. Nadýchnite sa pri každej pomlčke a každý skok si pred spevom predstavte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The opening leap: low G up to C. Any octave counts.
rows.translation: Úvodný skok: nízke G nahor na C. Počíta sa každá oktáva.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The big leap: G up to high C, then step down.
rows.translation: Veľký skok: G nahor na vysoké C, potom kroky nadol.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Where should you breathe in this song?
rows.translation: Kde sa v tejto piesni máte nadýchnuť?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Never; sing it in one breath
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The rests mark the ends of phrases. Breathe there so each line has full support.
rows.translation: Pomlčky označujú konce fráz. Nadýchnite sa tam, aby mal každý riadok plnú dychovú oporu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Five tunes back to back, one phrase each. Breathe at every rest, and give repeated notes a fresh start.
rows.translation: Päť melódií za sebou, z každej jedna fráza. Pri každej pomlčke sa nadýchnite a opakované tóny nasaďte nanovo.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which of these songs is in 3/4?
rows.translation: Ktorá z týchto piesní je v 3/4?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Amazing Grace counts 1, 2, 3 in every bar.
rows.translation: V Amazing Grace počítate v každom takte 1, 2, 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Hold notes steady, shape loud and soft, and warm up well.
rows.translation: Držte stále tóny, tvarujte hlasitosť a dobre sa rozospievajte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Pitch drifts when the air behind it changes. Keep a low, even breath and watch the note stay centered from start to finish.
rows.translation: Výška kolíše, keď sa mení prúd vzduchu. Udržujte hlboký, rovnomerný výdych a sledujte, ako tón zostáva v strede od začiatku do konca.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Hold G and keep it centered.
rows.translation: Držte G a udržujte ho v strede.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Notes often sag flat as your air runs out. Stop a little before you're empty, then take a fresh low breath.
rows.translation: Keď dochádza vzduch, tóny často klesajú. Skončite chvíľu pred vyčerpaním dychu a znova sa hlboko nadýchnite.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Your long notes go flat at the end. What helps?
rows.translation: Dlhé tóny vám na konci klesajú. Čo pomôže?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: End the note sooner and breathe
rows.translation: Skončiť tón skôr a nadýchnuť sa
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Pitch sags when you run low on air. Ending a bit early keeps the whole note in tune.
rows.translation: Pri nedostatku vzduchu výška klesá. O trochu skorší koniec udrží celý tón čistý.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Vibrato is a gentle, regular wave in pitch, around five to seven times a second. It grows out of a relaxed throat and steady breath, not out of shaking.
rows.translation: Vibrato je jemné pravidelné kolísanie výšky asi päť až sedemkrát za sekundu. Vzniká z uvoľneného hrdla a stáleho dychu, nie z trasenia.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Where does healthy vibrato come from?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A relaxed throat and steady breath
rows.translation: Z uvoľneného hrdla a stáleho dychu
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Vibrato appears when the voice is free and supported. Forcing it from the jaw or belly makes a wobble.
rows.translation: Vibrato sa objaví, keď je hlas voľný a má oporu. Vynucovanie čeľusťou alebo bruchom spôsobuje nepravidelné kolísanie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Learn to hold a straight, steady note before you chase vibrato. When your voice is relaxed and supported, vibrato often appears on its own.
rows.translation: Pred vibratom sa naučte držať rovný a stály tón. Keď je hlas uvoľnený a má oporu, vibrato sa často objaví samo.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A straight, steady A. No wave, just a clear line.
rows.translation: Rovné, stále A. Bez kolísania, iba čistá línia.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: What's the best first goal for a new singer?
rows.translation: Aký prvý cieľ je najlepší pre začínajúceho speváka?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A steady tone is the foundation. Vibrato that grows from it sounds natural.
rows.translation: Stály tón je základ. Vibrato, ktoré z neho vyrastie, znie prirodzene.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Dynamics are how loud or soft you sing. Get louder with more breath energy, not by squeezing your throat. The pitch should stay put.
rows.translation: Dynamika vyjadruje, ako hlasno alebo potichu spievate. Zosilňujte väčšou energiou dychu, nie sťahovaním hrdla. Výška má zostať rovnaká.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Sing E softly, then louder on the same pitch.
rows.translation: Spievajte E potichu, potom hlasnejšie v rovnakej výške.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: As you get louder, what can happen to pitch?
rows.translation: Čo sa môže stať s výškou pri zosilňovaní?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Extra push tends to raise the pitch, and very soft notes can sag flat. Watch the note either way.
rows.translation: Väčší tlak zvykne výšku zvyšovať, veľmi tiché tóny môžu klesať. V oboch prípadoch sledujte tón.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A swell grows from soft to louder and back on one breath. Start quietly, grow gently, then fade, all on the same pitch.
rows.translation: Na jeden nádych prejdite z tichého spevu k hlasnejšiemu a späť. Začnite potichu, jemne zosilnite a zoslabte, stále v rovnakej výške.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Swell on G: soft, louder, soft. Keep it centered.
rows.translation: Na G: potichu, hlasnejšie, potichu. Držte tón v strede.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A short warm-up eases your voice in: breathe low, hum, lip trill, then sing a scale. Start in the middle of your range and stay comfortable.
rows.translation: Krátke rozospievanie pripraví hlas: hlboké dýchanie, mručanie, trilky pier a potom stupnica. Začnite v strede svojho rozsahu a spievajte pohodlne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Your voice feels tired after practice. What's best?
rows.translation: Po cvičení je hlas unavený. Čo je najlepšie?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.translation: Dopriať mu odpočinok a piť vodu
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Rest helps a tired voice recover. If hoarseness lingers for a few weeks, check with a doctor.
rows.translation: Odpočinok pomáha unavenému hlasu zotaviť sa. Ak zachrípnutie trvá niekoľko týždňov, poraďte sa s lekárom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Warm up first. Then hold each note steady, shape it soft and loud, and breathe before you run out.
rows.translation: Najprv sa rozospievajte. Potom držte každý tón rovno, tvarujte jeho hlasitosť a nadýchnite sa skôr, než dôjde vzduch.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Vibrato is a gentle, even wave around the note, a few times a second.
rows.translation: Vibrato je jemné rovnomerné kolísanie okolo tónu niekoľkokrát za sekundu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: To sing louder, what do you add?
rows.translation: Čo pridáte, ak chcete spievať hlasnejšie?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Breath energy makes a bigger sound without strain.
rows.translation: Energia dychu vytvorí silnejší zvuk bez námahy.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Play the melody, or strum the chords and sing
rows.translation: Hrajte melódiu alebo akordový sprievod a spievajte
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Six famous tunes, one note at a time, on the top strings. Slow tempos, big wins.
rows.translation: Šesť známych melódií, tón po tóne na tenkých strunách. Pomalé tempo, veľké úspechy.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: In 1877, Thomas Edison recited this rhyme to test his new phonograph. The tune uses C and D on string 2, then open E, and G at fret 3 on string 1.
rows.translation: V roku 1877 Thomas Edison odrecitoval túto riekanku pri skúške nového fonografu. Melódia používa C a D na strune 2, potom prázdne E a G na pražci 3 struny 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: E D C D E E E: open string 1, then string 2 at frets 3 and 1, and back.
rows.translation: E D C D E E E: prázdna struna 1, potom struna 2 na pražcoch 3 a 1 a späť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: D D D at fret 3 on string 2. Then open E, and G at fret 3 on string 1.
rows.translation: D D D na pražci 3 struny 2. Potom prázdne E a G na pražci 3 struny 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: This melody was first printed in France in 1761, and Mozart later wrote twelve variations on it. It leaps up, then steps down across strings 2 and 3.
rows.translation: Melódia prvýkrát vyšla tlačou vo Francúzsku v roku 1761 a Mozart na ňu neskôr napísal dvanásť variácií. Skáče nahor a potom klesá po krokoch na strunách 2 a 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Open G, a leap up to D at fret 3 on string 2, open E, and back to D.
rows.translation: Prázdne G, skok nahor na D na pražci 3 struny 2, prázdne E a späť na D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Step down in pairs: C at fret 1, open B, A at fret 2 on string 3, open G.
rows.translation: Klesajte po dvojiciach: C na pražci 1, prázdne B, A na pražci 2 struny 3, prázdne G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which other song uses this same tune?
rows.translation: Ktorá ďalšia pieseň používa tú istú melódiu?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The alphabet song and Baa, Baa, Black Sheep both borrow this French melody.
rows.translation: Abecedná pieseň aj Baa, Baa, Black Sheep si požičiavajú túto francúzsku melódiu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Beethoven finished his Ninth Symphony in 1824, and this melody is now the anthem of the European Union. Here you'll play the whole tune, middle section included.
rows.translation: Beethoven dokončil Deviatu symfóniu v roku 1824 a táto melódia je dnes hymnou Európskej únie. Tu zahráte celú melódiu vrátane strednej časti.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The opening: E E F G G F E D, one step at a time.
rows.translation: Úvod: E E F G G F E D, vždy o jeden krok.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: In the middle section, E and F share a single beat. Count one, two-and, three, four, and play E on two and F on the and.
rows.translation: V strednej časti sa E a F delia o jednu dobu. Počítajte raz, dva-a, tri, štyri; E hrajte na dva a F na „a“.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The middle: quick E F pairs on string 1, then down to open G on string 3.
rows.translation: Stred: rýchle dvojice E F na strune 1, potom nadol na prázdne G na strune 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Frère Jacques is a French round, first printed around 1780: a second player starts the same tune two bars later, and the parts fit together.
rows.translation: Bratku Jakub je francúzsky kánon, prvýkrát vytlačený okolo roku 1780: druhý hráč začne tú istú melódiu o dva takty neskôr a hlasy do seba zapadnú.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: In a round, the second player…
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Everyone plays the same melody, each starting a little later. The phrases are built to fit on top of each other.
rows.translation: Všetci hrajú rovnakú melódiu, no každý začne o trochu neskôr. Frázy sú vytvorené tak, aby spolu súzneli.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The quick part: D E D C on strings 2 and 1, then B and G.
rows.translation: Rýchla časť: D E D C na strunách 2 a 1, potom B a G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The ending dips from open G to open D on string 4, then comes back.
rows.translation: Záver klesne z prázdneho G na prázdne D na strune 4 a potom sa vráti.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: James Lord Pierpont published this song in 1857 as One Horse Open Sleigh. You'll play its famous chorus, all on strings 1 and 2.
rows.translation: James Lord Pierpont vydal túto pieseň v roku 1857 pod názvom One Horse Open Sleigh. Zahráte jej známy refrén, celý na strunách 1 a 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Open E, G at fret 3, down to C and D on string 2, then home to E.
rows.translation: Prázdne E, G na pražci 3, nadol na C a D na strune 2 a potom domov na E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: In that phrase, C rings for a beat and a half and D slips in on the and of four. Count one, two, three, four-and.
rows.translation: V tejto fráze C znie jeden a pol doby a D sa pridá na „a“ po štvrtej. Počítajte raz, dva, tri, štyri-a.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The second line sits on F at fret 1, then settles onto open E.
rows.translation: Druhý riadok zotrvá na F na pražci 1 a potom sa usadí na prázdnom E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: This traditional spiritual became a jazz standard after Louis Armstrong recorded it in 1938. It uses C, D, E, F and G on strings 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Tento tradičný spirituál sa stal džezovým štandardom po nahrávke Louisa Armstronga z roku 1938. Používa C, D, E, F a G na strunách 2 a 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The opening: C on string 2, then E, F and G climbing string 1.
rows.translation: Úvod: C na strune 2, potom E, F a G nahor po strune 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: No new notes here: all six tunes from this unit, each a little faster than before. Name the opening by ear, then play.
rows.translation: Žiadne nové tóny: všetkých šesť melódií z tejto časti, každá trochu rýchlejšie než predtým. Spoznajte úvod podľa sluchu a potom hrajte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Campfire songs and a sea song, with easy chords to strum on the simplest ones.
rows.translation: Táborákové a námornícka pieseň; pri najľahších aj jednoduchý akordový sprievod.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Stephen Foster published this song in 1848, and gold seekers heading to California made it their anthem. The verse sits on strings 3, 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Stephen Foster vydal pieseň v roku 1848 a zlatokopi smerujúci do Kalifornie si ju zvolili za hymnu. Sloha leží na strunách 3, 2 a 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Open B, D at fret 3, open E, then back down to open G and A at fret 2.
rows.translation: Prázdne B, D na pražci 3, prázdne E, potom späť nadol na prázdne G a A na pražci 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The last bar: B B A A, then home to open G.
rows.translation: Posledný takt: B B A A, potom domov na prázdne G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: G sounds like home, and D7 pulls back toward it. The verse is three bars of G, one of D7, two of G, then D7 and G.
rows.translation: G znie ako domov a D7 k nemu priťahuje späť. Sloha má tri takty G, jeden D7, dva G a potom D7 a G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Stephen Foster wrote this racing song in 1850, two years after Oh! Susanna. It uses the same notes and the same two chords.
rows.translation: Stephen Foster napísal túto dostihovú pieseň v roku 1850, dva roky po Oh! Susanna. Používa rovnaké tóny aj rovnaké dva akordy.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: D D B D, up to open E, then D and B. Strings 2 and 1.
rows.translation: D D B D, nahor na prázdne E, potom D a B. Struny 2 a 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Twice in the first line, a quick B leads into an A that rings for three beats. Pick the A once and let it ring.
rows.translation: V prvom riadku dvakrát vedie rýchle B do A, ktoré znie tri doby. Brnknite na A raz a nechajte ho znieť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: This farmyard song was first printed in 1917, but people sang versions of it long before. Its tune reaches down to D and E on string 4.
rows.translation: Táto pieseň o farme prvýkrát vyšla tlačou v roku 1917, ale jej verzie sa spievali už dávno predtým. Melódia siaha nadol po D a E na strune 4.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Open G three times, down to open D, E at fret 2 on string 4, back to D.
rows.translation: Trikrát prázdne G, nadol na prázdne D, E na pražci 2 struny 4, späť na D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Then up: open B twice, A at fret 2 on string 3, and home to open G.
rows.translation: Potom nahor: dvakrát prázdne B, A na pražci 2 struny 3 a domov na prázdne G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Here each chord lasts two beats, so the strum counts one, two. The order is G, G, C, G, then G, D7, G, G. Change early.
rows.translation: Každý akord tu trvá dve doby, preto pri úderoch počítajte raz, dva. Poradie je G, G, C, G, potom G, D7, G, G. Zmenu pripravte včas.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: British soldiers first sang this tune to mock American colonists. By the end of the Revolution, the Americans had made it their own.
rows.translation: Britskí vojaci túto melódiu najprv spievali na posmech americkým kolonistom. Do konca revolúcie ju Američania prijali za svoju.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: C C D E, C E D, then a drop to open G on string 3.
rows.translation: C C D E, C E D, potom pokles na prázdne G na strune 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The first half ends on B. How does that feel?
rows.translation: Prvá polovica končí na B. Aký to vyvoláva dojem?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: B sits just below C and leans toward it. The second half answers by landing on C.
rows.translation: B leží tesne pod C a smeruje k nemu. Druhá polovica odpovie tým, že pristane na C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The last line: down from F on string 1, dip to open G, then climb back to C.
rows.translation: Posledný riadok: nadol z F na strune 1, pokles na prázdne G a potom výstup späť na C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The chorus sits low: A at fret 2 on string 3, open B, then F and E on string 4 and C on string 5.
rows.translation: Refrén je nízko: A na pražci 2 struny 3, prázdne B, potom F a E na strune 4 a C na strune 5.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: George Poulton published this ballad in 1861. Nearly a century later, its melody became the tune of Love Me Tender.
rows.translation: George Poulton vydal túto baladu v roku 1861. Takmer o storočie neskôr sa jej melódia stala nápevom Love Me Tender.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Up to C, down to open B and back, then D, a dip to A, and D again.
rows.translation: Nahor na C, nadol na prázdne B a späť, potom D, pokles na A a znova D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Aura Lee is a slow ballad. Keep each finger down until the next note sounds, so the notes join smoothly.
rows.translation: Aura Lee je pomalá balada. Každý prst držte na mieste až do ďalšieho tónu, aby sa tóny plynulo spájali.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The high part: open E, F at fret 1, then down to D, A, and D again.
rows.translation: Vysoká časť: prázdne E, F na pražci 1, potom nadol na D, A a znova D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: This song from the north of England is about Bobby Shafto, gone to sea. Its words were in print by 1805, and fiddlers played its tune for dances by 1770.
rows.translation: Táto pieseň zo severu Anglicka je o Bobbym Shaftovi, ktorý odišiel na more. Text bol vytlačený už v roku 1805 a huslisti hrali melódiu do tanca už v roku 1770.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Open B, D at fret 3, back to B and open G, then B, D and B again.
rows.translation: Prázdne B, D na pražci 3, späť na B a prázdne G, potom znova B, D a B.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The second line dips to F sharp: string 4, fret 4, with your little finger. Keep your hand over the first four frets so it's ready.
rows.translation: Druhý riadok klesá na Fis: struna 4, pražec 4, malíčkom. Ruku držte nad prvými štyrmi pražcami, aby bola pripravená.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, C at fret 1 on string 2, A, down to F sharp, and back up.
rows.translation: A na pražci 2 struny 3, C na pražci 1 struny 2, A, nadol na Fis a späť nahor.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The first three lines end the same way: two notes of one beat, then one of two beats. Gone to sea, on his knee, marry me.
rows.translation: Prvé tri riadky končia rovnako: dva tóny po jednej dobe, potom jeden na dve doby. Gone to sea, on his knee, marry me.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The verse needs only the two chords from Oh! Susanna: two bars of G, two of D7, two of G, then D7 and G.
rows.translation: Sloha potrebuje iba dva akordy z Oh! Susanna: dva takty G, dva D7, dva G a potom D7 a G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: No new notes or chords: all six songs from this unit, one after another, each a little faster than before.
rows.translation: Žiadne nové tóny ani akordy: všetkých šesť piesní z tejto časti za sebou, každá trochu rýchlejšie než predtým.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Famous themes by Pachelbel, Dvořák, Brahms, Petzold, Grieg and Beethoven, in first position.
rows.translation: Známe témy Pachelbela, Dvořáka, Brahmsa, Petzolda, Griega a Beethovena v prvej polohe.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Johann Pachelbel wrote this canon over 300 years ago. Its bass repeats the same eight notes the whole way through while violins weave melodies above.
rows.translation: Johann Pachelbel napísal tento kánon pred vyše 300 rokmi. Bas opakuje stále tých istých osem tónov, zatiaľ čo husle nad ním splietajú melódie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The bass, moved up an octave: D, A, B, F sharp, G, D, G, A.
rows.translation: Bas posunutý o oktávu vyššie: D, A, B, Fis, G, D, G, A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: What does the bass do all through the Canon?
rows.translation: Čo robí bas počas celého kánonu?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Plays a new tune each time
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A repeating bass like this is called a ground. Everything else in the piece is built on top of it.
rows.translation: Takýto opakujúci sa bas sa nazýva ostinátny bas. Všetko ostatné v skladbe je postavené nad ním.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A sharp is one fret above its letter. The melody uses C sharp on string 2, fret 2, and F sharp on string 4, fret 4. Reach that one with your little finger.
rows.translation: Krížik zvyšuje tón o jeden pražec. Melódia používa Cis na strune 2, pražci 2, a Fis na strune 4, pražci 4. Na Fis dosiahnite malíčkom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The first violin line: down from F sharp on string 1, then back up to C sharp.
rows.translation: Prvý husľový hlas: nadol z Fis na strune 1, potom späť nahor na Cis.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Antonín Dvořák wrote this theme for English horn in 1893, in his Symphony From the New World, while he was living in New York.
rows.translation: Antonín Dvořák napísal túto tému pre anglický roh v roku 1893 do symfónie Z nového sveta, keď žil v New Yorku.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Open E, G at fret 3 on string 1, back to E, then D and C on string 2.
rows.translation: Prázdne E, G na pražci 3 struny 1, späť na E, potom D a C na strune 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Most bars open with a long note and a quick one. Count one, two-and, three: the quick note lands on the and of two.
rows.translation: Väčšina taktov začína dlhým a rýchlym tónom. Počítajte raz, dva-a, tri: rýchly tón padne na „a“ po dva.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The ending: D, E, D, then settle on C and let it ring.
rows.translation: Záver: D, E, D, potom sa usaďte na C a nechajte ho znieť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Johannes Brahms wrote this lullaby in 1868 for a friend's newborn son. It sways in three, like a cradle: a long note, then two quick ones.
rows.translation: Johannes Brahms napísal túto uspávanku v roku 1868 pre novonarodeného syna priateľky. Kolíše sa na tri ako kolíska: dlhý tón a dva rýchle.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The opening rocks between open B and D at fret 3 on string 2.
rows.translation: Úvod kolíše medzi prázdnym B a D na pražci 3 struny 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Open G on string 3, then the same note an octave higher: G at fret 3 on string 1.
rows.translation: Prázdne G na strune 3, potom rovnaký tón o oktávu vyššie: G na pražci 3 struny 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: This minuet appears in a 1725 notebook Bach gave his wife, Anna Magdalena. Scholars now credit it to his fellow composer Christian Petzold.
rows.translation: Tento menuet je v zošite z roku 1725, ktorý Bach daroval manželke Anne Magdalene. Dnes ho bádatelia pripisujú jeho kolegovi Christianovi Petzoldovi.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, then climb from open G: A, B, C, D. Then two open Gs.
rows.translation: D na pražci 3 struny 2, potom stúpajte od prázdneho G: A, B, C, D. Potom dve prázdne G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A minuet is a dance in three. Most bars start with a long beat, then quick pairs: one, two-and, three-and.
rows.translation: Menuet je tanec na tri. Väčšina taktov začína dlhou dobou a pokračuje rýchlymi dvojicami: raz, dva-a, tri-a.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Open E, back to C and D on string 2, then E, F sharp and G on string 1.
rows.translation: Prázdne E, späť na C a D na strune 2, potom E, Fis a G na strune 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The ending: A B A G, then F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, and home to G.
rows.translation: Záver: A B A G, potom Fis na pražci 4 struny 4 a domov na G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The second section starts low: open B, A, open D, then C sharp at fret 4 and B at fret 2 on string 5, and open A.
rows.translation: Druhá časť začína nízko: prázdne B, A, prázdne D, potom Cis na pražci 4 a B na pražci 2 struny 5 a prázdne A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: In the Hall of the Mountain King
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Grieg wrote this for the play Peer Gynt in 1875. It pictures trolls in their king's hall, and it starts quietly and keeps speeding up.
rows.translation: Grieg napísal túto skladbu pre hru Peer Gynt v roku 1875. Zobrazuje trollov v sieni ich kráľa; začína potichu a stále sa zrýchľuje.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Climb from open string 6: F sharp at fret 2, G at fret 3, open A, B at fret 2.
rows.translation: Stúpajte od prázdnej struny 6: Fis na pražci 2, G na pražci 3, prázdne A, B na pražci 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The creeping part: A sharp at fret 1 on string 5, then open A with F at fret 1 on string 6.
rows.translation: Plazivá časť: Ais na pražci 1 struny 5, potom prázdne A s F na pražci 1 struny 6.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Where is A sharp on string 5?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A sharp is one fret above A, and A is open string 5. So A sharp is fret 1.
rows.translation: Ais je jeden pražec nad A a A je prázdna struna 5. Preto je Ais na pražci 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Beethoven wrote this piano piece in 1810, but it wasn't published until 1867, forty years after he died. This simplified version keeps the famous opening.
rows.translation: Beethoven napísal túto klavírnu skladbu v roku 1810, ale vyšla až v roku 1867, štyridsať rokov po jeho smrti. Táto jednoduchšia verzia zachováva slávny úvod.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Rock between open E and D sharp at fret 4 on string 2, then walk down B, D, C to A.
rows.translation: Kolíšte medzi prázdnym E a Dis na pražci 4 struny 2, potom klesajte cez B, D, C na A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Each bar has three beats. After the long A comes a short rest, then three quick notes climb: C, E, A. Lift your finger for the rest, but keep counting.
rows.translation: Každý takt má tri doby. Po dlhom A príde krátka pomlčka a potom stúpajú tri rýchle tóny: C, E, A. Na pomlčku zdvihnite prst, ale počítajte ďalej.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A, then C on string 5, E and A. Then B, E, G sharp at fret 1 on string 3, and B.
rows.translation: A, potom C na strune 5, E a A. Potom B, E, Gis na pražci 1 struny 3 a B.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The middle: each phrase dips to a low note, then steps down. E G F E, D F E D, C E D C.
rows.translation: Stred: každá fráza klesne k nízkemu tónu a potom zostupuje po krokoch. E G F E, D F E D, C E D C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: No new notes: the six themes from this unit, from Pachelbel to Beethoven, each a little faster than before.
rows.translation: Žiadne nové tóny: šesť tém z tejto časti od Pachelbela po Beethovena, každá trochu rýchlejšie než predtým.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which of these pieces is in three?
rows.translation: Ktorá z týchto skladieb je na tri?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A minuet is a dance in three. The Canon and the trolls' march both count in four.
rows.translation: Menuet je tanec na tri. Kánon aj pochod trollov počítajú na štyri.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A Gold Rush ballad, two beloved hymns and a Shaker song from America's songbook.
rows.translation: Balada zo zlatej horúčky, dve obľúbené duchovné piesne a pieseň shakerov z amerického spevníka.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: This American song was published in 1884 and looks back to the California Gold Rush of 1849. It's in three, on strings 3, 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Táto americká pieseň vyšla v roku 1884 a obzerá sa za kalifornskou zlatou horúčkou z roku 1849. Je na tri, na strunách 3, 2 a 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Clementine starts with two quick notes before beat one. What are they called?
rows.translation: Clementine začína dvoma rýchlymi tónmi pred prvou dobou. Ako sa nazývajú?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A pickup is a few notes that lead into the first strong beat. Here they fall on the and of beat three.
rows.translation: Predtaktie je niekoľko tónov vedúcich k prvej ťažkej dobe. Tu pripadajú na „a“ po tretej dobe.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The turn in the middle: G at fret 3 on string 1, down to D, then back up to F.
rows.translation: Obrat uprostred: G na pražci 3 struny 1, nadol na D, potom späť nahor na F.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.translation: Text z roku 1779, melódia z roku 1829
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: John Newton wrote the words in 1779. The tune, called New Britain, was first printed in 1829 and joined to his words in 1835.
rows.translation: John Newton napísal text v roku 1779. Melódia s názvom New Britain prvýkrát vyšla v roku 1829 a s jeho textom sa spojila v roku 1835.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The high line: up to D at fret 3 on string 2, then B G, B A, G E D.
rows.translation: Vysoký riadok: nahor na D na pražci 3 struny 2, potom B G, B A, G E D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Samuel Francis Smith wrote these American words in 1831, to a tune Britain already sang as God Save the King.
rows.translation: Samuel Francis Smith napísal tento americký text v roku 1831 na melódiu, ktorú už Británia spievala ako God Save the King.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A dot makes a note half again as long. In bar two, F sharp rings for a beat and a half, G slips in on the and of two, and A lands on three.
rows.translation: Bodka predĺži notu o polovicu. V druhom takte Fis znie jeden a pol doby, G sa pridá na „a“ po druhej a A padne na tretiu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The last line: B C B A G, then B C D, up to open E, and down C B A G.
rows.translation: Posledný riadok: B C B A G, potom B C D, nahor na prázdne E a nadol C B A G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Joseph Brackett wrote Simple Gifts in 1848 for the Shakers, who danced as they sang. Aaron Copland later built part of his ballet Appalachian Spring around it.
rows.translation: Joseph Brackett napísal Simple Gifts v roku 1848 pre shakerov, ktorí pri speve tancovali. Aaron Copland neskôr na nej vystaval časť baletu Apalačská jar.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The second part starts high: G at fret 3 on string 1, then E D, and E F E D C.
rows.translation: Druhá časť začína vysoko: G na pražci 3 struny 1, potom E D a E F E D C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Two notes share each beat in this tune. How do you count them?
rows.translation: O každú dobu sa v tejto melódii delia dve noty. Ako ich počítate?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Two even notes per beat are eighth notes. Say the number on the first and "and" on the second.
rows.translation: Dve rovnaké noty na dobu sú osminové noty. Pri prvej povedzte číslo a pri druhej „a“.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: No new ideas: the four songs from this unit, each a little faster than before. Three of them sway in three. Simple Gifts dances in four.
rows.translation: Žiadne nové postupy: štyri piesne z tejto časti, každá trochu rýchlejšie než predtým. Tri sa kolíšu na tri. Simple Gifts tancuje na štyri.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: What does a dot after a note do?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Makes it half again as long
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A dotted quarter lasts a beat and a half. The note after it is usually quick, to fill out the beat.
rows.translation: Štvrťová s bodkou trvá jeden a pol doby. Nasledujúca nota býva krátka, aby doplnila dobu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Carols and a New Year's song, in two, three, four and six.
rows.translation: Koledy a novoročná pieseň na dve, tri, štyri a šesť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: This tune was printed in 1582 in Piae Cantiones, a songbook from Finland, as a song about spring. John Mason Neale gave it Christmas words in 1853.
rows.translation: Táto melódia vyšla v roku 1582 vo fínskom spevníku Piae Cantiones ako pieseň o jari. John Mason Neale jej dal vianočný text v roku 1853.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The last line climbs from open D on string 4: E, F sharp at fret 4, open G, then A.
rows.translation: Posledný riadok stúpa od prázdneho D na strune 4: E, Fis na pražci 4, prázdne G a potom A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Then from D at fret 3 on string 2, step down to G, touch C, and land on G.
rows.translation: Potom od D na pražci 3 struny 2 klesajte po krokoch na G, dotknite sa C a pristaňte na G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Deck the Halls comes from Nos Galan, a Welsh New Year's Eve song from the 1700s. The English words came in 1862.
rows.translation: Deck the Halls pochádza z Nos Galan, waleskej silvestrovskej piesne zo storočia po roku 1700. Anglický text vznikol v roku 1862.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The third line climbs: C sharp at fret 2 on string 2, D, then E, F sharp and G on string 1.
rows.translation: Tretí riadok stúpa: Cis na pražci 2 struny 2, D, potom E, Fis a G na strune 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A7 needs two fingers on fret 2: finger 1 on string 4, finger 3 on string 2. Start your strum on string 5. That C sharp on string 2 is the one the melody climbs through.
rows.translation: A7 potrebuje dva prsty na pražci 2: prst 1 na strune 4, prst 3 na strune 2. Úder začnite na strune 5. Cis na strune 2 je tón, cez ktorý stúpa melódia.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: We Wish You a Merry Christmas
rows.translation: We Wish You a Merry Christmas
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: This carol comes from England's West Country, where singers went door to door on winter nights and hoped for a treat in return.
rows.translation: Táto koleda pochádza z anglického regiónu West Country, kde speváci za zimných nocí chodili od dverí k dverám a dúfali v odmenu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2 and open string 4 are both D. How far apart are they?
rows.translation: D na pražci 3 struny 2 aj prázdna struna 4 sú D. Aká je medzi nimi vzdialenosť?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: An octave is the same letter, eight steps higher or lower. The two Ds blend, but one sounds brighter.
rows.translation: Oktáva má rovnaké písmeno o osem stupňov vyššie alebo nižšie vrátane krajných. Obe D splývajú, ale jedno znie jasnejšie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: B A G, then leap from D at fret 3 on string 2 down to open D. Then E, A, F sharp, G.
rows.translation: B A G, potom skok z D na pražci 3 struny 2 nadol na prázdne D. Potom E, A, Fis, G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Auld lang syne is Scots for old long since, meaning days gone by. Robert Burns sent the words to a songbook in 1788, and this melody was printed with them in 1799.
rows.translation: Auld lang syne znamená v škótčine dávne časy. Robert Burns poslal text do spevníka v roku 1788 a táto melódia s ním vyšla v roku 1799.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The chorus reaches up: B, D, open E, then G at fret 3 on string 1. Back down: D, B B G.
rows.translation: Refrén siaha nahor: B, D, prázdne E, potom G na pražci 3 struny 1. Späť nadol: D, B B G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Lowell Mason arranged this tune in 1839, borrowing phrases from Handel's Messiah. It opens with a G major scale, straight down from G to G.
rows.translation: Lowell Mason upravil túto melódiu v roku 1839 a požičal si frázy z Händelovho Mesiáša. Začína stupnicou G dur priamo nadol od G po G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: This carol counts in two. In bar one, G fills beat one, F sharp takes most of beat two, and E slips in at the very end.
rows.translation: Táto koleda sa počíta na dve. V prvom takte G vyplní prvú dobu, Fis zaberie väčšinu druhej a E sa pridá až na samom konci.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The middle repeats open B and steps up to D, then repeats A at fret 2 on string 3 and steps up to C.
rows.translation: Stred opakuje prázdne B a stúpa na D, potom opakuje A na pražci 2 struny 3 a stúpa na C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Franz Xaver Gruber wrote Silent Night in 1818 for Christmas Eve in Oberndorf, Austria. At its first performance, the only accompaniment was a guitar.
rows.translation: Franz Xaver Gruber napísal Tichú noc v roku 1818 na Štedrý večer v rakúskom Oberndorfe. Pri prvom uvedení ju sprevádzala iba gitara.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Silent Night is in 6/8: six quick counts per bar, grouped one-two-three, four-five-six. Each group sways like one slow beat.
rows.translation: Tichá noc je v 6/8: šesť rýchlych počítaní v takte, zoskupených raz-dva-tri, štyri-päť-šesť. Každá skupina sa kolíše ako jedna pomalá doba.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The ending climbs to G at fret 3 on string 1, rings on F sharp, then walks down to open D.
rows.translation: Záver stúpa na G na pražci 3 struny 1, zaznie na Fis a potom klesá po krokoch na prázdne D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: D uses the top four strings. Finger 1 on string 3, fret 2; finger 2 on string 1, fret 2; finger 3 on string 2, fret 3. Strum from open string 4.
rows.translation: D používa štyri najtenšie struny. Prst 1 na strune 3, pražci 2; prst 2 na strune 1, pražci 2; prst 3 na strune 2, pražci 3. Hrajte od prázdnej struny 4.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Joseph Mohr (1818), English by John Freeman Young (1859)
rows.translation: Joseph Mohr (1818), anglický text John Freeman Young (1859)
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: No new ideas: six songs in two, three, four and six, each a little faster than before. Feel where every bar begins.
rows.translation: Žiadne nové postupy: šesť piesní na dve, tri, štyri a šesť, každá trochu rýchlejšie než predtým. Vnímajte začiatok každého taktu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Silent Night is in 6/8. How are its six counts grouped?
rows.translation: Tichá noc je v 6/8. Ako je zoskupených jej šesť osmín?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: 6/8 sways in two big beats, each split into three: one-two-three, four-five-six.
rows.translation: 6/8 sa kolíše v dvoch veľkých dobách, každá sa delí na tri: raz-dva-tri, štyri-päť-šesť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Two Mozart themes and two old airs: rests, minor keys, a wide range and third position.
rows.translation: Dve Mozartove témy a dve staré melódie: pomlčky, molové tóniny, široký rozsah a tretia poloha.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Mozart finished this serenade for strings in 1787. Its opening leaps up through the notes of a G chord, then answers with the notes of D7.
rows.translation: Mozart dokončil túto serenádu pre sláčiky v roku 1787. Úvod skáče nahor po tónoch akordu G a potom odpovedá tónmi D7.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A rest is a silent beat. Touch the string with your fretting fingers so the silence is crisp, then come back in exactly on time.
rows.translation: Pomlčka je tichá doba. Dotknite sa struny prstami hmatovej ruky, aby bolo ticho zreteľné, a potom nastúpte presne načas.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The answer: C at fret 1 on string 2, A at fret 2 on string 3, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, then open D.
rows.translation: Odpoveď: C na pražci 1 struny 2, A na pražci 2 struny 3, Fis na pražci 4 struny 4, potom prázdne D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The opening climbs through a chord. Major or minor?
rows.translation: Úvod stúpa po tónoch akordu. Dur alebo mol?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Greensleeves was sung in England by the 1580s, and Shakespeare mentions it in The Merry Wives of Windsor. Here it's in E minor, low and dark.
rows.translation: Greensleeves sa v Anglicku spievala už v desaťročí od roku 1580 a Shakespeare ju spomína vo Veselých paničkách windsorských. Tu je v E mol, nízka a temná.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: In E minor, D sharp sits one fret below E and pulls toward it. Find D sharp at string 4, fret 1, and C sharp at string 5, fret 4.
rows.translation: V E mol leží Dis jeden pražec pod E a priťahuje k nemu. Nájdite Dis na strune 4, pražci 1, a Cis na strune 5, pražci 4.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Each half ends: G, F sharp, E, then D sharp, C sharp, D sharp, and home to E.
rows.translation: Každá polovica končí: G, Fis, E, potom Dis, Cis, Dis a domov na E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The chorus starts high: D at fret 3 on string 2, C sharp at fret 2, open B, then down to open D.
rows.translation: Refrén začína vysoko: D na pražci 3 struny 2, Cis na pražci 2, prázdne B, potom nadol na prázdne D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Greensleeves is built on this chord. Major or minor?
rows.translation: Greensleeves stojí na tomto akorde. Dur alebo mol?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: This melody was first printed in George Petrie's collection of Irish music in 1855. The words of Danny Boy were set to it much later, in 1913.
rows.translation: Táto melódia prvýkrát vyšla v zbierke írskej hudby Georgea Petrieho v roku 1855. Text Danny Boy k nej pribudol oveľa neskôr, v roku 1913.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The high point: three As, up to F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, then E E D B D, A F sharp D.
rows.translation: Vrchol: tri A, nahor na Fis na pražci 2 struny 1, potom E E D B D, A Fis D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: This tune runs from string 5 to string 1. What keeps every string in reach?
rows.translation: Táto melódia vedie od struny 5 po strunu 1. Čo pomáha dosiahnuť na všetky struny?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: With your thumb low behind the neck, your fingers arch and reach from string 5 to string 1 without straining.
rows.translation: S palcom nízko za krkom sa prsty vyklenú a bez námahy dosiahnu od struny 5 po strunu 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Mozart finished his Symphony No. 40 in 1788. It's one of only two symphonies he wrote in a minor key, and it opens with this restless, sighing theme.
rows.translation: Mozart dokončil symfóniu č. 40 v roku 1788. Je jednou iba z dvoch jeho molových symfónií a začína touto nepokojnou, vzdychajúcou témou.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Slide your hand up so finger 1 rests at fret 3. Each finger now covers one fret: 3, 4, 5 and 6. Move your thumb up too, behind finger 2.
rows.translation: Posuňte ruku nahor tak, aby prst 1 spočíval na pražci 3. Každý prst teraz pokrýva jeden pražec: 3, 4, 5 a 6. Posuňte aj palec, za prst 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: In third position, which finger plays fret 3?
rows.translation: Ktorý prst hrá v tretej polohe pražec 3?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A position is named for where finger 1 sits. In third position, finger 1 plays fret 3 and finger 4 reaches fret 6.
rows.translation: Poloha sa volá podľa miesta prsta 1. V tretej polohe hrá prst 1 pražec 3 a prst 4 dosiahne na pražec 6.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: E flat at fret 4 and D at fret 3 on string 2, then finger 4 up to B flat at fret 6 on string 1.
rows.translation: Es na pražci 4 a D na pražci 3 struny 2, potom prst 4 nahor na znížené B na pražci 6 struny 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The last phrase: F sharp, reaching finger 1 back to fret 2. Then E flat, D, C at fret 5 on string 3, and B flat.
rows.translation: Posledná fráza: Fis, prst 1 natiahnite späť na pražec 2. Potom Es, D, C na pražci 5 struny 3 a znížené B.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: No new ideas: two Mozart themes, two old airs and third position, each a little faster than before. Breathe between pieces.
rows.translation: Žiadne nové postupy: dve Mozartove témy, dve staré melódie a tretia poloha, všetko trochu rýchlejšie než predtým. Medzi skladbami sa nadýchnite.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: In E minor, which note leans up into E?
rows.translation: Ktorý tón v E mol smeruje nahor do E?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: D sharp sits one fret below E. That half step pulls hard toward home, which is why Greensleeves uses it at every cadence.
rows.translation: Dis leží jeden pražec pod E. Tento poltón silno priťahuje domov, preto ho Greensleeves používa v každej kadencii.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Five new songs on the open chords you know: campfire pop, a ballad, stomp-folk, reggae and country.
rows.translation: Päť nových piesní na známych otvorených akordoch: táborákový pop, balada, dupavý folk, reggae a country.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Kite Weather is bright, easy pop: four chords on a loop, G, D, E minor and C, at a relaxed 88 beats per minute. Listen for the hook jumping up to F sharp in its second bar.
rows.translation: Počasie na šarkany je jasný, ľahký pop: štyri akordy v slučke, G, D, E mol a C, pri uvoľnených 88 dobách za minútu. Všímajte si skok motívu na Fis v druhom takte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Does the hook climb or fall at first?
rows.translation: Motív na začiatku stúpa alebo klesá?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open B and back, then open E and F sharp at fret 2 on string 1.
rows.translation: D na pražci 3 struny 2, prázdne B a späť, potom prázdne E a Fis na pražci 2 struny 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Porchlight drifts along at 70 beats per minute. A ballad is a slow song that tells a story, so give every chord room to ring. Listen for the long note that closes each line.
rows.translation: Svetlo na verande plynie pri 70 dobách za minútu. Balada je pomalá pieseň rozprávajúca príbeh, preto nechajte každý akord doznieť. Všímajte si dlhý tón na konci každého riadka.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Does this phrase end at home?
rows.translation: Končí táto fráza na domovskom tóne?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The chorus climbs string 1: open E, F sharp at fret 2, G at fret 3, then steps back down to D.
rows.translation: Refrén stúpa po strune 1: prázdne E, Fis na pražci 2, G na pražci 3, potom klesá po krokoch späť na D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Moth and Ember is the kind of song a whole room stomps along to: heavy downstrokes, a chant of a hook, 96 beats per minute. It starts dark in A minor and brightens on D.
rows.translation: Moľa a uhlík je pieseň, pri ktorej dupe celá miestnosť: ťažké údery nadol, skandovaný motív, 96 dôb za minútu. Začína temne v A mol a rozjasní sa na D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Climb A minor: A at fret 2 on string 3, C at fret 1 on string 2, open E. Then step back down.
rows.translation: Stúpajte po A mol: A na pražci 2 struny 3, C na pražci 1 struny 2, prázdne E. Potom späť nadol po krokoch.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The hook's second bar copies the first, a few notes higher. What is that called?
rows.translation: Druhý takt motívu opakuje prvý o niekoľko tónov vyššie. Ako sa to volá?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A sequence repeats a melodic shape from a new starting note. It makes a hook easy to remember.
rows.translation: Sekvencia opakuje melodický tvar z nového počiatočného tónu. Vďaka nej sa motív ľahko pamätá.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Low Tide Radio is laid-back reggae at 80 beats per minute. The guitar plays only on the and of each beat, a short chop called a skank, while bass and drums hold the beat.
rows.translation: Rádio pri odlive je uvoľnené reggae pri 80 dobách za minútu. Gitara hrá len na „a“ každej doby krátky tlmený úder nazývaný skank, kým basgitara a bicie držia doby.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Strum down on each and, then ease your fretting fingers off the strings so the chord stops. Chk, chk, chk, chk. The silence between chops is half the groove.
rows.translation: Hrajte nadol na každé „a“, potom uvoľnite prsty na strunách, aby akord stíchol. Čk, čk, čk, čk. Ticho medzi údermi tvorí polovicu rytmického pocitu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, C sharp at fret 2, open B, then A at fret 2 on string 3.
rows.translation: Prázdne E, D na pražci 3 struny 2, Cis na pražci 2, prázdne B, potom A na pražci 2 struny 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Dust on the Dashboard rolls along at 100 beats per minute. Country players split the bar: boom, a bass note on beats one and three, then chick, a strum on two and four.
rows.translation: Prach na palubnej doske plynie pri 100 dobách za minútu. Country hráči delia takt: bum, basový tón na prvej a tretej dobe, potom čik, úder na druhej a štvrtej.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: On boom, pick only the chord's lowest note, its root: open string 5 for A, open string 4 for D, open string 6 for E. On chick, brush the thinner strings.
rows.translation: Na bum brnknite iba najnižší, základný tón akordu: prázdna struna 5 pre A, struna 4 pre D, struna 6 pre E. Na čik prejdite tenšie struny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which string is the boom for a D chord?
rows.translation: Ktorá struna hrá bum pri akorde D?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: D's root is open string 4, the same string a D strum starts from.
rows.translation: Základný tón D je prázdna struna 4, tá istá, od ktorej začína úder akordu D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, open B, C sharp at fret 2 on string 2, then open E and F sharp at fret 2.
rows.translation: A na pražci 2 struny 3, prázdne B, Cis na pražci 2 struny 2, potom prázdne E a Fis na pražci 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: No new chords or notes: the five songs from this unit, each a touch faster. Name each hook by ear, then play.
rows.translation: Žiadne nové akordy ani tóny: päť piesní z tejto časti, každá o trochu rýchlejšie. Spoznajte každý motív podľa sluchu a potom hrajte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which song's hook starts like this?
rows.translation: Motív ktorej piesne sa začína takto?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: In reggae, where does the guitar chop?
rows.translation: Kde hrá gitara tlmené údery v reggae?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: On the and of each beat
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The skank lands between the beats, while bass and drums hold the downbeats.
rows.translation: Skank padá medzi doby, zatiaľ čo basgitara a bicie držia hlavné doby.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Five songs on three chords each: a campfire chorus, a country two-step, a waltz, easy reggae and bedroom pop.
rows.translation: Päť trojakordových piesní: táborákový refrén, country two-step, valčík, ľahké reggae a izbový pop.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Lantern Hill is a campfire song on three chords, G, C and D, at 92 beats per minute. The chorus is made for a crowd, so by the second time around, sing it out.
rows.translation: Lampášový vrch je táboráková pieseň na troch akordoch G, C a D pri 92 dobách za minútu. Refrén je pre celý dav, preto ho pri druhom opakovaní zaspievajte naplno.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, open E again, then G at fret 3 on string 1 and back down.
rows.translation: Prázdne E, D na pražci 3 struny 2, znova prázdne E, potom G na pražci 3 struny 1 a späť nadol.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Gravel Road Two-Step is dance-hall country in A at 116 beats per minute. Pick the root on one and three, strum on two and four, and add a quick up after each strum.
rows.translation: Two-step na štrkovej ceste je tanečné country v A dur pri 116 dobách za minútu. Na prvej a tretej brnknite základný tón, na druhej a štvrtej akord a po ňom pridajte rýchly úder nahor.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: In a two-step, where do the bass notes fall?
rows.translation: Na ktoré doby padajú basové tóny v two-stepe?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The bass walks with the dancers' feet on one and three; the strums fill two and four.
rows.translation: Bas kráča s nohami tanečníkov na prvej a tretej; údery akordov vyplnia druhú a štvrtú.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, then C sharp at fret 2 and A on string 3.
rows.translation: Fis na pražci 2 struny 1, prázdne E, D na pražci 3 struny 2, potom Cis na pražci 2 a A na strune 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: First Frost counts in three at 108 beats per minute: one, two, three, with the weight on one. D, G and A carry it all, and every line ends on a long, held note.
rows.translation: Prvý mráz sa počíta na tri pri 108 dobách za minútu: raz, dva, tri, s dôrazom na raz. Všetko nesú D, G a A a každý riadok končí dlhým držaným tónom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1, D at fret 3 on string 2, twice. Then E, F sharp at fret 2, E, D and A.
rows.translation: G na pražci 3 struny 1, D na pražci 3 struny 2, dvakrát. Potom E, Fis na pražci 2, E, D a A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Hammock Season is easy reggae in C at 76 beats per minute. The guitar plays only on beats two and four: one short, bright upstroke on the top strings, then silence.
