rows.translation: Sezóna hojdacích sietí je ľahké reggae v C dur pri 76 dobách za minútu. Gitara hrá len na druhej a štvrtej: jeden krátky jasný úder nahor po tenkých strunách, potom ticho.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Brush up across strings 1 to 3, then relax your fretting hand so the chord stops at once. Chk on two, chk on four. The quiet beats are what make it sway.
rows.translation: Prejdite nahor po strunách 1 až 3 a uvoľnite hmatovú ruku, aby akord hneď stíchol. Čk na druhej, čk na štvrtej. Práve tiché doby vytvárajú kolísanie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Glow-in-the-Dark Stars is soft bedroom pop at 84 beats per minute: E minor, C and G, strummed light. Most lines start just after the beat, so let them float in.
rows.translation: Hviezdy svietiace v tme je jemný izbový pop pri 84 dobách za minútu: E mol, C a G s ľahkými údermi. Väčšina riadkov začína tesne po dobe; nechajte ich voľne vplávať.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Open E twice, G at fret 3 on string 1, open E, G again, then D at fret 3 on string 2.
rows.translation: Dvakrát prázdne E, G na pražci 3 struny 1, prázdne E, znova G, potom D na pražci 3 struny 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: E minor, C and G share one note. Which?
rows.translation: E mol, C a G majú spoločný tón. Ktorý?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: E minor is E, G and B; C is C, E and G; G is G, B and D. G sits in all three, so the changes feel smooth.
rows.translation: E mol tvorí E, G a B; C tvorí C, E a G; G tvorí G, B a D. G je vo všetkých troch, preto zmeny pôsobia plynulo.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: In reggae, where does the guitar play?
rows.translation: Na ktorých dobách hrá gitara v reggae?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Reggae's guitar answers the beat: a short upstroke on two and four, silence in between.
rows.translation: Reggae gitara odpovedá na dobu: krátky úder nahor na druhej a štvrtej, medzi nimi ticho.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The four-chord loop five ways: two summer anthems, a roller-rink bop, a pop song in 6/8 and a stadium chorus.
rows.translation: Štyri akordy päťkrát inak: dve letné hymny, pop na korčule, pieseň v 6/8 a štadiónový refrén.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Sparkler Season rides the most famous loop in pop: C, G, A minor and F, the one, five, six and four of C. Hundreds of hits share these chords; a new tune and new words make each one its own.
rows.translation: Sezóna prskaviek stojí na najslávnejšej popovej slučke: C, G, A mol a F, prvý, piaty, šiesty a štvrtý stupeň C dur. Majú ich stovky hitov; každý odlišuje nová melódia a text.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The mini F covers strings 4 to 1: finger 1 flat across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1, finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, finger 3 on string 4, fret 3.
rows.translation: Malé F pokrýva struny 4 až 1: prst 1 naplocho cez struny 2 a 1 na pražci 1, prst 2 na strune 3, pražci 2, prst 3 na strune 4, pražci 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Roller Rink is bright dance pop at 120 beats per minute: G, E minor, C and D, the one, six, four and five. Strum even eighths and feel the kick drum land on every beat.
rows.translation: Korčuliarsky parket je jasný tanečný pop pri 120 dobách za minútu: G, E mol, C a D, prvý, šiesty, štvrtý a piaty stupeň. Hrajte rovné osminy a vnímajte veľký bubon na každej dobe.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open E, G at fret 3 on string 1 three times, F sharp at fret 2, open E.
rows.translation: D na pražci 3 struny 2, prázdne E, trikrát G na pražci 3 struny 1, Fis na pražci 2, prázdne E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Echo Canyon plays E minor, C, G and D at 80 beats per minute. Big strum on one, let it ring, then build on three and four. The half-time beat makes it feel huge.
rows.translation: Kaňon ozvien hrá E mol, C, G a D pri 80 dobách za minútu. Silný úder na prvú, nechať znieť, potom stupňovať na tretej a štvrtej. Pocit polovičného tempa mu dáva veľkosť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Kite Weather plays G, D, E minor and C. Echo Canyon plays E minor, C, G and D. What changed?
rows.translation: Počasie na šarkany hrá G, D, E mol a C. Kaňon ozvien hrá E mol, C, G a D. Čo sa zmenilo?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Same four chords, same key. Starting on E minor puts the sad chord first, so the loop sounds darker.
rows.translation: Rovnaké štyri akordy, rovnaká tónina. Začiatok na E mol kladie smutný akord na prvé miesto, preto slučka znie temnejšie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1 and open E, twice. Then G again and D at fret 3 on string 2, twice.
rows.translation: G na pražci 3 struny 1 a prázdne E, dvakrát. Potom znova G a D na pražci 3 struny 2, dvakrát.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Open Windows sways in 6/8 at 120 counts a minute: six quick counts felt as two big swings. C, F, A minor and G roll under a chorus that opens wide.
rows.translation: Otvorené okná sa kolíšu v 6/8 pri 120 počítaniach za minútu: šesť rýchlych počítaní cítených ako dve veľké hojdania. C, F, A mol a G plynú pod široko otvoreným refrénom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: C at fret 1 on string 2, D at fret 3, open E, F at fret 1 on string 1, E, G at fret 3, E, G, then C.
rows.translation: C na pražci 1 struny 2, D na pražci 3, prázdne E, F na pražci 1 struny 1, E, G na pražci 3, E, G, potom C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Scoreboard Lights is a stadium anthem in D at 100 beats per minute: D, A, B minor and G, the same one, five, six, four loop in a new key. Drive steady eighths.
rows.translation: Svetlá výsledkovej tabule je štadiónová hymna v D dur pri 100 dobách za minútu: D, A, B mol a G, rovnaká slučka prvého, piateho, šiesteho a štvrtého stupňa v novej tónine. Žeňte rovné osminy.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: This B minor uses the top four strings only: fret 4 on strings 4 and 3, fret 3 on string 2, fret 2 on string 1. The full barre comes later.
rows.translation: Tento B mol používa len štyri najtenšie struny: pražec 4 na strunách 4 a 3, pražec 3 na strune 2, pražec 2 na strune 1. Úplné barré príde neskôr.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, open B, D at fret 3 on string 2, then G at fret 3 on string 1, F sharp, open E.
rows.translation: A na pražci 2 struny 3, prázdne B, D na pražci 3 struny 2, potom G na pražci 3 struny 1, Fis, prázdne E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which of these is the four-chord loop in C?
rows.translation: Ktorá z možností je štvorakordová slučka v C dur?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The one, five, six and four of C are C, G, A minor and F.
rows.translation: Prvý, piaty, šiesty a štvrtý stupeň C dur sú C, G, A mol a F.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Blues, a waltz, 6/8 folk, lo-fi and funk, with seventh chords, sus chords and swung rhythms.
rows.translation: Blues, valčík, folk v 6/8, lo-fi a funk so septakordmi, akordmi sus a swingovým rytmom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Rust Belt Shuffle is a blues at 80 beats per minute: twelve bars of E7, A7 and B7, strummed long-short. The melody swings the same way, so lean into every long note.
rows.translation: Shuffle hrdzavého pásu je blues pri 80 dobách za minútu: dvanásť taktov E7, A7 a B7 s údermi dlho-krátko. Melódia sa hojdá rovnako, preto zdôraznite každý dlhý tón.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Open B, D at fret 3, open E and back. Then G and G sharp on string 3, sliding into open B.
rows.translation: Prázdne B, D na pražci 3, prázdne E a späť. Potom G a Gis na strune 3, s plynulým prechodom na prázdne B.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Carousel at Closing Time turns in three, like a fairground ride winding down: oom-pah-pah at 96 beats per minute. Count one, two, three, with the weight on one.
rows.translation: Kolotoč pred záverečnou sa točí na tri ako spomaľujúca púťová atrakcia: um-pa-pa pri 96 dobách za minútu. Počítajte raz, dva, tri, s dôrazom na raz.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, A on string 3, then C sharp at fret 2, open E and G at fret 3 on string 1.
rows.translation: D na pražci 3 struny 2, A na strune 3, potom Cis na pražci 2, prázdne E a G na pražci 3 struny 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Cedar Smoke sways in 6/8: six quick counts per bar, felt as two big beats, one-two-three, four-five-six. At 100 counts a minute it rocks like a slow boat.
rows.translation: Cédrový dym sa kolíše v 6/8: šesť rýchlych počítaní v takte ako dve veľké doby, raz-dva-tri, štyri-päť-šesť. Pri 100 počítaniach za minútu sa hojdá ako pomalý čln.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Bar four holds Dsus4: a D chord with your little finger on string 1, fret 3. It hangs in the air. Bar eight drops to plain D, and the song lands.
rows.translation: Štvrtý takt drží Dsus4: akord D s malíčkom na strune 1, pražci 3. Visí vo vzduchu. Ôsmy takt klesne na obyčajné D a pieseň pristane.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open B and back, then open E on string 1, and down again.
rows.translation: D na pražci 3 struny 2, prázdne B a späť, potom prázdne E na strune 1 a znova nadol.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Rain on the Skylight is lo-fi: soft seventh chords over a lazy, swung beat at 72 beats per minute. Strum down on one, then down-up on three, the up a little late.
rows.translation: Dážď na strešnom okne je lo-fi: jemné septakordy nad lenivým swingovým rytmom pri 72 dobách za minútu. Hrajte nadol na prvú a nadol-nahor na tretiu, nahor trochu neskôr.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Am7 is A minor with finger 3 lifted. Cmaj7 is C with finger 1 lifted. For Dm7, finger 2 goes on string 3, fret 2, and finger 1 lies flat across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1.
rows.translation: Am7 je A mol so zdvihnutým prstom 3. Cmaj7 je C so zdvihnutým prstom 1. Pri Dm7 ide prst 2 na strunu 3, pražec 2, a prst 1 naplocho cez struny 2 a 1 na pražci 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Neon Laundromat stays on one chord, A7, the whole way through. A vamp like this lives on rhythm: tight, choppy strums at 96 beats per minute and a hook that dodges the beat.
rows.translation: Neónová práčovňa zostáva celý čas na jedinom akorde A7. Takýto sprievod žije rytmom: krátke ostré údery pri 96 dobách za minútu a motív, ktorý sa vyhýba dobe.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Funk players call beat one the one. Hit it hard, keep your strumming hand swinging in eighths, and ease your fingers off after each strum so it goes chk.
rows.translation: Funkoví hráči zdôrazňujú prvú dobu. Udrite ju silno, hrajúcou rukou stále kývajte v osminách a po každom údere uvoľnite prsty, aby zaznelo čk.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, C and C sharp at frets 1 and 2 on string 2, open E, G at fret 3, then back down.
rows.translation: A na pražci 2 struny 3, C a Cis na pražcoch 1 a 2 struny 2, prázdne E, G na pražci 3, potom späť nadol.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: How many quick counts fill a bar of 6/8?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: 6/8 has six eighth-note counts, felt as two groups of three.
rows.translation: 6/8 má šesť osminových počítaní, cítených ako dve skupiny po troch.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Lo-fi, one-drop reggae, funk, a 6/8 slow dance and bedroom pop, on seventh chords that make a groove glow.
rows.translation: Lo-fi, one-drop reggae, funk, pomalý tanec v 6/8 a izbový pop na septakordoch, ktoré rozžiaria rytmus.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Late Checkout is lo-fi at 72 beats per minute: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 and Am7 on a loop. Strum down on one, then down-up on three with the up a little late, and swing the tune the same way.
rows.translation: Neskorý odchod z hotela je lo-fi pri 72 dobách za minútu: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 a Am7 v slučke. Hrajte nadol na prvú, nadol-nahor na tretiu s oneskoreným nahor a rovnako swingujte melódiu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: G7 is G with string 1 at fret 1 instead of fret 3: fingers 3 and 2 on strings 6 and 5, finger 1 on string 1. It leans hard toward C.
rows.translation: G7 je G so strunou 1 na pražci 1 namiesto pražca 3: prsty 3 a 2 na strunách 6 a 5, prst 1 na strune 1. Silno smeruje k C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Saltwater Sunday is reggae in A minor at 76 beats per minute. The guitar plays a double chop on two and four, chk-a, chk-a, while the drums drop their weight on three.
rows.translation: Slaná nedeľa je reggae v A mol pri 76 dobách za minútu. Gitara hrá dvojitý tlmený úder na druhej a štvrtej, čk-a, čk-a, kým bicie kladú dôraz na tretiu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: D7: finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, finger 1 on string 2, fret 1, finger 3 on string 1, fret 2. Am7 to D7 and back is the sunny, minor-but-bright sound of the whole song.
rows.translation: D7: prst 2 na strune 3, pražci 2, prst 1 na strune 2, pražci 1, prst 3 na strune 1, pražci 2. Am7 do D7 a späť tvorí slnečný, molový, ale jasný zvuk celej piesne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Pocket Change is funk at 100 beats per minute: a vamp on Em7, with A7 for the chorus. Your strumming hand never stops moving in eighths; only some strokes ring.
rows.translation: Drobné vo vrecku je funk pri 100 dobách za minútu: opakovaný sprievod na Em7, s A7 v refréne. Hrajúca ruka sa v osminách nikdy nezastaví; znejú iba niektoré údery.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Between the strokes that ring, lay your fretting fingers lightly across the strings and keep strumming: the muted strokes go chk. Press down only for the hits.
rows.translation: Medzi znejúcimi údermi položte prsty hmatovej ruky zľahka cez struny a pokračujte: tlmené údery znejú čk. Pritlačte iba pri znejúcich úderoch.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, then C and C sharp at frets 1 and 2 on string 2. Twice.
rows.translation: A na pražci 2 struny 3, potom C a Cis na pražcoch 1 a 2 struny 2. Dvakrát.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Kitchen Slow Dance is a soul ballad in 6/8 at 108 counts a minute, two slow sways a bar. Cmaj7, Am7, Dm7 and G7 carry the verse; Fmaj7 and Em7 open up the chorus.
rows.translation: Pomalý tanec v kuchyni je soulová balada v 6/8 pri 108 počítaniach za minútu, dve pomalé hojdania v takte. Cmaj7, Am7, Dm7 a G7 nesú slohu; Fmaj7 a Em7 otvoria refrén.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Fmaj7 is the mini F with string 1 left open. Em7 takes one finger: finger 2 on string 5, fret 2, every other string open.
rows.translation: Fmaj7 je malé F s prázdnou strunou 1. Em7 potrebuje jeden prst: prst 2 na strune 5, pražci 2, všetky ostatné struny prázdne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Open E, G at fret 3 on string 1, E, D at fret 3 on string 2, open E again, then open B.
rows.translation: Prázdne E, G na pražci 3 struny 1, E, D na pražci 3 struny 2, znova prázdne E, potom prázdne B.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Houseplants is soft bedroom pop at 88 beats per minute: Gmaj7, Em7, Cmaj7 and D. Seventh chords make it dreamy. Strum once on one, then brush soft ups on the ands.
rows.translation: Izbové rastliny je jemný izbový pop pri 88 dobách za minútu: Gmaj7, Em7, Cmaj7 a D. Septakordy mu dávajú snovosť. Udrite raz na prvú, potom jemne nahor na „a“.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Gmaj7 is G with string 1 at fret 2 instead of fret 3. Bm7 puts three fingers at fret 2, on strings 5, 3 and 1, and lets strings 4 and 2 ring open.
rows.translation: Gmaj7 je G so strunou 1 na pražci 2 namiesto pražca 3. Bm7 má tri prsty na pražci 2, na strunách 5, 3 a 1, a struny 4 a 2 necháva prázdne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1 and open E, twice, then D at fret 3 on string 2 and F sharp at fret 2 on string 1.
rows.translation: G na pražci 3 struny 1 a prázdne E, dvakrát, potom D na pražci 3 struny 2 a Fis na pražci 2 struny 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which chord has a major seventh?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Cmaj7 adds B, a half step under C. G7 and Am7 add a flat seventh, a whole step under the root.
rows.translation: Cmaj7 pridáva B, poltón pod C. G7 a Am7 pridávajú malú septimu, celý tón pod základným tónom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Punk, garage rock, doo-wop, surf and heartland rock, with power chords, a riff and sus chords.
rows.translation: Punk, garážový rock, doo-wop, surf a americký rock s kvintovými akordmi, riffom a akordmi sus.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Static on Channel Nine is punk: four power chords, palm-muted eighths, 104 beats per minute. The verse mutters on low notes; the chorus is a gang shout, so dig in.
rows.translation: Šum na deviatom kanáli je punk: štyri kvintové akordy, osminy tlmené dlaňou, 104 dôb za minútu. Sloha si mrmle nízko, refrén kričí zborovo, tak sa doň oprite.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1, down to D at fret 3 on string 2, then F sharp at fret 2 and D again.
rows.translation: G na pražci 3 struny 1, nadol na D na pražci 3 struny 2, potom Fis na pražci 2 a znova D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Basement Weather is garage rock at 92 beats per minute: a riff on the low strings, then power chords that punch back. Rest your palm at the bridge to keep the riff tight.
rows.translation: Počasie v pivnici je garážový rock pri 92 dobách za minútu: riff na hrubých strunách a kvintové akordy, ktoré mu odpovedajú. Oprite dlaň pri kobylke, aby riff znel krátko a presne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Open string 5, C at fret 3 on the same string, then open string 4, and back.
rows.translation: Prázdna struna 5, C na pražci 3 tej istej struny, potom prázdna struna 4 a späť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 6, open A, G again, then open low E.
rows.translation: G na pražci 3 struny 6, prázdne A, znova G, potom prázdne nízke E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Answer the riff with power chords on one, the and of two, and four: A5, G5, C5, D5. Between hits, ease your fretting fingers off so the chords stop short.
rows.translation: Odpovedzte riffu kvintovými akordmi na prvú, „a“ po druhej a štvrtú: A5, G5, C5, D5. Medzi údermi uvoľnite prsty, aby akordy rýchlo stíchli.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Jukebox Moon is a slow dance in 1950s doo-wop style: C, A minor, F and G7, around and around, at 72 beats per minute. Strum every beat, with a quick swung up into each new bar.
rows.translation: Jukeboxový mesiac je pomalý tanec v štýle doo-wop z desaťročia od roku 1950: C, A mol, F a G7 stále dokola pri 72 dobách za minútu. Hrajte každú dobu s rýchlym swingovým úderom nahor pred novým taktom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Open G, C at fret 1 on string 2, open E, then D and C. Next, A at fret 2 on string 3 and back up.
rows.translation: Prázdne G, C na pražci 1 struny 2, prázdne E, potom D a C. Ďalej A na pražci 2 struny 3 a späť nahor.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Boardwalk Comet is surf rock: a twangy melody over A minor, G, F and E, galloping along at 104 beats per minute. Picture reverb, salt spray and a wave about to break.
rows.translation: Kométa na promenáde je surfový rock: zvonivá melódia nad A mol, G, F a E, cválajúca pri 104 dobách za minútu. Predstavte si dozvuk, morskú triešť a vlnu pred zlomením.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A on string 3, C at fret 1, open E and back down. Then open B, D at fret 3, and up to G on string 1.
rows.translation: A na strune 3, C na pražci 1, prázdne E a späť nadol. Potom prázdne B, D na pražci 3 a nahor na G na strune 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Over the E chord the tune plays G sharp, not G. Where is G sharp on string 3?
rows.translation: Nad akordom E hrá melódia Gis, nie G. Kde je Gis na strune 3?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: G is open string 3, so G sharp is one fret up. It leans hard toward A, the home note.
rows.translation: G je prázdna struna 3, preto je Gis o jeden pražec vyššie. Silno smeruje k A, domovskému tónu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Mile Marker Zero is open-road rock at 100 beats per minute: big ringing chords and a chorus for driving with the windows down. Listen for D lifting to Dsus4 and back.
rows.translation: Nultý míľnik je cestný rock pri 100 dobách za minútu: veľké zvonivé akordy a refrén na jazdu s otvorenými oknami. Počúvajte, ako D stúpa na Dsus4 a späť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Asus4 is A with your little finger added on string 2, fret 3. Like Dsus4, it leans forward and wants to fall back home.
rows.translation: Asus4 je A s pridaným malíčkom na strune 2, pražci 3. Ako Dsus4 smeruje vpred a chce sa vrátiť domov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: F sharp at fret 2 and G at fret 3 on string 1, then down to D at fret 3 on string 2.
rows.translation: Fis na pražci 2 a G na pražci 3 struny 1, potom nadol na D na pražci 3 struny 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which of these styles swings, long-short?
rows.translation: Ktorý z týchto štýlov swinguje dlho-krátko?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Doo-wop rides a gentle swing. Punk and surf drive on straight, even eighths.
rows.translation: Doo-wop sa jemne hojdá. Punk a surf poháňajú rovné, pravidelné osminy.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.translation: Punk a rock s kvintovými akordmi
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Punk-pop, riff rock, dark 6/8 rock, an indie anthem and desert rock, on power chords and low-string riffs.
rows.translation: Punk-pop, riffový rock, temný rock v 6/8, indie hymna a púštny rock s kvintovými akordmi a nízkymi riffmi.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Last Bell is punk-pop at 152 beats per minute: C5, G5, A5 and F5, the four-chord loop as power chords. All downstrokes in steady eighths, palm resting on the strings by the bridge.
rows.translation: Posledné zvonenie je punk-pop pri 152 dobách za minútu: C5, G5, A5 a F5, štvorakordová slučka v kvintových akordoch. Všetko nadol v rovných osminách, dlaň pri kobylke na strunách.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: F5 is the G5 shape two frets lower: finger 1 on string 6, fret 1, fingers 3 and 4 on strings 5 and 4 at fret 3.
rows.translation: F5 je hmat G5 o dva pražce nižšie: prst 1 na strune 6, pražci 1, prsty 3 a 4 na strunách 5 a 4 na pražci 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1 and open E, twice. Then D at fret 3 on string 2, twice, open E and D.
rows.translation: G na pražci 3 struny 1 a prázdne E, dvakrát. Potom dvakrát D na pražci 3 struny 2, prázdne E a D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Copper Wire is built on a riff: a short, catchy line on the low strings that the whole band locks onto. It runs at 112 beats per minute in E, with power chords in the chorus.
rows.translation: Medený drôt stojí na riffe: krátkej chytľavej linke na hrubých strunách, ktorú drží celá kapela. Beží pri 112 dobách za minútu v E, s kvintovými akordmi v refréne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Open string 6 twice, G at fret 3, open E, open string 5, G again, then open E.
rows.translation: Dvakrát prázdna struna 6, G na pražci 3, prázdne E, prázdna struna 5, znova G, potom prázdne E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The second bar turns around: B at fret 2 on string 5, open A, G at fret 3 on string 6, open A.
rows.translation: Druhý takt sa obracia: B na pražci 2 struny 5, prázdne A, G na pražci 3 struny 6, prázdne A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Cold Lake is dark alternative rock in 6/8 at 120 counts a minute: E5, C5, G5 and D5. Keep the verse quiet and low so the chorus can open up.
rows.translation: Studené jazero je temný alternatívny rock v 6/8 pri 120 počítaniach za minútu: E5, C5, G5 a D5. Slohu držte tichú a nízku, aby sa refrén mohol otvoriť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1, open E, G again, then D at fret 3 on string 2. Let each ring.
rows.translation: G na pražci 3 struny 1, prázdne E, znova G, potom D na pražci 3 struny 2. Každý tón nechajte znieť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Parking Lot Cathedral is indie rock at 128 beats per minute: D5, A5, B5 and G5, the four-chord loop again, now as power chords. Big, open, driving eighths.
rows.translation: Katedrála na parkovisku je indie rock pri 128 dobách za minútu: D5, A5, B5 a G5, znovu štvorakordová slučka, teraz v kvintových akordoch. Veľké, otvorené, hnacie osminy.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: B5 is the A5 shape moved up two frets: finger 1 on string 5, fret 2, fingers 3 and 4 on strings 4 and 3 at fret 4.
rows.translation: B5 je hmat A5 posunutý o dva pražce vyššie: prst 1 na strune 5, pražci 2, prsty 3 a 4 na strunách 4 a 3 na pražci 4.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, twice, F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, open E, G at fret 3, open E.
rows.translation: Dvakrát D na pražci 3 struny 2, Fis na pražci 2 struny 1, prázdne E, G na pražci 3, prázdne E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Halogen is desert rock in D minor at 104 beats per minute: a hypnotic riff on strings 4 and 5, a low, steady voice, then F5, C5 and G5 opening up the chorus.
rows.translation: Halogén je púštny rock v D mol pri 104 dobách za minútu: hypnotický riff na strunách 4 a 5, nízky stály hlas, potom F5, C5 a G5 otvárajú refrén.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Open string 4 twice, F at fret 3, open D, open string 3, F again, then open D.
rows.translation: Dvakrát prázdna struna 4, F na pražci 3, prázdne D, prázdna struna 3, znova F, potom prázdne D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: F at fret 1 on string 1, open E, C at fret 1 on string 2, then G at fret 3 on string 1, E and C.
rows.translation: F na pražci 1 struny 1, prázdne E, C na pražci 1 struny 2, potom G na pražci 3 struny 1, E a C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which song's riff starts like this?
rows.translation: Riff ktorej piesne sa začína takto?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A power chord is a root and its fifth, with no third, so it is neither major nor minor.
rows.translation: Kvintový akord tvorí základný tón a jeho kvinta bez tercie, preto nie je ani durový, ani molový.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A ballad, a sea story in 6/8, a music-box waltz, a bright folk strummer and a dark song in A minor.
rows.translation: Balada, morský príbeh v 6/8, valčík hracej skrinky, jasný folkový sprievod a temná pieseň v A mol.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Letters in a Shoebox tells a story in C at 72 beats per minute. The verse walks C, G, A minor, E minor, F, C, F and G, a chain of chords that has carried ballads for centuries.
rows.translation: Listy v krabici od topánok rozpráva príbeh v C dur pri 72 dobách za minútu. Sloha kráča cez C, G, A mol, E mol, F, C, F a G, reťazec akordov nesúci balady po stáročia.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: C at fret 1 on string 2, D at fret 3, open E, F at fret 1 on string 1, G at fret 3, then D again.
rows.translation: C na pražci 1 struny 2, D na pražci 3, prázdne E, F na pražci 1 struny 1, G na pražci 3, potom znova D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Keeper's Daughter is a story song in 6/8 at 120 counts a minute: E minor, D, C and B7. Three verses tell the story, and the chorus answers each one.
rows.translation: Dcéra strážcu majáka je príbehová pieseň v 6/8 pri 120 počítaniach za minútu: E mol, D, C a B7. Tri slohy rozprávajú príbeh a refrén odpovedá na každú.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Open B, open E, G at fret 3 on string 1, open E, then C at fret 1 on string 2, E and C.
rows.translation: Prázdne B, prázdne E, G na pražci 3 struny 1, prázdne E, potom C na pražci 1 struny 2, E a C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Snow Globe Town is a quick waltz in G at 120 beats per minute, like a music box: one strong beat, two light ones. G, D, E minor and C, with B7 in the bridge.
rows.translation: Mestečko v snežnej guli je rýchly valčík v G dur pri 120 dobách za minútu, ako hracia skrinka: jedna silná doba, dve ľahké. G, D, E mol a C, s B7 v mostíku.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, C at fret 1, D, C, then open B: a slow fall, like snow.
rows.translation: Prázdne E, D na pražci 3 struny 2, C na pražci 1, D, C, potom prázdne B: pomalý pád ako sneh.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Thistle and Thread is a bright folk strummer in A at 116 beats per minute. Asus4 and Asus2 decorate the A chord: change one finger and the chord sparkles.
rows.translation: Bodliak a niť je jasný folk s akordovým sprievodom v A dur pri 116 dobách za minútu. Asus4 a Asus2 zdobia akord A: zmeňte jeden prst a akord sa rozžiari.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: From A, put finger 4 on string 2, fret 3 for Asus4. Lift the finger off string 2 and let it ring open for Asus2. Both fall back to A.
rows.translation: Z A položte prst 4 na strunu 2, pražec 3 pre Asus4. Pre Asus2 zdvihnite prst zo struny 2 a nechajte ju prázdnu. Oba sa vracajú na A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, E twice, C sharp, open B, then A.
rows.translation: Fis na pražci 2 struny 1, prázdne E, D na pražci 3 struny 2, dvakrát E, Cis, prázdne B, potom A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Ghost Light is a slow, dark ballad in A minor at 70 beats per minute. The verse sinks from A minor through F and C to E major, which pulls hard back to A minor.
rows.translation: Svetlo duchov je pomalá temná balada v A mol pri 70 dobách za minútu. Sloha klesá z A mol cez F a C do E dur, ktorý silno priťahuje späť k A mol.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: E major in A minor brings one new note. Which?
rows.translation: E dur prináša do A mol jeden nový tón. Ktorý?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A minor's own notes have G. E major needs G sharp, a half step under A, so it leans hard toward home.
rows.translation: A mol má vo vlastných tónoch G. E dur potrebuje Gis, poltón pod A, preto silno smeruje domov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: F at fret 1 on string 1, open E, G at fret 3, then D at fret 3 on string 2. Hold each long.
rows.translation: F na pražci 1 struny 1, prázdne E, G na pražci 3, potom D na pražci 3 struny 2. Každý držte dlho.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: How many beats fill a bar of 3/4?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: 3/4 counts one, two, three, with the weight on one: the waltz.
rows.translation: 3/4 počíta raz, dva, tri s dôrazom na raz: valčík.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Indie pop, a power ballad, highlife, neo-soul and an anthem with a key change, with F and B minor barres.
rows.translation: Indie pop, veľká balada, highlife, neo-soul a hymna so zmenou tóniny, s barré F a B mol.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Late Bus Home is indie pop for the ride back through a sleeping city: D, B minor, G and A at 100 beats per minute. Each line starts just after the beat, so wait a breath.
rows.translation: Neskorý autobus domov je indie pop na cestu spiacim mestom: D, B mol, G a A pri 100 dobách za minútu. Každý riadok začína tesne po dobe, preto chvíľku počkajte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Play the full B minor barre at fret 2 if you can. If not, use the top four strings: fret 4 on strings 4 and 3, fret 3 on string 2, fret 2 on string 1.
rows.translation: Ak viete, hrajte úplné barré B mol na pražci 2. Inak použite štyri najtenšie struny: pražec 4 na strunách 4 a 3, pražec 3 na strune 2, pražec 2 na strune 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, D at fret 3 on string 2, then open E and F sharp at fret 2 on string 1.
rows.translation: A na pražci 2 struny 3, D na pražci 3 struny 2, potom prázdne E a Fis na pražci 2 struny 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Glass Satellites is a slow, soaring ballad at 76 beats per minute: A minor, F, C and G. Strum big on one and let it ring, then build on three and four.
rows.translation: Sklenené satelity je pomalá vzletná balada pri 76 dobách za minútu: A mol, F, C a G. Silno udrite na prvú a nechajte znieť, potom stupňujte na tretej a štvrtej.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Lay finger 1 flat across all six strings at fret 1 and build an E shape in front of it. Not there yet? Use the mini F on the top four strings for now.
rows.translation: Položte prst 1 naplocho cez všetkých šesť strún na pražci 1 a pred ním vytvorte hmat E. Ešte to nejde? Zatiaľ použite malé F na štyroch najtenších strunách.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: C at fret 1 on string 2, open E twice, D at fret 3, C again, then A at fret 2 on string 3.
rows.translation: C na pražci 1 struny 2, dvakrát prázdne E, D na pražci 3, znova C, potom A na pražci 2 struny 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Market Day borrows from highlife, the bright guitar pop of Ghana and Nigeria: G, B minor, C and D at 104 beats per minute. The hook bounces off the beat, so keep your body moving.
rows.translation: Trhový deň čerpá z highlife, jasného gitarového popu Ghany a Nigérie: G, B mol, C a D pri 104 dobách za minútu. Motív odskakuje mimo doby, preto sa neprestávajte hýbať.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open B, D again, open E, then back to D and B.
rows.translation: D na pražci 3 struny 2, prázdne B, znova D, prázdne E, potom späť na D a B.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Bar two keeps bar one's rhythm but swaps one note. Why?
rows.translation: Druhý takt zachováva rytmus prvého, no mení jeden tón. Prečo?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Bar two moves E up to F sharp, a note of B minor. Same rhythm, new chord, new note.
rows.translation: Druhý takt posúva E nahor na Fis, tón akordu B mol. Rovnaký rytmus, nový akord, nový tón.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Velvet Hour is neo-soul at 74 beats per minute: four lush seventh chords stepping down, Fmaj7, Em7, Dm7 and Cmaj7. Strum once on one, then brush soft ups on the ands.
rows.translation: Zamatová hodina je neo-soul pri 74 dobách za minútu: štyri bohaté septakordy klesajú po krokoch, Fmaj7, Em7, Dm7 a Cmaj7. Udrite raz na prvú, potom jemne nahor na „a“.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Fmaj7 is the mini F with string 1 left open. Em7 takes one finger: finger 2 on string 5, fret 2, every other string open. Dm7 and Cmaj7 you know from Rain on the Skylight.
rows.translation: Fmaj7 je malé F s prázdnou strunou 1. Em7 potrebuje jeden prst: prst 2 na strune 5, pražci 2, ostatné struny prázdne. Dm7 a Cmaj7 poznáte z piesne Dážď na strešnom okne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The chords walk down F, E, D. Where does the loop land?
rows.translation: Akordy klesajú F, E, D. Kde slučka pristane?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Each chord sits one step below the last, and the walk ends on C, the home chord.
rows.translation: Každý akord leží o stupeň pod predchádzajúcim a zostup končí na C, domovskom akorde.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: An anthem with a key change
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Rooftop Choir is a stadium-sized anthem at 92 beats per minute. You play the chorus in C, then one bar of A lifts everything a whole step, and the chorus returns in D.
rows.translation: Zbor na streche je štadiónová hymna pri 92 dobách za minútu. Refrén hráte v C dur, potom jeden takt A zdvihne všetko o celý tón a refrén sa vráti v D dur.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A key change up a whole step moves every note up…
rows.translation: Zmena tóniny o celý tón nahor posunie každý tón o…
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A whole step is two half steps, and each fret is a half step. C becomes D, and G becomes A.
rows.translation: Celý tón tvoria dva poltóny a každý pražec je poltón. C sa zmení na D a G na A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which chord lifts Rooftop Choir from C into D?
rows.translation: Ktorý akord zdvihne Zbor na streche z C dur do D dur?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A leads home to D. Landing on it turns the whole song toward the new key.
rows.translation: A vedie domov do D. Pristátie na ňom otočí celú pieseň k novej tónine.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Synth-pop, gospel-pop, dark pop, indie pop and a 6/8 finale, with five new barre chords.
rows.translation: Synth-pop, gospel-pop, temný pop, indie pop a finále v 6/8 s piatimi novými barré akordmi.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Slow Motion Strobe is synth-pop at 118 beats per minute: F sharp minor, D, A and E. The strum is pushed: two of its hits land on the and, just before the beat.
rows.translation: Spomalený stroboskop je synth-pop pri 118 dobách za minútu: Fis mol, D, A a E. Sprievod predbieha dobu: dva údery padajú na „a“ tesne pred dobou.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Barre finger 1 across all six strings at fret 2, then put fingers 3 and 4 on strings 5 and 4 at fret 4: the E minor shape, moved up two frets.
rows.translation: Prstom 1 držte barré cez všetkých šesť strún na pražci 2, potom položte prsty 3 a 4 na struny 5 a 4 na pražci 4: hmat E mol posunutý o dva pražce vyššie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Bright Side of the Block is a gospel-pop sing-along in D at 100 beats per minute: D, F sharp minor, G and A. Clap on two and four and sing the chorus like the whole street joins in.
rows.translation: Svetlá strana ulice je gospel-pop na spoločný spev v D dur pri 100 dobách za minútu: D, Fis mol, G a A. Tlieskajte na druhú a štvrtú a refrén spievajte, akoby sa pridala celá ulica.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Barre finger 1 across strings 5 to 1 at fret 2, then build an A minor shape two frets up with fingers 2, 3 and 4. Leave string 6 silent.
rows.translation: Prstom 1 držte barré cez struny 5 až 1 na pražci 2 a prstami 2, 3 a 4 vytvorte hmat A mol o dva pražce vyššie. Strunu 6 nehrajte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open E, G at fret 3 on string 1, F sharp at fret 2, E, G, then E.
rows.translation: D na pražci 3 struny 2, prázdne E, G na pražci 3 struny 1, Fis na pražci 2, E, G, potom E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Over You Soon is dark pop in B minor at 84 beats per minute: B minor, G, D and A. Strum once on one, then soft ups on the ands, and keep it hushed.
rows.translation: Čoskoro na teba zabudnem je temný pop v B mol pri 84 dobách za minútu: B mol, G, D a A. Udrite raz na prvú, potom jemne nahor na „a“ a hrajte tlmene.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1, F sharp at fret 2, D at fret 3 on string 2, then F sharp, open E and D.
rows.translation: G na pražci 3 struny 1, Fis na pražci 2, D na pražci 3 struny 2, potom Fis, prázdne E a D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Spray Paint Sunrise is indie pop at 124 beats per minute: E, B, C sharp minor and A, the four-chord loop with two barres. Drive steady eighths and let it run.
rows.translation: Úsvit nasprejovaný farbou je indie pop pri 124 dobách za minútu: E, B, Cis mol a A, štvorakordová slučka s dvoma barré. Hrajte hnacie rovné osminy a nechajte hudbu bežať.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: B is an A shape barred at fret 2: finger 1 across strings 5 to 1, three fingers at fret 4. C sharp minor is an A minor shape barred at fret 4.
rows.translation: B je hmat A s barré na pražci 2: prst 1 cez struny 5 až 1, tri prsty na pražci 4. Cis mol je hmat A mol s barré na pražci 4.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: G sharp at fret 4 on string 1, F sharp, open E, open B, then D sharp at fret 4 on string 2, C sharp, D sharp.
rows.translation: Gis na pražci 4 struny 1, Fis, prázdne E, prázdne B, potom Dis na pražci 4 struny 2, Cis, Dis.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Constellation Prize closes the course: an anthem in 6/8 at 126 counts a minute, in F. F and B flat are both barres, with C and D minor between them.
rows.translation: Cena súhvezdia uzatvára kurz: hymna v 6/8 pri 126 počítaniach za minútu, v F dur. F aj znížené B sú barré, medzi nimi C a D mol.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.translation: Znížené B, barré s hmatom A
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Barre finger 1 across strings 5 to 1 at fret 1, then put fingers 2, 3 and 4 on strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 3. Leave string 6 silent.
rows.translation: Prstom 1 držte barré cez struny 5 až 1 na pražci 1, potom položte prsty 2, 3 a 4 na struny 4, 3 a 2 na pražci 3. Strunu 6 nehrajte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, F at fret 1 on string 1 twice, G at fret 3, F twice, open E, then F.
rows.translation: D na pražci 3 struny 2, dvakrát F na pražci 1 struny 1, G na pražci 3, dvakrát F, prázdne E, potom F.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: F sharp minor is which shape, barred at fret 2?
rows.translation: Ktorý hmat s barré na pražci 2 tvorí Fis mol?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Barre at fret 2 and the E minor shape sits in front of your first finger: F sharp minor.
rows.translation: Barré na pražci 2 a hmat E mol pred ukazovákom: Fis mol.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Famous tunes everyone knows, start to finish
rows.translation: Známe melódie od začiatku do konca
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Folk songs and a spiritual everyone can sing, with simple chord charts to strum.
rows.translation: Ľudové piesne a spirituál pre každého, s jednoduchými akordovými zápismi na sprievod.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: This tune began as a spiritual. In the 1890s railroad crews in the Midwest gave it new words, and Carl Sandburg printed it in 1927. It climbs from low B up to D on string 2.
rows.translation: Táto melódia vznikla ako spirituál. V desaťročí od roku 1890 jej železničiari zo Stredozápadu dali nový text a Carl Sandburg ju vydal v roku 1927. Stúpa od nízkeho B po D na strune 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The first line: open D, E, four open Gs, a dip to B on string 5, then home to G.
rows.translation: Prvý riadok: prázdne D, E, štyri prázdne G, pokles na B na strune 5, potom domov na G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The words She'll be come before beat one. What are they?
rows.translation: Slová She'll be znejú pred prvou dobou. Čo tvoria?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A pickup is a few notes that lead into the first strong beat. Here they run up to the word com-.
rows.translation: Predtaktie je niekoľko tónov vedúcich k prvej ťažkej dobe. Tu stúpajú k slabike com-.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Three chords: G, C and D7
rows.translation: Tri akordy: G, C a D7
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Most of the song sits on G. D7 comes at the end of the second line, and C colors the fourth. Change on the word that starts the bar.
rows.translation: Väčšina piesne zostáva na G. D7 prichádza na konci druhého riadka a C zafarbí štvrtý. Meňte na slove, ktorým začína takt.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: This African American spiritual is older than the Civil War and was first printed in 1918. Its line ain't gonna study war no more became a song of the peace movement.
rows.translation: Tento afroamerický spirituál je starší než občianska vojna a prvýkrát vyšiel tlačou v roku 1918. Verš ain't gonna study war no more sa stal piesňou mierového hnutia.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Lay down my burden: open B, a drop to open D, then up through E, G and A to B.
rows.translation: Lay down my burden: prázdne B, pokles na prázdne D, potom nahor cez E, G a A do B.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A sharp sits between A and B, at fret 3 on string 3. It slides up into open B, the bluesy lift that gives gospel its sound.
rows.translation: Ais leží medzi A a B na pražci 3 struny 3. Plynulo stúpa do prázdneho B, bluesové zdvihnutie, ktoré dáva gospelu jeho zvuk.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Down by the riverside: B, B, A sharp at fret 3, B, then A and G.
rows.translation: Down by the riverside: B, B, Ais na pražci 3, B, potom A a G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The high road and the low road
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: This Scottish song was first printed in 1841. The low road is often heard as the road a soldier's spirit takes home, faster than the living on the high road.
rows.translation: Táto škótska pieseň prvýkrát vyšla v roku 1841. Dolná cesta sa často chápe ako cesta vojakovho ducha domov, rýchlejšia než cesta živých po hornej ceste.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: By yon bonnie banks: open D, then G, G, A, B and back down to G.
rows.translation: By yon bonnie banks: prázdne D, potom G, G, A, B a späť nadol na G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: This tune moves in quarter notes and pairs of eighths. Count one, two-and, three, four-and, and the lilt comes by itself.
rows.translation: Táto melódia strieda štvrťové noty a dvojice osmín. Počítajte raz, dva-a, tri, štyri-a a kolísanie príde samo.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: This song was printed in 1876 and credited in 1884 to James Yorkston of Edinburgh. It is now Dublin's unofficial anthem, and Molly and her cart stand as a statue in the city.
rows.translation: Pieseň vyšla v roku 1876 a v roku 1884 bola pripísaná Jamesovi Yorkstonovi z Edinburghu. Dnes je neoficiálnou hymnou Dublinu, kde stojí socha Molly s vozíkom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: In Dublin's fair city: open D, four open Gs, up to open B and back to G.
rows.translation: In Dublin's fair city: prázdne D, štyri prázdne G, nahor na prázdne B a späť na G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Count one, two, three and lean on one. In many bars the middle note is long: one, two, and a quick note just before the next one.
rows.translation: Počítajte raz, dva, tri a zdôraznite raz. V mnohých taktoch je stredný tón dlhý: raz, dva a rýchly tón tesne pred ďalšou prvou dobou.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Cecil Sharp collected and published this ballad in 1906, from verses that go back to the 1700s. Play it slowly and let every long note ring.
rows.translation: Cecil Sharp zozbieral a vydal túto baladu v roku 1906 z veršov pochádzajúcich zo storočia po roku 1700. Hrajte pomaly a každý dlhý tón nechajte znieť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The water is wide, I cannot get o'er: up from open D to B, then gently back down to D.
rows.translation: The water is wide, I cannot get o'er: nahor od prázdneho D po B, potom jemne späť nadol na D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Wide rings for two beats and two for two and a half. Keep counting while the string rings, so the next word lands on time.
rows.translation: Wide znie dve doby a two dva a pol doby. Kým struna znie, počítajte ďalej, aby ďalšie slovo prišlo načas.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which word holds over two notes in the first verse?
rows.translation: Ktoré slovo sa v prvej slohe spieva na dvoch tónoch?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Fly starts on C and slides down to a long A. Singers call one syllable over several notes a melisma.
rows.translation: Fly začína na C a kĺže nadol na dlhé A. Spev jednej slabiky na viacerých tónoch sa nazýva melizma.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: No new notes: the five songs from this unit, one after another, a little faster than before. Name each one from its first notes.
rows.translation: Žiadne nové tóny: päť piesní z tejto časti za sebou, trochu rýchlejšie než predtým. Spoznajte každú podľa prvých tónov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A Welsh lullaby, a Highland boat song and three carols, in German, Latin and English.
rows.translation: Waleská uspávanka, lodná pieseň z Vysočiny a tri koledy v nemčine, latinčine a angličtine.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The tune Ar Hyd y Nos was printed in Wales in 1784, and Harold Boulton wrote these English words in 1884. One phrase comes three times, with a higher one in the middle.
rows.translation: Melódia Ar Hyd y Nos vyšla vo Walese v roku 1784 a Harold Boulton napísal tento anglický text v roku 1884. Jedna fráza zaznie trikrát, s vyššou uprostred.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Sleep, my child, and peace attend thee: open G, down to F sharp and E, then G, A, G, F sharp and D.
rows.translation: Sleep, my child, and peace attend thee: prázdne G, nadol na Fis a E, potom G, A, G, Fis a D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which phrase of the verse climbs highest?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The third phrase, soft the drowsy hours, rises to C, D and E. The other three phrases share one tune.
rows.translation: Tretia fráza, soft the drowsy hours, stúpa na C, D a E. Ostatné tri frázy majú rovnakú melódiu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Harold Boulton set these words in 1884 to a Highland rowing tune collected by Anne MacLeod. They tell of Bonnie Prince Charlie escaping to the Isle of Skye in 1746.
rows.translation: Harold Boulton priradil tento text v roku 1884 k veslárskej melódii zo Škótskej vysočiny, ktorú zozbierala Anne MacLeod. Rozpráva o úteku princa Charlesa na ostrov Skye v roku 1746.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: This song rocks in six-eight: two big beats a bar, each split in three. Count one-two-three, four-five-six, like oars pulling and coming back.
rows.translation: Táto pieseň sa kolíše v šesťosminovom takte: dve veľké doby, každá delená na tri. Počítajte raz-dva-tri, štyri-päť-šesť ako zábery vesiel a ich návrat.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Speed, bonnie boat, like a bird on the wing: open D, E, D, three open Gs, then A, B, A and up to D.
rows.translation: Speed, bonnie boat, like a bird on the wing: prázdne D, E, D, tri prázdne G, potom A, B, A a nahor na D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Ernst Anschütz wrote these words in Leipzig in 1824, to a much older folk tune. You'll sing them in German, the language they were written in.
rows.translation: Ernst Anschütz napísal tento text v Lipsku v roku 1824 na oveľa staršiu ľudovú melódiu. Budete ho spievať po nemecky, v jazyku, v ktorom vznikol.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: O Tannenbaum, o Tannenbaum: open D, three open Gs, then A at fret 2 and three open Bs.
rows.translation: O Tannenbaum, o Tannenbaum: prázdne D, tri prázdne G, potom A na pražci 2 a tri prázdne B.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Tan-nen is a dotted note and a very short one, then baum rings on. Say the words as you tap, and the rhythm follows.
rows.translation: Tan-nen je bodkovaná a veľmi krátka nota, potom baum znie ďalej. Pri ťukaní hovorte slová a rytmus sa dostaví.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The Latin hymn Adeste Fideles was printed with this tune in 1751, and Frederick Oakeley's English words followed in 1841. You'll sing a verse in each language.
rows.translation: Latinská duchovná pieseň Adeste Fideles vyšla s touto melódiou v roku 1751 a anglický text Fredericka Oakeleyho nasledoval v roku 1841. Zaspievate slohu v každom jazyku.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: O come, all ye faithful: open G twice, down to open D, back to G, A, and D again.
rows.translation: O come, all ye faithful: dvakrát prázdne G, nadol na prázdne D, späť na G, A a znova D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: How many times does the refrain sing O come, let us adore him?
rows.translation: Koľkokrát zaznie v refréne O come, let us adore him?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Three times, each a little higher, before Christ the Lord brings the tune home.
rows.translation: Trikrát, vždy o trochu vyššie, kým Christ the Lord privedie melódiu domov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Latin hymn (1751); English words Frederick Oakeley (1841)
rows.translation: Latinská duchovná pieseň (1751); anglický text Frederick Oakeley (1841)
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: This carol was first printed in 1823, in a collection of old Christmas carols. Its tune walks up the scale and back, which is why it is so easy to remember.
rows.translation: Táto koleda prvýkrát vyšla v roku 1823 v zbierke starých vianočných kolied. Melódia kráča nahor po stupnici a späť, preto sa tak ľahko pamätá.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Up the D scale: F sharp and E, open D, then E, F sharp, open G, A, open B, C sharp at fret 2 and D.
rows.translation: Nahor po stupnici D dur: Fis a E, prázdne D, potom E, Fis, prázdne G, A, prázdne B, Cis na pražci 2 a D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The tune starts with two quick notes, F sharp and E, before beat one. Then a long D and a run of eighths climb to A.
rows.translation: Melódia začína dvoma rýchlymi tónmi Fis a E pred prvou dobou. Potom dlhé D a sled osmín stúpajú k A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Five songs from this unit: two ballads and three carols. No new notes, just one after another, each a little faster than before.
rows.translation: Päť piesní z tejto časti: dve balady a tri koledy. Žiadne nové tóny, len jedna za druhou, každá trochu rýchlejšie než predtým.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which of these counts in six?
rows.translation: Ktorá z nich sa počíta na šesť?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The Skye Boat Song rocks in six-eight. O Christmas Tree is in three, and All Through the Night in four.
rows.translation: The Skye Boat Song sa kolíše v šesťosminovom takte. Ó, jedlička je na tri a All Through the Night na štyri.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A pipe march, a Russian folk dance, the Blue Danube and the can-can.
rows.translation: Gajdošský pochod, ruský ľudový tanec, Na krásnom modrom Dunaji a kankán.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: This Scottish march was in print by 1878, and pipe bands play it all over the world. Pipers play it without words, and so will you.
rows.translation: Tento škótsky pochod bol vytlačený už v roku 1878 a gajdošské kapely ho hrajú po celom svete. Gajdoši ho hrajú bez slov a rovnako aj vy.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A dotted note and a quick one give a march its snap: long, then short. In the first bar, the second D is long and E slips in just before beat two.
rows.translation: Bodkovaná a rýchla nota dávajú pochodu ráznosť: dlho, potom krátko. V prvom takte je druhé D dlhé a E sa pridá tesne pred druhou dobou.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Up the D chord: open D twice, E, F sharp at fret 4, D, F sharp, A, then D on string 2.
rows.translation: Nahor po akorde D: dvakrát prázdne D, E, Fis na pražci 4, D, Fis, A, potom D na strune 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Nikolay Nekrasov's poem about traveling peddlers was printed in 1861, and this folk tune was published with it in 1898. A video game made it famous worldwide almost a century later.
rows.translation: Báseň Nikolaja Nekrasova o putujúcich obchodníkoch vyšla v roku 1861 a táto ľudová melódia s ňou v roku 1898. Takmer o storočie neskôr ju po celom svete preslávila videohra.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The opening: open B, down to F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, up G and A, then G, F sharp, E.
rows.translation: Úvod: prázdne B, nadol na Fis na pražci 4 struny 4, nahor na G a A, potom G, Fis, E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The second half reaches higher: A, C at fret 1 on string 2, open E, then down D, C, B and G.
rows.translation: Druhá polovica siaha vyššie: A, C na pražci 1 struny 2, prázdne E, potom nadol D, C, B a G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: This tune is in E minor. Which note sounds like home?
rows.translation: Táto melódia je v E mol. Ktorý tón znie ako domov?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Both halves end on E, the home note of E minor. You hear it as the place the tune settles.
rows.translation: Obe polovice končia na E, domovskom tóne E mol. Počujete ho ako miesto, kde sa melódia usadí.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Johann Strauss II first performed this waltz in Vienna in 1867, and Vienna still plays it every New Year's Day. Its tune climbs a chord, then answers with two high notes.
rows.translation: Johann Strauss II uviedol tento valčík vo Viedni v roku 1867 a Viedeň ho dodnes hrá na Nový rok. Melódia stúpa po akorde a odpovedá dvoma vysokými tónmi.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 6 twice, B on string 5, open D, then leap up to D at fret 3 on string 2 and down to open B.
rows.translation: Dvakrát G na pražci 3 struny 6, B na strune 5, prázdne D, skok na D na pražci 3 struny 2 a nadol na prázdne B.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Each phrase starts low on the bass strings and leaps up an octave. Look at the high note before you play the low ones, so your hand knows where it's going.
rows.translation: Každá fráza začína nízko na basových strunách a skáče o oktávu nahor. Pozrite sa na vysoký tón skôr, než zahráte nízke, aby ruka vedela, kam smeruje.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Jacques Offenbach wrote this galop for his 1858 operetta Orpheus in the Underworld. Paris dance halls later made it the music of the can-can.
rows.translation: Jacques Offenbach napísal tento galop pre operetu Orfeus v podsvetí z roku 1858. Parížske tanečné sály z neho neskôr urobili hudbu ku kankánu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A long open G, then A, C, B, A, and two Ds at fret 3 on string 2.
rows.translation: Dlhé prázdne G, potom A, C, B, A a dve D na pražci 3 struny 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Most of the tune runs in eighth notes. Keep the pick small and alternate down and up, so you never fall behind.
rows.translation: Väčšina melódie beží v osminách. Robte malé pohyby brnkadlom a striedajte nadol a nahor, aby ste nezaostávali.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The big run: open G, leap to G at fret 3 on string 1, then step all the way down to A.
rows.translation: Veľký beh: prázdne G, skok na G na pražci 3 struny 1, potom po krokoch až nadol na A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Four tunes from this unit: a pipe march, a Russian folk song, a Viennese waltz and a French galop. Each one a little faster than before.
rows.translation: Štyri melódie z tejto časti: gajdošský pochod, ruská ľudová pieseň, viedenský valčík a francúzsky galop. Každá trochu rýchlejšie než predtým.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which of these is a waltz, in three?
rows.translation: Ktorá z nich je valčík na tri?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A waltz counts one, two, three. The can-can and the pipe march both count in four.
rows.translation: Valčík počíta raz, dva, tri. Kankán aj gajdošský pochod počítajú na štyri.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Joplin, Sousa, Bizet and Grieg: syncopation, six-eight and key changes.
rows.translation: Joplin, Sousa, Bizet a Grieg: synkopy, šesťosminový takt a zmeny tóniny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Scott Joplin published The Entertainer in 1902, and a 1973 film made it famous again. In ragtime the tune leans off the beat while the bass keeps steady time.
rows.translation: Scott Joplin vydal The Entertainer v roku 1902 a film z roku 1973 ho znova preslávil. V ragtime sa melódia opiera mimo doby, kým bas drží pravidelný pulz.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Open D, D sharp at fret 1, E at fret 2 on string 4, then leap to C at fret 1 on string 2 and back, three times.
rows.translation: Prázdne D, Dis na pražci 1, E na pražci 2 struny 4, potom skok na C na pražci 1 struny 2 a späť, trikrát.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Syncopation puts the accent between the beats. In the opening, each C lands on an and. Count one-and-two-and and feel the C pull ahead.
rows.translation: Synkopa kladie prízvuk medzi doby. V úvode každé C padne na „a“. Počítajte raz-a-dva-a a cíťte, ako C ťahá vpred.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The ending run circles C, D and E on strings 2 and 1, then lands through B and D on C.
rows.translation: Záverečný beh krúži okolo C, D a E na strunách 2 a 1 a potom cez B a D pristane na C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: John Philip Sousa published The Liberty Bell in 1893, and a British TV comedy later made it its theme. It's in six-eight: two big beats a bar, like left, right.
rows.translation: John Philip Sousa vydal The Liberty Bell v roku 1893 a britská televízna komédia si ho neskôr zvolila za zvučku. Je v šesťosminovom takte: dve veľké doby ako ľavá, pravá.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Many beats start with a short silence. Stop the string with your fretting hand, then come back in on the next eighth.
rows.translation: Mnohé doby začínajú krátkym tichom. Zastavte strunu hmatovou rukou a nastúpte znova na ďalšiu osminu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Open B three times, A sharp at fret 3 on string 3, B again, then up to G on string 1 and down D, D, B.
rows.translation: Trikrát prázdne B, Ais na pražci 3 struny 3, znova B, potom nahor na G na strune 1 a nadol D, D, B.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Georges Bizet's opera Carmen opened in Paris in 1875. Its prelude starts with this festive march, then plays the tune of the famous Toreador Song.
rows.translation: Opera Carmen Georgesa Bizeta mala premiéru v Paríži v roku 1875. Predohra začína týmto slávnostným pochodom, potom hrá melódiu slávnej Piesne toreadora.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Four As at fret 2 on string 3, then down to E at fret 2 on string 4, open D and E.
rows.translation: Štyri A na pražci 2 struny 3, potom nadol na E na pražci 2 struny 4, prázdne D a E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The march is in A major, with C sharp and G sharp. The Toreador tune moves to F major, with B flat at fret 3 on string 3. Watch for the change.
rows.translation: Pochod je v A dur s Cis a Gis. Melódia toreadora prejde do F dur so zníženým B na pražci 3 struny 3. Sledujte zmenu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: What happens at the end of the Toreador tune?
rows.translation: Čo sa stane na konci melódie toreadora?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: It climbs to a long E
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: It climbs to a long high E, the note that leads back home to A major for the march.
rows.translation: Stúpa na dlhé vysoké E, tón vedúci späť domov do A dur, kde sa vráti pochod.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Edvard Grieg wrote Morning Mood in 1875 for the play Peer Gynt. The flute plays the theme, the oboe answers, and the music climbs like the rising sun.
rows.translation: Edvard Grieg napísal Rannú náladu v roku 1875 pre hru Peer Gynt. Flauta hrá tému, hoboj odpovedá a hudba stúpa ako vychádzajúce slnko.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The theme uses just G, A, B, D and E. A five-note scale like this is called pentatonic, and it sounds calm and open.
rows.translation: Téma používa len G, A, B, D a E. Takáto päťtónová stupnica sa nazýva pentatonická a znie pokojne a otvorene.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open B, A at fret 2 on string 3, open G, then back up A and B.
rows.translation: D na pražci 3 struny 2, prázdne B, A na pražci 2 struny 3, prázdne G, potom späť nahor A a B.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: How many different notes does the theme use?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: G, A, B, D and E: a pentatonic scale. There is no C and no F sharp in the whole theme.
rows.translation: G, A, B, D a E: pentatonická stupnica. V celej téme nie je C ani Fis.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The four pieces from this unit, back to back: ragtime, a march, an opera prelude and a sunrise. Each a little faster than before.
rows.translation: Štyri skladby z tejto časti za sebou: ragtime, pochod, operná predohra a východ slnka. Každá trochu rýchlejšie než predtým.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which of these pieces uses only five notes in its theme?
rows.translation: Ktorá z týchto skladieb používa v téme iba päť tónov?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Morning Mood's theme is pentatonic: G, A, B, D and E. The others use many more.
rows.translation: Téma Rannej nálady je pentatonická: G, A, B, D a E. Ostatné používajú oveľa viac tónov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Four Christmas carols to sing by candlelight: Wesley and Mendelssohn, a lullaby, and two tunes from America.
rows.translation: Štyri vianočné koledy na spev pri sviečkach: Wesley a Mendelssohn, uspávanka a dve americké melódie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Charles Wesley wrote the words in 1739. In 1856 an English organist set them to a tune from a choral piece by Felix Mendelssohn, and the carol has been sung that way since.
rows.translation: Charles Wesley napísal text v roku 1739. V roku 1856 ho anglický organista spojil s melódiou zo zborovej skladby Felixa Mendelssohna a odvtedy sa koleda spieva takto.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Open D, open G twice, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, G, then open B twice and A at fret 2 on string 3.
rows.translation: Prázdne D, dvakrát prázdne G, Fis na pražci 4 struny 4, G, potom dvakrát prázdne B a A na pražci 2 struny 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Her-ald is long-short: her- lands on three and holds, and -ald slips in on the and of four. Count one, two, three, four-and.
rows.translation: Her-ald ide dlho-krátko: her- padne na tretiu a drží, -ald sa pridá na „a“ po štvrtej. Počítajte raz, dva, tri, štyri-a.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The chorus moves C, A minor, D7 and G. Change on the word that starts each half bar, and keep the strum light under the high E.
rows.translation: Refrén ide cez C, A mol, D7 a G. Meňte na slove, ktoré začína polovicu taktu, a pod vysokým E hrajte ľahko.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.translation: Charles Wesley (1739), podľa vydania z roku 1861
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: These words first appeared in an American children's book in 1885, and James R. Murray gave them this gentle tune in 1887. It rocks in three, like a cradle.
rows.translation: Tento text sa prvýkrát objavil v americkej detskej knihe v roku 1885 a James R. Murray mu dal jemnú melódiu v roku 1887. Kolíše sa na tri ako kolíska.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: It starts high: D at fret 3 on string 2, then steps down C, B, A, G and F sharp all the way to open D.
rows.translation: Začína vysoko: D na pražci 3 struny 2, potom klesá cez C, B, A, G a Fis až na prázdne D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The first line walks down from high D to low D. How far is that?
rows.translation: Prvý riadok klesá od vysokého D po nízke D. Aká je to vzdialenosť?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: D down to D is an octave: eight steps of the scale, the same note name, one register lower.
rows.translation: D nadol po D je oktáva: osem tónov stupnice vrátane krajných, rovnaký názov tónu o register nižšie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Hold G for most of a line, C for crib for a bed, and D7 to lead home. In three, strum down on one and lightly on two and three.
rows.translation: Väčšinu riadka držte G, na crib for a bed C a D7 na návrat domov. Na tri hrajte nadol na prvú a ľahko na druhú a tretiu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.translation: Neznámy autor (1885); sloha 3 John T. McFarland (1892)
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Phillips Brooks wrote these words in 1868 for the children of his Philadelphia church, and its organist, Lewis Redner, wrote the tune for their Christmas service.
rows.translation: Phillips Brooks napísal text v roku 1868 pre deti svojho kostola vo Philadelphii a organista Lewis Redner zložil melódiu na ich vianočnú bohoslužbu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Open B three times, A sharp at fret 3 on string 3, B again, then D, C and a drop to E on string 4.
rows.translation: Trikrát prázdne B, Ais na pražci 3 struny 3, znova B, potom D, C a pokles na E na strune 4.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A sharp at fret 3 on string 3 leans into open B, a half step up. It gives O little town its gentle sway.
rows.translation: Ais na pražci 3 struny 3 smeruje do prázdneho B o poltón vyššie. Dáva O little town jemné kolísanie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which word dips down to the low D in the first verse?
rows.translation: Ktoré slovo klesá v prvej slohe na nízke D?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Thee, in how still we see thee lie
rows.translation: Thee vo verši how still we see thee lie
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: How still we see thee lie: the tune falls to open D on thee, then lifts to B on lie.
rows.translation: How still we see thee lie: melódia klesne na prázdne D pri thee a potom stúpne na B pri lie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: It Came Upon the Midnight Clear
rows.translation: It Came Upon the Midnight Clear
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Edmund Sears wrote these words in Massachusetts in 1849, and Richard Storrs Willis wrote the tune a year later. It swings in two big beats a bar, each split in three.
rows.translation: Edmund Sears napísal text v Massachusetts v roku 1849 a Richard Storrs Willis zložil melódiu o rok neskôr. Hojdá sa v dvoch veľkých dobách v takte, každá sa delí na tri.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: In six-eight a quarter and an eighth make one big beat: long, short. Count one-two-three, four-five-six, and play on one, three, four and six.
rows.translation: V šesťosminovom takte tvorí štvrťová a osminová nota jednu veľkú dobu: dlho, krátko. Počítajte raz-dva-tri, štyri-päť-šesť a hrajte na raz, tri, štyri a šesť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Open G, a leap to open E on string 1, then B, D, C, A, and back to G with a turn through A.
rows.translation: Prázdne G, skok na prázdne E na strune 1, potom B, D, C, A a späť na G s obratom cez A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The middle of the verse drops to low E and climbs through G sharp, at fret 1 on string 3, to A. Under it the chord moves from E7 to A minor.
rows.translation: Stred slohy klesá na nízke E a stúpa cez Gis na pražci 1 struny 3 do A. Pod ním sa akord mení z E7 na A mol.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The four carols from this unit, one after another, each a little faster. Keep the chords soft and let the tune sing.
rows.translation: Štyri koledy z tejto časti za sebou, každá trochu rýchlejšie. Akordy hrajte jemne a nechajte melódiu spievať.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which of these carols counts in three?
rows.translation: Ktorá z týchto kolied sa počíta na tri?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Away in a Manger is a waltz: one, two, three. The other two count in four.
rows.translation: Away in a Manger je valčík: raz, dva, tri. Ostatné dve sa počítajú na štyri.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: King's College's opening carol, Holst's midwinter carol, a folk carol and a grand processional.
rows.translation: Úvodná koleda z King's College, Holstova zimná koleda, ľudová koleda a slávnostná procesiová pieseň.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Cecil Frances Alexander wrote these words for children in 1848. Since 1919 a single young voice has sung the first verse to open the Christmas Eve carols at King's College, Cambridge.
rows.translation: Cecil Frances Alexander napísala tento text pre deti v roku 1848. Od roku 1919 otvára koledy na Štedrý večer v King's College v Cambridge jediný mladý hlas prvou slohou.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Open D, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, open G, then a turn: G, F sharp, G, A, A, G.
rows.translation: Prázdne D, Fis na pražci 4 struny 4, prázdne G, potom obrat: G, Fis, G, A, A, G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Da-vid's spreads each syllable over two eighth notes. Play both, but sing them as one smooth sound.
rows.translation: V Da-vid's pripadajú na každú slabiku dve osminové noty. Zahrajte obe, ale spievajte ich ako jeden plynulý zvuk.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Where is the highest note of the carol?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Mary was that mother mild starts on open E, the top of the tune.
rows.translation: Mary was that mother mild začína na prázdnom E, vrchole melódie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A poem and a quiet tune
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Christina Rossetti wrote this poem in 1872, and Gustav Holst set it to music for a hymn book in 1906. Its lines are short and calm, like snow falling.
rows.translation: Christina Rossetti napísala túto báseň v roku 1872 a Gustav Holst ju zhudobnil pre spevník v roku 1906. Jej riadky sú krátke a pokojné ako padajúci sneh.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Open B twice, C at fret 1 and D at fret 3 on string 2, then back down B, A and G.
rows.translation: Dvakrát prázdne B, C na pražci 1 a D na pražci 3 struny 2, potom späť nadol B, A a G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Many words land on half notes: -ter in mid-winter, i-ron. Let each ring for two full beats before you move on.
rows.translation: Mnohé slová padajú na polové noty: -ter v mid-winter, i-ron. Každú nechajte znieť celé dve doby, než pôjdete ďalej.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Long ago stretches three syllables over how many notes?
rows.translation: Na koľkých tónoch sa rozložia tri slabiky Long ago?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Long takes two notes, a- takes two, and go takes one: five notes for three syllables.
rows.translation: Long má dva tóny, a- dva a go jeden: päť tónov na tri slabiky.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Under frost-y wind made moan the chords move A minor to D7, a lean that pulls the line back to G.
rows.translation: Pod frost-y wind made moan idú akordy z A mol do D7 a priťahujú riadok späť do G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: This carol is centuries old. The song collector Cecil Sharp heard it sung in a Cotswold town and printed this tune in 1911. It dances in three.
rows.translation: Táto koleda je stará stáročia. Zberateľ piesní Cecil Sharp ju počul v mestečku v Cotswolds a túto melódiu vydal v roku 1911. Tancuje na tri.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Four open Gs, then a leap to open E on string 1, down to D at fret 3 on string 2 and open B.
rows.translation: Štyri prázdne G, potom skok na prázdne E na strune 1, nadol na D na pražci 3 struny 2 a prázdne B.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: From open G to open E is a sixth. Keep your pick close to the strings and cross from string 3 to string 1 in one move.
rows.translation: Od prázdneho G po prázdne E je sexta. Držte brnkadlo blízko strún a prejdite zo struny 3 na strunu 1 jedným pohybom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Angels from the Realms of Glory
rows.translation: Angels from the Realms of Glory
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: James Montgomery printed these words in his Sheffield newspaper on Christmas Eve, 1816. Henry Smart's tune, from 1867, gives it a grand, marching sound.
rows.translation: James Montgomery vytlačil tento text vo svojich sheffieldských novinách na Štedrý večer roku 1816. Melódia Henryho Smarta z roku 1867 mu dáva slávnostný pochodový zvuk.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: A on string 3, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, D at fret 3 on string 2, A, then F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, E and D.
rows.translation: A na strune 3, Fis na pražci 4 struny 4, D na pražci 3 struny 2, A, potom Fis na pražci 2 struny 1, E a D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: This key has two sharps, F sharp and C sharp. C sharp sits at fret 2 on string 2.
rows.translation: Táto tónina má dva krížiky, Fis a Cis. Cis leží na pražci 2 struny 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Where is the highest note of the chorus?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Worship Christ starts on G at fret 3 on string 1, the top of the whole carol.
rows.translation: Worship Christ začína na G na pražci 3 struny 1, vrchole celej koledy.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The carols from this unit, back to back. Most move in long notes: let each one ring full length before the next.
rows.translation: Koledy z tejto časti za sebou. Väčšina ide v dlhých tónoch: každý nechajte znieť celú dĺžku pred ďalším.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which of these counts in three?
rows.translation: Ktorá z nich sa počíta na tri?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: The Holly and the Ivy is in three. The other two count in four.
rows.translation: The Holly and the Ivy je na tri. Ostatné dve sa počítajú na štyri.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Five great hymns in long, singing notes, from 1708 to 1861.
rows.translation: Päť veľkých duchovných piesní v dlhých spevných tónoch, od roku 1708 do 1861.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: O God, Our Help in Ages Past
rows.translation: O God, Our Help in Ages Past
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: William Croft wrote this tune, St Anne, in 1708, and Isaac Watts's words were first printed in 1719. Each verse is four short lines, the plainest hymn shape there is.
rows.translation: William Croft napísal melódiu St Anne v roku 1708 a text Isaaca Wattsa prvýkrát vyšiel v roku 1719. Každá sloha má štyri krátke riadky, najjednoduchší tvar duchovnej piesne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Open G, E at fret 2 on string 4, A at fret 2 on string 3, G, then C at fret 1 on string 2, C, open B and C.
rows.translation: Prázdne G, E na pražci 2 struny 4, A na pražci 2 struny 3, G, potom C na pražci 1 struny 2, C, prázdne B a C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3

rows.source: Every line starts on the beat before the bar: O, our, our, and. Count four, then sing the first word on it.
rows.translation: Každý riadok začína na dobe pred taktom: O, our, our, and. Počítajte štyri a na nej zaspievajte prvé slovo.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI 3
